Frost Wyrm Corrompido.aparencia: Broken skeletal dragon with discolored green-tinged bones, chipped horns, dripping frozen sludge, bits of rotten sinew clinging to ribs, and glowing sickly blue eyes in a warped skull.

Frost Wyrm Elite.aparencia: Colossal skeletal dragon with thick, bleached bones, huge spiked wing arms, a heavy horned skull with bright blue eye lights, and thick ice armor encrusting its chest and legs.

Gryphon Guerreiro.aparencia: Eagle-headed winged beast with golden-brown feathers on the forequarters and a tawny lion body, large wings, a hooked beak, sharp talons and a tufted tail, rearing with spread wings.

Gryphon Xamã.aparencia: Eagle-headed winged beast with soft cream-and-grey feathers, a lion hindquarters and blue-glowing eyes, with beads and feather charms tied to its crest, standing calmly with wings half open.

Gryphon Caçador.aparencia: Sleek eagle-headed winged beast with light brown speckled feathers, a lean lion body, long narrow wings and keen amber eyes, crouched low in a stalking posture with a pointed beak forward.

Gryphon Mago.aparencia: Eagle-headed winged beast with blue-white feathers, a pale lion body, wing tips crackling with small arcs of light and a glowing blue gem-like patch on its chest, wings flared.

Gryphon Assassino.aparencia: Slim eagle-headed winged beast with dark grey and black feathers, a lean charcoal lion body, long hooked claws and a narrow sharp beak, crouched on its haunches with wings tucked.

Gryphon Corrompido.aparencia: Eagle-headed, lion-bodied beast with patchy, molting feathers of sickly green-grey, exposed sores along the flanks, bloodshot yellow eyes and a warped, overgrown beak. Wings hang ragged and uneven.

Gryphon Elite.aparencia: Large eagle-headed lion-bodied beast with glossy golden-brown plumage, a thick mane-like ruff and heavily muscled haunches. Broad wings, a scarred hooked beak and a proud, upright stance.

Gryphon Ancião.aparencia: Aged eagle-lion hybrid with white-grey feathers, a long pale ruff and cloudy, wise amber eyes. The beak is chipped and the tawny hindquarters lean, yet the huge wings still spread wide and calm.

Hippogryph Guerreiro.aparencia: Raven-headed stag-bodied beast with glossy black plumage, thick forelegs and branching antlers. Chest broad and muscled, wings half-flared, scarred beak and a forward, braced stance.

Hippogryph Xamã.aparencia: Black raven-headed stag with antlers wound in vines, small feathers and pale charms. Soft grey markings streak the wings, and it stands with its head lowered and calm, eyes bright and half-lidded.

Hippogryph Caçador.aparencia: Lean raven-headed stag with dark brown-black feathers, sharp keen eyes and a streamlined build. Wings held slightly lifted, long legs ready to spring, and antlers swept back like a stalking hunter.

Hippogryph Mago.aparencia: Raven-headed stag with deep indigo-black plumage dusted with silver speckles, like a night sky. Antler tips glow faintly violet, and the wings curve elegantly above a slim, poised body.

Hippogryph Assassino.aparencia: Slender, jet-black raven-headed stag with narrow wings, sharp curved talons and thin antlers. Its low, crouched stance and glinting pale eyes give it a silent, stalking look.

Hippogryph Corrompido.aparencia: Raven-headed stag with ragged, molting feathers, gaunt ribs showing through grey-green skin, and antlers twisted into crooked spikes. Eyes weep a sickly glow and one wing droops limply.

Hippogryph Elite.aparencia: Imposing raven-headed stag with glossy blue-black plumage, heavy chest and thick forelegs. Tall, polished antlers frame its head and powerful wings are held wide in a commanding pose.

Hippogryph Ancião.aparencia: Old raven-headed stag with silver-white streaked plumage and massive, many-branched antlers wreathed in moss. Its eyes are milky and gentle, and its stance is slow and dignified.

Chimera Guerreiro.aparencia: Two-headed winged beast with a dragon-like body, scaly rust-red hide and heavy shoulders. Both heads bear horns and scarred jaws, wings are broad and tattered at the edges, tail long and spiked.

Chimera Xamã.aparencia: Two-headed winged beast with mottled teal-green scales and feathery crests on both heads. Bone-like charms hang from the horns, and its pale eyes are calm and glassy. Wings are streaked with ochre markings.

Chimera Caçador.aparencia: Lean two-headed flying beast with sandy-brown scales, narrow wings and a streamlined frame. One head scans the ground, the other the sky; long clawed feet are tucked as if ready to dive.

Chimera Mago.aparencia: Two-headed winged beast with deep violet scales and glowing amber eyes, one head crowned with curved horns, the other with a frilled crest. Faint embers drift from both mouths, and the wings are thin and wide.

Chimera Assassino.aparencia: Sleek two-headed winged beast with matte charcoal scales, slim horns and narrow wings. Both heads are low and pointed with thin, needle-like fangs; the tail is thin and whip-like, body built for silence.

Chimera Corrompido.aparencia: Two-headed winged beast with blotchy green-black scales, oozing lesions and mismatched horns. One head is swollen, the other half-withered; torn wing membranes and a drooling, wheezing look.

Chimera Elite.aparencia: Massive two-headed winged beast with glossy crimson scales edged in gold, thick plated shoulders and heavy horns. Smoke curls from both nostrils, and the broad wings and long barbed tail look imposing.

Chimera Ancião.aparencia: Huge, weathered two-headed winged beast with cracked grey-bronze scales and long, curled horns grown thick with age. Eyes are cloudy, jaws heavy with worn fangs, and the wings are wide but frayed.

Treant Guerreiro.aparencia: Tall tree-bodied giant with thick, gnarled bark limbs and broad shoulders. Knotted fists, a jaw-like split in the trunk and branches bent forward like a brace; leaves are dark green and sparse.

Treant Xamã.aparencia: Tree-bodied giant with moss-draped bark and a crown of flowering branches. Glowing amber sap seeps in carved spirals on the trunk, wooden charms and feathers hang from twigs, and the eyes are hollow and gentle.

Treant Caçador.aparencia: Lean, tall tree-bodied giant with a narrow trunk, long arms like bending boughs and tangled vines coiled at the shoulders. Bark in brown-green camouflage tones, thorny twigs at the fingers, poised and watchful.

Treant Mago.aparencia: Tree-bodied giant with silvery-blue bark and leaves that shimmer with faint stars. Glowing runelike grain patterns run through the trunk, and the branches arc overhead like a tall, graceful crown.

Treant Assassino.aparencia: Narrow, dark-barked tree-bodied figure with sparse black leaves and long, thin splintered fingers. Its trunk twists forward into a crouch, with thorn-like claws and glinting pale knot-eyes in deep shadow.

Treant Corrompido.aparencia: Rotting tree-bodied giant with black, weeping bark, fungus clusters and dead gray leaves. Roots drag unevenly, a hollow gapes in the chest oozing dark sap, and the branches are twisted into sharp, jagged barbs.

Treant Elite.aparencia: Massive tree-bodied giant with iron-hard, dark bark and thick buttress-like legs. Heavy limbs with fist-sized knots, a dense crown of deep green leaves and golden sap veins give it a mighty, rooted stance.

Treant Ancião.aparencia: Enormous, ancient tree-bodied giant with deeply furrowed bark thick with moss, lichen and small mushrooms. Long drooping branches like a beard, slow, heavy limbs and soft, glowing green eyes in the trunk.

Whelp Guerreiro.aparencia: Small young dragon with ruddy scales, stubby horns and a stout, muscled body. Small wings flare in a fighting pose, with a scarred snout, claws spread and tail raised like a club.

Whelp Xamã.aparencia: Small young dragon with mossy green-and-teal scales and a frill of feathers along the neck. Tiny bone beads dangle from the horns, wings are short, and its wide golden eyes look calm and thoughtful.

Whelp Caçador.aparencia: Small young dragon with sandy-brown scales, a slim body and long, slender legs. Narrow snout, bright alert eyes, small pointed wings held tight to the sides and a low, stalking crouch.

Whelp Mago.aparencia: Small young dragon with indigo scales speckled with silver, short curved horns and large violet eyes. Tiny wings with star-like spots, a faint glow at the throat and a graceful, upright pose.

Whelp Assassino.aparencia: Small, sleek young dragon with matte black scales, a narrow wedge-shaped head and thin tail. Small sharp claws and tight wings; it crouches low with slitted pale eyes, built for stealth.

Whelp Corrompido.aparencia: Small young dragon with blotchy gray-green scales, weeping sores and a lopsided, swollen jaw. Wings are torn and thin, ribs show, and its crooked horns and clouded yellow eyes look sick.

Whelp Elite.aparencia: Small young dragon with glossy crimson scales edged in gold, heavier horns and a broad chest. Well-fed and powerful for its size, with spiked tail ridge and wings spread proudly.

Whelp Ancião.aparencia: Small but old-looking dragon with dull bronze scales, a grizzled chin ridge and long, curled horns. Droopy lids over deep, wise eyes, a slow and settled posture, and worn, faded claws.

Drake Guerreiro.aparencia: Horse-sized dragon with dusky red scales, thick neck and broad chest. Heavy horns, a scarred jaw and sturdy limbs; wide wings flared and a clubbed tail held ready for a charge.

Drake Xamã.aparencia: Horse-sized dragon with sea-green scales and a feathered ridge down the spine. Bone charms and pale ribbons hang from its horns, the wings are streaked with ochre markings, and the gaze is calm and steady.

Drake Caçador.aparencia: Slim, long-limbed dragon about the size of a horse, with tan-brown mottled scales and narrow wings. Its sharp snout, keen eyes and low, stalking stance suit a pursuit predator.

Drake Mago.aparencia: Horse-sized dragon with deep blue scales flecked with silver, swept-back horns and glowing amber eyes. Wings are broad with delicate veins, and faint sparks curl around the jaw.

Drake Assassino.aparencia: Lithe horse-sized dragon with dull black scales, a narrow head and thin wings kept folded close. Long claws, a whip-thin tail and a flattened, creeping posture; eyes are pale and slitted.

Drake Corrompido.aparencia: Horse-sized dragon with mottled green-black scales peeling away to raw, oozing patches. Horns grow crooked, one wing is shredded, and the jaw hangs loose over uneven teeth with dull, sickly eyes.

Drake Elite.aparencia: Powerful horse-sized dragon with polished crimson scales trimmed in gold and thick plated armor along the back. Heavy swept-back horns, massive wings and a large barbed tail with a commanding stance.

Drake Ancião.aparencia: Large, weathered dragon with dull bronze-grey scales, thick curling horns and a heavy, sagging chin. Wings are wide but ragged at the edges, and the cloudy eyes and slow movements suggest great age.

Ogre Guerreiro.aparencia: Huge, hulking humanoid with thick grey-brown skin, an underbite with tusks and a bald, heavy brow. Broad scarred chest, wrapped hide and iron bracers, gripping a massive spiked club.

Ogre Xamã.aparencia: Huge humanoid with mottled tan skin, tusks and a tangled beard hung with bones and feathers. Painted white spirals cover the chest, a fur cloak on the shoulders and a gnarled wooden staff in one fist.

Ogre Caçador.aparencia: Huge but lean humanoid with dusty olive skin, jutting tusks and a hood of animal hide. Carries a heavy crude bow and a bundle of thick spears, with cord wraps around the arms and legs.

Ogre Mago.aparencia: Huge humanoid with bluish-grey skin, small tusks and a topknot of braided hair. Wears a long patched robe covered in chalk runes and holds a crooked staff with a glowing stone.

Ogre Assassino.aparencia: Unusually lean, huge humanoid with dark ashen skin, a narrow jaw with short tusks and a dark wrapped hood. Cloth bound over the face and a pair of curved knives hang at the belt.

Ogre Corrompido.aparencia: Huge humanoid with sagging green-grey skin covered in boils and open sores. One arm is swollen, tusks are cracked and black, and the eyes are bloodshot and weeping, with tattered rags hanging off.

Ogre Elite.aparencia: Massive humanoid with thick, dark grey skin, huge tusks and a heavily scarred face. Wears layered plate pauldrons and a spiked iron belt and carries a huge double-headed hammer.

Ogre Ancião.aparencia: Gigantic old humanoid with wrinkled, stone-grey skin, a long white beard and worn, broken tusks. Hunched with a heavy cane of twisted wood, a cloak of old furs and slow, clouded eyes.

Core Hound Guerreiro.aparencia: Large four-legged hound of black molten rock with glowing orange cracks over a heavy chest. Its massive head carries scarred jaws and short horns, and flames flicker from the shoulders as it braces to charge.

Core Hound Xamã.aparencia: Four-legged hound of dark volcanic stone with glowing orange veins. Pale ash markings run down the flanks, small bones hang from the neck, and its flame mane and tail burn low and steady.

Core Hound Caçador.aparencia: Lean four-legged hound of charcoal rock with thin glowing orange seams. Long legs, narrow muzzle, pointed ears and a lowered stalking posture; the tail is a streak of embers.

Core Hound Mago.aparencia: Four-legged hound of dark stone with blue-white glowing veins instead of orange. Small floating embers circle the head, the flame mane is crown-like and the eyes glow bright white.

Core Hound Assassino.aparencia: Slim four-legged hound of obsidian-black rock whose glowing cracks are dim red. Narrow head, sharp fangs and a low, silent crouch; its mane burns only as faint embers.

Core Hound Corrompido.aparencia: Four-legged hound of crumbling rock with sickly green fire leaking from the cracks. Uneven limbs, a lopsided head with fused jaws, dripping molten slag and eyes that glow dull yellow.

Core Hound Elite.aparencia: Large four-legged hound of dark rock plated with thick, glowing-edged slabs over the chest and shoulders. A mane of bright orange flame, heavy jaws and horn-like spikes on its brow.

Core Hound Ancião.aparencia: Big, old four-legged hound of cooled grey-brown rock with only faint orange glow in deep cracks. Heavy, slow frame, mossy ash on the back, drooping jowls and a dim, smoldering mane.

Felhunter Guerreiro.aparencia: Hulking four-legged demon hound with purple-blue skin, spiked back ridge and tentacle-like whiskers around a toothy maw. Glowing green eyes, broad chest and scarred, clawed limbs.

Felhunter Xamã.aparencia: Four-legged demon hound with violet skin, whiskering tentacles around the maw and dangling bones and ragged cloth strips. Green runic scars glow along the ribs and the eyes are half-lidded and calm.

Felhunter Caçador.aparencia: Lean four-legged demon hound with blue-purple skin, a narrow head and long tentacle whiskers. Pointed ears, sleek long legs and a low, sniffing stance with glowing green eyes.

Felhunter Mago.aparencia: Four-legged demon hound with deep indigo skin and glowing green spiral markings on the flanks. Whisker tentacles drift in the air and small green flames hover near the horns.

Felhunter Assassino.aparencia: Slender four-legged demon hound with nearly black blue skin, narrow head and sharp, curved claws. Short fine whisker tentacles, thin glowing slitted eyes and a creeping crouch.

Felhunter Corrompido.aparencia: Four-legged demon hound with blotchy, sagging skin and exposed ribs. Tentacle whiskers are limp and tangled, one eye is swollen shut, and green slime oozes from its split, crooked jaws.

Felhunter Elite.aparencia: Large four-legged demon hound with deep purple skin, horn-like plates over shoulders and back, and long tentacle whiskers. Thick limbs, bright green eyes and a heavy, imposing frame.

Felhunter Ancião.aparencia: Old four-legged demon hound with faded grey-violet skin, sagging jowls and long drooping whiskers. Dull green eyes, chipped fangs and a slow, heavy gait with dry, cracked patches along the back.

Voidwalker Guerreiro.aparencia: Hovering, shapeless blue-violet being with a broad, heavy torso and thick, dense arms ending in crushing fists. Hollow white eyes glow in a faceless head; its edges swirl like dark smoke.

Voidwalker Xamã.aparencia: Hovering blue-purple being of swirling shadow with a hunched shape and long arms. Pale glyph marks float around it, feathers and bones hang from tendrils, and two soft white eyes glow in its hollow face.

Voidwalker Caçador.aparencia: Lean, hovering blue-purple being of dark mist with a stretched, narrow body and long grasping arms. Trailing wisp tail, glowing white eyes fixed forward in a stalking, forward-leaning pose.

Voidwalker Mago.aparencia: Hovering violet being of dark smoke with a tall, elegant shape. Tiny star-like points shimmer inside its body, ringed sparks orbit its hands, and its eyes glow bright blue-white.

Voidwalker Assassino.aparencia: Thin, nearly black-blue hovering being of smoke with a sharp, tapered body. Narrow blade-like fingers, thin glowing slit eyes and a body that trails into a shredded point.

Voidwalker Corrompido.aparencia: Hovering being of murky blue-purple smoke streaked with sickly green. Its body bulges and tears unevenly, extra lopsided arms dangle, and its eyes are mismatched and flicker.

Voidwalker Elite.aparencia: Large hovering being of dense, dark violet-blue mass with thick, solid-looking arms and a broad chest. Edges crackle with faint light, and its bright white eyes are set deep in a hooded head.

Voidwalker Ancião.aparencia: Huge hovering being of pale blue-grey smoke, worn and thin at the edges. Its form drifts slowly, long trailing wisps like a beard, and dim, deep-set eyes glow faintly in a hollow face.

Infernal Guerreiro.aparencia: Giant, hulking demon-golem of cracked dark stone with green fire spilling through the fissures. Massive fists, horned head and wide shoulders, with heavy plates of scorched rock on the arms.

Infernal Caçador.aparencia: Tall, lean stone-bodied demon with dark cracked rock and thin streaks of green fire. Long arms, a narrow horned head and a hunched forward lean like a tracker; fingers are claw-like.

Infernal Mago.aparencia: Tall stone-bodied demon of dark cracked rock with bright green-white fire at the chest and eyes. Floating rock shards orbit it, glowing carved marks cover the arms and the horns are curled and tall.

Infernal Assassino.aparencia: Slim stone-bodied demon of black rock with narrow, dim green cracks. Sharp spiked elbows, thin blade-like fingers and a lowered, creeping pose; eyes are tiny green slits.

Infernal Corrompido.aparencia: Crumbling stone-bodied demon with sickly yellow-green flames and sagging, uneven rock slabs. One arm is oversized, horns are cracked, and tar-like slag drips from open fissures.

Infernal Elite.aparencia: Giant stone-bodied demon with thick black plated rock and bright green flames at the joints. Massive spiked shoulders, heavy horns and a wide, imposing build with oversized fists.

Infernal Ancião.aparencia: Enormous old stone-bodied demon with weathered grey rock covered in moss and ash. Fire glows only faintly in deep cracks, the horns are worn blunt and its posture is heavy and slow.

Doomguard Guerreiro.aparencia: Tall, muscular demon with dark red skin, curved horns and bat-like wings. Heavy plate armor in black iron with green glowing seams, a scarred face and a huge two-handed blade.

Doomguard Xamã.aparencia: Tall demon with ashen red skin and swept-back horns, draped in a ragged hide mantle with skulls at the shoulders. Painted green glyphs mark the chest and it holds a twisted bone staff.

Doomguard Caçador.aparencia: Lean tall demon with dark crimson skin, curved horns and narrow bat wings. Wears a light leather harness and a hood, and carries a heavy barbed crossbow with a quiver of dark bolts.

Doomguard Mago.aparencia: Tall, thin demon with dark purple-red skin and tall curved horns. Wears long black robes with glowing green trim and holds a staff topped with a floating fel-green orb.

Doomguard Assassino.aparencia: Slim demon with dusky red skin, swept horns and short folded wings, in dark cloth wraps and a half mask. Two thin curved daggers at the belt, glowing green eyes and a quiet, crouched stance.

Doomguard Corrompido.aparencia: Tall demon with mottled gray-red skin sagging off its frame, cracked horns and tattered wings. Armor is rusted and half fallen off, green ichor leaks from sores and the eyes are glassy.

Doomguard Elite.aparencia: Huge demon with deep crimson skin, great curved horns and broad wings, in ornate black plate with spiked pauldrons and green-glowing trim. Wields a massive jagged axe and stands tall.

Doomguard Ancião.aparencia: Old, tall demon with faded grey-red skin, long chipped horns and ragged wings. Heavy, tarnished armor worn with age, a thin white beard of wisps and slow, clouded green eyes.

Succubus Guerreiro.aparencia: Tall, athletic female demon with violet-pink skin, curved horns and a barbed tail. Wears dark spiked leather and bladed bracers, with short wings half spread and a whip coiled at the hip.

Succubus Xamã.aparencia: Female demon with lavender skin, curled horns and a slim tail. Dressed in cloth wraps with bone beads and feathers, her chest and arms painted with white swirls, a crooked bone staff in hand.

Succubus Caçador.aparencia: Lithe female demon with rose-violet skin, swept horns and small wings. Wears a hooded leather jacket, carries a short recurve bow and arrow quiver, and holds a low, watchful crouch.

Succubus Mago.aparencia: Slender female demon with deep violet skin, tall curled horns and glowing pink eyes. Long dark robes with magenta embroidery, a floating spark between her hands and a thin spaded tail.

Succubus Assassino.aparencia: Slim female demon with dusky purple skin, narrow horns and a thin tail. Black close-fitting cloth, a veil across the face and twin curved daggers; wings folded tight against her back.

Succubus Corrompido.aparencia: Female demon with blotchy gray-purple skin, cracked horns and torn bat wings. Her thin frame is marked by sores, clothes hang in rags, and glassy red eyes and a drooping tail show decay.

Succubus Elite.aparencia: Tall female demon with deep magenta skin, long swept horns and large leathery wings. Ornate black armored corset, spiked gauntlets and a barbed tail tipped with gold.

Succubus Ancião.aparencia: Aged female demon with faded mauve skin, long worn horns and tattered wings. Silver streaked hair, wrinkled face with sharp eyes, a long dark shawl and a cane with a curled tail behind.

Ork Boy Veterano.aparencia: Broad green-skinned brute with a heavy jaw, tusks and a scarred face missing part of one ear. Wears patched armor plates and a crude helmet, with a rough cleaver and a battered, hunched stance.

Ork Boy Mutante.aparencia: Green-skinned brute with a lopsided frame, one oversized arm and an extra eye on the forehead. Skin is blotchy, tusks uneven and scrap metal is bolted to the body; it hunches and slouches.

Ork Boy Exaltado.aparencia: Hulking green-skinned brute with a jutting tusked jaw, stooped shoulders and thick arms. Crude plated armor is polished and trimmed with pale gold, and a faint glow rims the heavy cleaver.

Ork Boy Sombrio.aparencia: Broad, hunched green brute whose skin has dulled to a bruised grey-green. Soot-black scrap armor, eyes glowing dim red under a heavy brow, tusks chipped and a ragged cloak trailing behind.

Ork Boy de Elite.aparencia: Unusually tall and wide green-skinned brute with scarred, knotted muscles and a heavy underbite. Wears thick, well-patched plate and a crested helm, gripping a massive blade with a steady stance.

Gretchin Veterano.aparencia: Small, wiry goblin-like creature with big pointed ears, a sharp-toothed grin and wrinkled olive skin crisscrossed by old scars. Carries a battered scrap helmet and a patched leather vest.

Gretchin Mutante.aparencia: Small goblin-like creature with a lopsided body: one oversized arm, extra knobbly lumps on the back and a swollen, sickly-green head. Mismatched eyes, drooling mouth, hunched crooked stance.

Gretchin Exaltado.aparencia: Small olive-green goblin-like creature standing unusually upright, with large ears and a pale halo of light behind its head. Wears a scrap circlet and a clean white sash over its scrawny frame.

Gretchin Sombrio.aparencia: Small, thin goblin-like creature with slate-black skin, long drooping ears and glowing yellow slit eyes. Crouches low in a dark ragged hood, long fingers curled like hooks.

Gretchin de Elite.aparencia: Small but sturdy goblin-like creature with bright green skin, large ears and a confident crooked grin. Dressed in tidy scrap plates and a crested helmet, holding a short blade upright.

Squig Veterano.aparencia: Round, fleshy red-orange beast that is mostly a huge toothy mouth on stubby legs, with two small eyes on top. Hide is thick and scarred, one fang broken, and it plods with a heavy, wary gait.

Squig Mutante.aparencia: Bulbous orange beast with a wide fanged mouth and stubby legs, now sprouting extra eyes and warty growths across its lumpy hide. One side swells larger than the other, giving a lurching gait.

Squig Exaltado.aparencia: Round, plump beast with a wide toothy mouth on stubby legs, its hide a clean bright orange-pink. Pale glowing patterns trace the skin and a soft light halo floats above its small eyes.

Squig Sombrio.aparencia: Round, toothy beast on stubby legs with dusky purple-black hide and a gaping mouth full of pale fangs. Two small glowing red eyes sit on top, and thin wisps of dark mist drift off its back.

Squig de Elite.aparencia: Large, muscular round beast with a huge fanged mouth, glossy red hide and strong stubby legs. Thick armor-like ridges run over its back, and it stands squarely with a challenging glare.

Tyranid Gaunt Veterano.aparencia: Lean, insectoid alien with a chitinous purple-grey carapace, four limbs ending in scythe claws and a long tail. Its plating is scored and chipped, and the narrow head bears a toothy, hissing maw.

Tyranid Gaunt Mutante.aparencia: Lean insectoid alien with a purple carapace gone lumpy, with an extra pair of misshapen claws, bulging sacs along the spine and a swollen, asymmetric skull. Moves with a twitching, uneven gait.

Tyranid Gaunt Exaltado.aparencia: Slender insectoid alien with a smooth, pearly violet carapace edged in pale gold and elegant curved claws. A bright crest rises from the skull and a soft glow hangs around its upright body.

Tyranid Gaunt Sombrio.aparencia: Lean insectoid alien with a near-black carapace, glossy like wet ink, and glowing violet eye slits. Its blade-like claws and thin tail are matte and sharp, and it hunches low in a stalking pose.

Tyranid Gaunt de Elite.aparencia: Taller, heavier insectoid alien with a thick purple carapace, bony crest and broad shoulder plates. Four sharp scythe claws, a strong tail and a firm, ready stance mark it as a seasoned fighter.

Genestealer Veterano.aparencia: Gaunt, four-armed alien with a long elongated skull, purple-grey chitin and sharp, curved talons. Its carapace is battle-scarred and cracked in places, and it stands in a coiled, tense crouch.

Genestealer Mutante.aparencia: Gaunt four-armed alien with an elongated skull, now bulging with tumorous lumps and a split, uneven jaw. Fleshy growths bulge between mismatched claws, and the carapace is a blotchy purple-green.

Genestealer Exaltado.aparencia: Tall, graceful four-armed alien with a smooth elongated skull, polished pale violet chitin and fine gilded edges on its talons. A faint radiant aura outlines its elegant, upright figure.

Genestealer Sombrio.aparencia: Sleek four-armed alien with an elongated skull and pitch-black chitin that swallows light. Only its faint violet eyes and thin pale talon tips show as it creeps low to the ground.

Genestealer de Elite.aparencia: Large, strongly built four-armed alien with an elongated skull, thick purple chitin plates and long, razor-edged talons. Its broad frame and squared, confident stance set it apart from smaller kin.

Carnifex Veterano.aparencia: Huge, bulky armored beast on thick legs with a heavy bone-plated head, two massive scything claws and a thick tail. Its chitin is scarred and pitted with old gouges, and it plods forward heavily.

Carnifex Mutante.aparencia: Huge armored beast with a plated head and twin scything claws, but misshapen: swollen bony lumps on the shoulders, one limb larger than the other and a drooping, uneven jaw. Skin is sickly mottled.

Carnifex Exaltado.aparencia: Huge armored beast with heavy bone plates, twin large claws and a thick tail, its carapace polished to a pearly sheen with pale gold edging. A calm, bright glow surrounds its broad, upright frame.

Carnifex Sombrio.aparencia: Huge armored beast with a black, rough carapace, heavy plated skull and two massive claws. Dull red eyes glow beneath its brow, and shadowy wisps curl up from the thick tail and jagged back spikes.

Carnifex de Elite.aparencia: Enormous armored beast, even broader than usual, with layered thick plates, a horned crest and giant crushing claws. It stands tall and wide with a thick tail, an imposing and well-fed bulk.

Hive Tyrant Veterano.aparencia: Tall, winged insectoid overlord with a large crested skull, four arms ending in long scythes and a spined tail. Its dark purple carapace is chipped and scarred, and a tattered membrane spans its wings.

Hive Tyrant Exaltado.aparencia: Tall winged insectoid with a grand crested skull, four arms with elegant long blades and a polished pearly carapace trimmed in gold. Broad pale wings spread behind it and a soft halo glows overhead.

Hive Tyrant Sombrio.aparencia: Tall winged insectoid with a jet-black carapace, a tall crested skull and four arms ending in long dark scythes. Smoky wings hang in tatters and its eyes burn a dim violet in the shadow of its crest.

Hive Tyrant de Elite.aparencia: Towering winged insectoid with thick layered purple plates, a large horned crest and four heavily armed limbs. Wide, strong wings and a spiked tail frame its imposing, commanding upright stance.

Space Marine Mutante.aparencia: Very tall armored warrior in bulky power armor, but the body beneath has warped: one oversized arm bursting through a cracked pauldron, fleshy growths at the neck and a lopsided helmet fitting poorly.

Space Marine Exaltado.aparencia: Very tall warrior in gleaming white and gold power armor with a laurel-crested helmet. A soft light haloes the broad shoulders, and a heavy ornate sword is held upright in a noble stance.

Space Marine Sombrio.aparencia: Very tall warrior in matte black power armor with scratched grey trim and a dark visor glowing faintly red. A tattered black cloak hangs from the wide shoulders, and the stance is low and watchful.

Space Marine de Elite.aparencia: Very tall warrior in thick, decorated blue power armor with a plumed helmet and heavy shoulder plates. Bears a large bolt rifle and a combat blade, standing square with disciplined posture.

Chaos Cultist Veterano.aparencia: Ordinary human in patchwork armor and a rough hooded cowl, with a lined, hardened face and tattoos of crooked sigils across the arms. Carries a notched blade and a battered round shield.

Chaos Cultist Mutante.aparencia: Human in a ragged robe whose body is twisting: a second small arm sprouting at the ribs, patchy scaled skin, a bulging misshapen eye and bony nubs along the scalp. Hunched, clutching a rusty knife.

Chaos Cultist Exaltado.aparencia: Robed human in rich crimson and gold vestments with a tall ornate headdress, face painted with bright sigils. A faint glow gathers around the raised hand holding a curved ritual staff.

Chaos Cultist Sombrio.aparencia: Gaunt human in a deep black hooded robe with only pale hollow eyes and a thin mouth visible. Wears blackened iron spiked bracers, holds a jagged dagger low and stands half hidden in shadow.

Chaos Cultist de Elite.aparencia: Strongly built human in dark spiked plate armor with a horned helm and a heavy cloak, bearing a long cruel axe. Crooked sigils are cut into the metal, and the posture is upright and confident.

Bloodletter Veterano.aparencia: Muscular red-skinned fiend with a horned, snarling face, digitigrade legs and a thick tail. Wields a long heavy blade, wears brass armor plates, and its hide is covered in old pale scars.

Bloodletter Mutante.aparencia: Muscular red-skinned fiend with horns, but misshapen: extra horn stumps, an oversized swollen arm, patchy scales and a jaw split into two uneven halves. Drags a blade in its twisted clawed hand.

Bloodletter Exaltado.aparencia: Muscular fiend with deep crimson skin and tall swept-back horns capped in gold, standing elegantly upright. A bright glow rims its brass-and-gold armor and the long blade it holds high.

Bloodletter Sombrio.aparencia: Muscular fiend with dark maroon, nearly black skin, curved horns and smoldering orange eyes. Wisps of dark smoke trail from its shoulders as it crouches with a long dark blade.

Bloodletter de Elite.aparencia: Large, heavily muscled red fiend with swept horns, broad brass armor and a thick tail. Holds an oversized blade in both clawed hands and stands wide and tall with a stern snarl.

Plaguebearer Veterano.aparencia: Sagging, one-eyed greenish fiend with a single horn, rotting skin and a swollen paunch trailing slimy ropes of flesh. Holds a rusty bell-topped staff, with old sores and flies around it.

Plaguebearer Mutante.aparencia: Bloated green-grey fiend with a drooping horn, exposed pustules and a wet, gaping belly. Extra fleshy growths, a second drooping eye and uneven limbs make it sag lopsidedly on thin legs.

Plaguebearer Exaltado.aparencia: Round, soft-bellied fiend with pale sage skin and a single curved horn tipped with gold. Its sores are clean and healing like blossoms, and a gentle glow shines around its calm, upright form.

Plaguebearer Sombrio.aparencia: Hunched, swollen fiend with dark mossy-black skin, a lone horn and one dim yellow eye. Dripping sludge and hanging rags of flesh cling to its body, and thin black mist hovers around its feet.

Plaguebearer de Elite.aparencia: Large, wide-bellied fiend with thick, leathery grey-green hide and a strong single horn. Wears rusted heavy plates over its bulk and grips a large corroded staff firmly, standing steady.

Daemonette Veterano.aparencia: Slender, graceful fiend with pale lilac skin, long limbs and two huge crab-like claws. Its face is narrow with small horns, its hair is long and its body bears faint old scars along the arms.

Daemonette Mutante.aparencia: Slender fiend with lilac skin and crab-like claws, but one claw is oversized and another split in three. Small extra horns, a twisted spine and blotchy patches of scales make its poise unbalanced.

Daemonette Exaltado.aparencia: Slender, regal fiend with pearly pink-white skin, long limbs and delicate gilded claws. Tall curved horns, flowing silver hair and a soft glow around her give her an elegant, upright look.

Daemonette Sombrio.aparencia: Slender fiend with deep indigo, near-black skin and long limbs ending in two thin black claws. Narrow glowing magenta eyes and curved thin horns peek from long dark hair, in a low stalking posture.

Horror Veterano.aparencia: Small, hunched fiend with blue-tinged skin, a wide mouth full of crooked teeth and spindly arms with long fingers. Its body is wrinkled and scarred, and it hovers close to the floor on thin legs.

Horror Mutante.aparencia: Small blue-skinned fiend that has split and warped: two heads on one shoulder, one tiny arm and one very long, and fleshy lumps that wobble across its back. Teeth jut at odd angles from its mouths.

Horror Exaltado.aparencia: Small blue fiend with smooth, bright skin, a single clean row of teeth and long elegant fingers. A ring of pale light floats above its head, and its body shimmers faintly with pink and blue hues.

Horror Sombrio.aparencia: Small hunched fiend with ink-dark blue skin, a gaping mouth and thin long fingers. Glowing white eyes shine out of its dark face, and wisps of black vapor curl from its narrow shoulders.

Horror de Elite.aparencia: Larger, stockier blue fiend with thick, dense skin, a broad mouth of strong teeth and heavy hands with long fingers. A crest of small horns crowns its head and its stance is wide and steady.

Skaven Veterano.aparencia: Tall hunched rat-man with matted brown-grey fur, a long pink tail and a scarred snout with notched ears. Wears patched leather and a battered metal helm, carrying a rusty sword and a round shield.

Skaven Mutante.aparencia: Hunched rat-man with patchy fur and a malformed body: an extra arm growing from the chest, a bulging tumor on the shoulder and a long, crooked snout with uneven teeth. Tail is bald and knotted.

Skaven Exaltado.aparencia: Rat-man standing taller than kin, with clean cream-white fur and a pink tail, wearing a bright embroidered tabard. A pale glowing halo lingers around the head and a polished short staff is held upright.

Skaven Sombrio.aparencia: Lean rat-man with soot-black fur, a thin pink tail and glinting red eyes. Wears a dark hooded cloak and wraps, creeping bent forward with a curved knife held low behind the back.

Skaven de Elite.aparencia: Large, strongly built rat-man with glossy dark fur and thick scarred muscles. Wears heavy iron plates and a spiked helm, gripping a large halberd while standing steadily over its long tail.

Rat Ogre Veterano.aparencia: Huge hulking rat-like brute with a thick muscular torso, long arms dragging low and a heavy fanged snout. Its brown fur is patchy and scarred, with rough stitching and old metal studs on its hide.

Rat Ogre Mutante.aparencia: Huge rat-like brute with an oversized torso, one gigantic arm and one withered one, and bone spurs poking through the patchy fur. A second small snout bulges at its shoulder and its skin is blotchy.

Rat Ogre Exaltado.aparencia: Huge rat-like brute with unusually clean silvery-white fur, powerful arms and a long pink tail. Gilded rings circle its wrists and a bright glow haloes its broad shoulders and calm, heavy-jawed face.

Rat Ogre Sombrio.aparencia: Huge rat-like brute with coarse black fur, bulging muscles and a fanged snout. Its eyes glow dull red in deep sockets, and dark mist rolls off its shoulders as it lumbers forward on knuckled hands.

Rat Ogre de Elite.aparencia: Enormous rat-like brute with dense dark-brown fur, a barrel chest and thick forearms, with iron plates riveted over its shoulders and a heavy collar. Its large frame and steady stance dominate the space.

Saurus Veterano.aparencia: Muscular lizard warrior standing upright, with blue-green scaled hide, a long tail and a broad, fanged snout. Old scars mark the scales, and it wears a simple bone-and-leather harness with a stone-bladed spear.

Saurus Mutante.aparencia: Muscular upright lizard with uneven blotchy scales, spiny growths down the back and an extra misshapen claw on one arm. Jaw is lopsided with crooked fangs, and the tail ends in a bony club-like lump.

Saurus Exaltado.aparencia: Muscular upright lizard with shiny emerald scales, a tall bright crest and gold armbands. A faint golden glow rims its body, and it holds a long ornate spear with a calm and proud posture.

Saurus Sombrio.aparencia: Muscular upright lizard with dark slate-black scales, narrow yellow eyes and a long, low-slung tail. Wears dark tattered wraps and holds a black-bladed spear while crouching in a quiet, alert pose.

Saurus de Elite.aparencia: Large, thickly built upright lizard with rich blue scales, a tall bony crest and heavy gilded plate across chest and shoulders. Grips a big stone-headed spear and stands wide with a firm snarl.

Skink Veterano.aparencia: Small, slim upright lizard with bright green skin patterned in yellow spots, a long tail and a narrow head crested with a small frill. Has weathered scars, wearing a feathered band and holding a short javelin.

Skink Mutante.aparencia: Small slim lizard with patchy green skin and warty swellings, a lopsided frill and a double-jointed arm ending in too many fingers. Its spotted tail is bent, and one eye is oversized and cloudy.

Skink Exaltado.aparencia: Small, graceful upright lizard with luminous teal skin and golden spots, a wide feathered frill and fine golden bands on the limbs. A soft glow circles its narrow head as it stands tall and balanced.

Skink Sombrio.aparencia: Small, thin upright lizard with dusky blue-black skin and pale speckles, a narrow frill and sharp yellow eyes. Moves in a low crouch with a long tail curled behind, carrying a slim dark blowpipe.

Skink de Elite.aparencia: Small but wiry upright lizard with vivid green-and-orange skin, a tall frill and a sleek build. Wears a feathered headdress and small gold ornaments, standing alert with a javelin held upright.

Kroxigor Veterano.aparencia: Giant, hulking crocodile-headed brute standing on thick legs, with heavy olive-green scaly hide, a long tail and a massive toothy snout. Scarred along its jaw, it hefts a huge stone-headed hammer.

Kroxigor Mutante.aparencia: Giant crocodile-headed brute with warped scaly hide: knobbly bone growths on the back, a lopsided snout with teeth poking at odd angles and one swollen arm. Its tail is thick and uneven, eyes mismatched.

Kroxigor Exaltado.aparencia: Giant crocodile-headed brute with polished jade-green scales and gold bands on arms and brow. A pale glow lights its heavy snout and broad shoulders, and it holds a huge ornate hammer upright.

Kroxigor Sombrio.aparencia: Giant crocodile-headed brute with black-green scales that glisten like wet stone and glowing amber eyes in a heavy snout. Thick tail dragging, it hefts a giant dark hammer in a looming stance.

Kroxigor de Elite.aparencia: Enormous crocodile-headed brute with thick dark-green armor-like scales, a wide jaw and a long tail, wearing heavy gold-trimmed plates. A gigantic stone-headed hammer rests across its massive shoulders.

Slann Veterano.aparencia: Huge, squat toad-like being with wrinkled blue-green skin, a wide mouth and heavy-lidded eyes. Sits cross-legged, hunched with age, in a plain gold-trimmed headdress with a long chain of warts and creases.

Slann Mutante.aparencia: Huge squat toad-like being with blotchy, lumpy skin, an extra eye on its brow and a mouth that sags unevenly. Swollen sacs bulge along its bloated sides, and its limbs are mismatched and thin.

Slann Exaltado.aparencia: Huge squat toad-like being with smooth, luminous teal skin and calm half-lidded eyes. A tall gilded headdress crowns its head and a soft golden light radiates from its seated, serene body.

Slann Sombrio.aparencia: Huge squat toad-like being with dark indigo, glossy skin and narrow, glowing pale eyes. Sits heavy and still in a dark, tattered headdress, with slow wisps of shadow curling around its wide mouth.

Slann de Elite.aparencia: Massive squat toad-like being with thick blue-green skin, a broad jaw and heavy-lidded eyes. Seated tall in a large ornate golden headdress and wide shoulder rings, with an imposing, composed bearing.

Genestealer Veterano II.aparencia: Wiry four-armed alien with a long, ridged skull, mottled grey-purple chitin and hooked talons worn dull by use. Tough scar lines cross its thorax, and its stance is crouched, with arms held wide apart.

Skaven de Elite II.aparencia: Burly rat-man with rust-brown fur, a long scarred snout and a thick pink tail, in dark riveted breastplate with a horned helm. Carries a long chain-bladed weapon and stands with a wide, braced stance.

Ork Boy Exaltado II.aparencia: Heavyset green-skinned brute with a wide tusked jaw and a short spiky crest of hair. Wears bright plate with white-and-gold painted stripes and a pale glowing ring above its head, hefting a gleaming axe.

Kroxigor Sombrio II.aparencia: Giant crocodile-headed brute with charcoal scales, ragged dark jaw ridges and pale, cold eyes. Wears a cracked black stone collar and heavy armlets, and wades forward with a huge dark club in one fist.

Bloodletter Sombrio II.aparencia: Lean, muscular fiend with deep plum-black skin, back-swept horns and a narrow, toothy snarl. Embers glow in its chest cracks and a long jagged blade drips dark smoke as it leans forward to strike.

Chocobo Rei.aparencia: Large flightless bird with long strong legs, a long neck and plush golden-yellow plumage. A tall crest of feathers and a cape of white plumes on its back give it a stately look, with a proud upright stance.

Chocobo Ancião.aparencia: Large flightless bird with long legs and a long neck, its yellow plumage faded to pale cream and dull gold. White tufts of feather like brows and a thin beard hang by the beak, and it stands slightly stooped.

Chocobo Sombrio.aparencia: Large flightless bird with long strong legs and a long neck, covered in dark charcoal-black plumage with violet sheen. Its beady eyes glow pale, the beak is dusky and feathers are slightly ragged.

Chocobo Brilhante.aparencia: Large flightless bird with long legs and neck, with radiant pale-gold plumage that shimmers almost white. Tips of the wing and tail feathers sparkle, and a soft glow surrounds its bright, lively frame.

Moogle Comum.aparencia: Small, plump, round-bodied creature with soft white fur, tiny bat-like wings and a short pair of stubby limbs. A single red pom-pom dangles from an antenna on its head, with a small pink nose and big round eyes.

Moogle Rei.aparencia: Plump knee-high furry white creature with small bat wings, a red pom-pom on a feeler, and a tiny snout. Wears a velvet crimson cape with ermine trim and a little gold crown between its round ears.

Moogle Ancião.aparencia: Chubby white-furred creature gone gray at the muzzle, with drooping ears, stooped back and faded wings. Bushy white eyebrows hang over its eyes, and a limp pale pom-pom dangles from its head.

Moogle Sombrio.aparencia: Round plush creature with charcoal-violet fur, narrowed glowing yellow eyes and bat-like wings of dark membrane. Its pom-pom is a smoky deep purple and its small fangs show.

Moogle Brilhante.aparencia: Round fluffy creature with fur of gleaming pearl white and a faint golden glow along its edges. Its small wings shimmer like silk and its pom-pom shines bright pink-gold.

Cactuar Comum.aparencia: Slim upright green cactus body with a tall rounded head, two dot eyes and an open oval mouth, caught mid-sprint. Thin spiny arms and legs swing wide, and a few needles stick out along its flanks.

Cactuar Ancião.aparencia: Gnarled, thick-skinned cactus body in dull olive and tan, with a bent top and a few dry yellow blooms. Long pale spines hang like a beard, and its wrinkled face looks serene while it stands rooted-still.

Cactuar Sombrio.aparencia: Slender cactus body of blackish green with purple-tinged spines and hollow glowing red eyes. Its arms and legs are crooked and bristling, and a dark mist clings around its feet as it dashes.

Cactuar Brilhante.aparencia: Slender pale-lime cactus body that glows from within, with silvery spines catching the light. Its eyes are bright, and small flowers of white-gold open along the arms as it sprints with sparkles trailing.

Tonberry Comum.aparencia: Short stocky lizard-like creature in a hooded green-brown robe, with a wide flat mouth and yellow eyes. It carries a small lantern in one hand and a long kitchen knife in the other, standing upright.

Tonberry Rei.aparencia: Short stout green-skinned hooded creature wearing a tattered royal-purple robe edged in gold, with a spiked crown atop the hood. Holds a long gleaming knife and a lantern with a large glowing flame.

Tonberry Ancião.aparencia: Small hunched hooded creature with grayish moss-colored skin, deep wrinkles and a sagging wide mouth. Its robe is frayed and patched, and it leans on a gnarled staff while a dim lantern swings from one hand.

Tonberry Sombrio.aparencia: Short hooded lizard-like creature in a black robe, skin a bruised dark green, with glowing red eyes. Its lantern burns with a cold violet flame and the knife blade is long and chipped.

Tonberry Brilhante.aparencia: Short hooded creature in a white and pale-gold robe, with luminous light-green skin and gentle bright eyes. Its lantern shines warm gold and the long knife blade gleams like polished silver.

Bomb Comum.aparencia: Floating round ball of molten red and orange with a lumpy surface, a cheerful grinning mouth and two small dark eyes. A short flame flickers on its top and its edges glow like hot coals.

Bomb Rei.aparencia: Large floating sphere of glowing orange-red magma, crowned with a ring of tall flame points. Its face is stern with a wide jaw, and its crust is cracked and scorched with bright seams.

Bomb Ancião.aparencia: Floating round body of dull ember and gray ash, crusted with cooled black rock and leaking a few dim glowing cracks. Its sagging face looks tired, and thin wisps of smoke curl off its surface.

Bomb Sombrio.aparencia: Floating round body of charred black with deep crimson veins glowing in the cracks. It has a snarling jagged mouth and narrow white eyes, and its flames burn dark violet at the tip.

Bomb Brilhante.aparencia: Floating round sphere of intense yellow-white fire with a pale orange rim, nearly too bright to look at. A broad happy face glows on its surface and sparks drift outward in a halo.

Malboro Comum.aparencia: Huge bulb-shaped green plant body with a vast round mouth full of rows of teeth and a long purple tongue. Many thick tentacle-like vines wave from its top, and a few small eyes dot its upper body.

Malboro Rei.aparencia: Immense bloated plant body in mottled dark green and magenta, with a gaping toothy maw ringed by a crown of thorny, thick vines. Its tentacles are long and heavy with pods, and a stench haze hangs about.

Malboro Ancião.aparencia: Sagging, wilted bulb body of yellowish gray-green with peeling bark-like skin, a drooping maw with few worn teeth, and limp pale tentacles. Moss and fungus grow in its folds.

Malboro Sombrio.aparencia: Hulking bulb plant body in near-black green with violet blotches, a huge maw of crooked fangs dripping dark ooze, and writhing thorned tentacles. Its eyes glow sickly yellow.

Malboro Brilhante.aparencia: Large rounded bulb plant of fresh bright green with pale gold highlights and soft pink inside its wide mouth. Its tentacle vines bear tiny glowing buds, and its teeth are small, rounded and white.

Behemoth Comum.aparencia: Massive quadruped with a bulky purple-gray hide, a shaggy mane, a bulging chest, and two long curved horns on a heavy brow. Powerful clawed limbs and a thick tail with a bristling tip.

Behemoth Rei.aparencia: Enormous horned quadruped with deep violet fur, a huge flowing mane and thick armored shoulders. Its curled horns are massive and ridged, and it carries a regal head-high stance on pillar-like legs.

Behemoth Ancião.aparencia: Vast shaggy quadruped with graying fur, deeply scarred hide and long cracked horns worn smooth at the tips. Its movements are slow, its back sagging, and its pale eyes sit in a heavily wrinkled face.

Behemoth Sombrio.aparencia: Massive quadruped with jet-black fur, a smoky dark mane and curved horns of dull obsidian. Its eyes burn a dim red and its lowered head and bared fangs give it a predatory crouch.

Behemoth Brilhante.aparencia: Massive quadruped with pale cream and gold fur, a luminous mane that seems to glow, and pearly horns. Its hide shimmers softly and its broad head is held high with a calm, bright gaze.

Flan Comum.aparencia: Wobbling gelatinous blob shaped like a dome pudding, translucent yellow-green with a faintly glossy surface. It has two small dark eyes, a lipless mouth, and a slightly drooping puddle skirt around its base.

Flan Rei.aparencia: Large translucent gelatinous dome in rich amber and gold, with a thick wobbling body and a small solid crown floating in its upper mass. Its eyes are stern and a heavy puddle spreads at its base.

Flan Ancião.aparencia: Sagging gelatinous mound in cloudy pale gray-green, its surface wrinkled and slightly cracked like old pudding. Specks of debris float inside, and its two dim eyes sit low in its slumped body.

Flan Sombrio.aparencia: Wobbling gelatinous dome of murky purple-black, nearly opaque with a glossy shine and small bubbles rising inside. Two pale slit eyes glow and a thin dark drip trails from its base.

Flan Brilhante.aparencia: Clear gelatinous dome with a luminous pale-blue and white tint, glittering as light passes through it. Its eyes are bright and round, and a glassy puddle shines around its smooth wobbling base.

Ahriman Comum.aparencia: Floating spherical head dominated by one huge bulging eye with a veined yellow-red surface, a small bat-wing pair on each side, and a wide fanged mouth under the eye. Short stubby arms hang at the sides.

Ahriman Rei.aparencia: Large floating spherical body with one enormous pale eye ringed by dark heavy lids, a broad toothy grin and large leathery bat wings. A circle of small horns forms a crown on its crown-like brow.

Ahriman Ancião.aparencia: Floating round body with one clouded milky eye, drooping wrinkled lids and tattered gray bat wings. Its mouth is toothless, mostly sagging, and a few long thin hairs trail from its underside.

Ahriman Sombrio.aparencia: Floating round body of blackish purple with a single enormous eye glowing a hot red, and sharp jagged wing frames of dark membrane. Its mouth is a ragged line of dark fangs, and shadow smoke trails behind.

Ahriman Brilhante.aparencia: Floating round body of pale lavender with one big glowing golden eye and gleaming silvery bat wings. Its fanged grin looks friendly, and a soft shine outlines its smooth, rounded skin.

Coeurl Comum.aparencia: Sleek panther-like cat with a smooth gray-blue coat marked by dark spots, a flat predatory face and two long whisker-like tentacles curling from its shoulders. Its eyes are narrow, and its claws are sharp.

Coeurl Rei.aparencia: Large muscular panther-like cat with deep indigo coat and bold black spotting, a thick ruffled neck and two long thick tentacle whiskers. Heavy paws, long fangs and a proud forward-leaning stance.

Coeurl Ancião.aparencia: Lean panther-like cat with graying blue fur, faded spots and a scarred face. Its two tentacle whiskers are thin and drooping, its pale eyes cloudy, and it moves with a low, deliberate stalk.

Coeurl Sombrio.aparencia: Lean black panther-like cat with faint dark spots, burning pale-yellow eyes and long fangs bared. Its tentacle whiskers are thin and whip-like, and its claws gleam as it crouches to pounce.

Coeurl Brilhante.aparencia: Sleek panther-like cat with a pale silvery-white coat, golden spots and soft glowing amber eyes. Two long tentacle whiskers shimmer like threads of light, and its claws are polished and pearly.

Iron Giant Comum.aparencia: Towering humanoid made of riveted gray iron plates, with a blocky head, glowing narrow eyes and massive arms ending in square fists. Its legs are thick pillars and its joints show bolts and seams.

Iron Giant Rei.aparencia: Tall broad humanoid of polished dark steel trimmed with brass, with a tall helm-like head crest and wide shoulder plates. Its fists are huge and its chest has a glowing circular core.

Iron Giant Ancião.aparencia: Tall rusted humanoid of dented brown-orange iron, with moss in its seams, a bowed back and a cracked head with dim eyes. Its massive arms hang low and its joints look stiff and corroded.

Iron Giant Sombrio.aparencia: Tall humanoid of blackened iron with spiked shoulders and a narrow visor glowing red. Dark smoke leaks from its joints and its clenched fists are studded with short thorns.

Iron Giant Brilhante.aparencia: Tall humanoid of mirror-polished silver steel that gleams white, with soft blue-white light shining in its eyes and chest. Its smooth plates are clean and its heavy hands rest open.

Zu Comum.aparencia: Gigantic bird with a long curved sharp beak, a thick feathered neck, broad brown-gold wings and heavy yellow talons. Its crest is short and its eyes are small and fierce under a heavy brow.

Zu Rei.aparencia: Colossal bird with a tall crest of long golden feathers, a thick plumed neck ruff, and wide wings of deep russet and gold. Its beak is hooked and heavy, and its talons are massive.

Zu Ancião.aparencia: Huge bird with tattered gray-brown plumage, a bare wrinkled neck, thin patchy crest and ragged wide wings. Its beak is chipped, its talons knobby, and its eyes are cloudy yet sharp.

Zu Sombrio.aparencia: Gigantic dark-feathered bird with a blackish-violet plumage, spiky jagged crest and sharp hooked beak. Its eyes shine red and its wide wings have pointed, bladelike feather tips.

Zu Brilhante.aparencia: Gigantic bird with glossy white and pale gold plumage, a flowing crest and a pearly beak. Its wings catch the light like a polished sheen, and its talons are bright and clean.

Ochu Comum.aparencia: Huge walking plant with a thick green stalk body, a round toothy mouth at the top and many writhing vine tentacles. Its base is a cluster of stubby root legs and the skin is warty and slimy.

Ochu Rei.aparencia: Large thick-stalked plant with a vast circular maw full of fangs and a ring of heavy leaves like a collar. Many long tentacles bear spiked pods, and its skin is deep green with magenta spots.

Ochu Sombrio.aparencia: Huge plant monster of near-black green stalk, a wide maw with crooked purple teeth and thorny tentacles that drip dark sap. Pale glowing eyes sit amid its moldy, warty skin.

Ochu Brilhante.aparencia: Large walking plant with a bright lime stalk, a wide rounded mouth with pearly teeth and tentacle vines tipped with glowing yellow buds. Its skin is smooth and glossy, with a light dusting of pollen.

Adamantoise Comum.aparencia: Gigantic tortoise with a vast domed shell of gray rock-like plates covered in moss and boulders, thick columnar legs and a wrinkled, beaked head. Its eyes are small and slow.

Adamantoise Rei.aparencia: Colossal tortoise with a mountainous steel-gray shell studded with long crystal spikes and thick ridged plates. Its head is crowned with bony horns, and its legs are massive, scaled stone pillars.

Adamantoise Ancião.aparencia: Ancient giant tortoise with a cracked shell overgrown with trees, lichen and soil, pale thinning scales and a long wrinkled neck. Its eyes are half-closed and its pace seems nearly still.

Adamantoise Sombrio.aparencia: Gigantic tortoise with a blackened jagged shell of dark metal-like plates, purple cracks glowing along the seams, and sharp spikes. Its eyes burn dim red beneath a heavy horned brow.

Adamantoise Brilhante.aparencia: Gigantic tortoise with a pale shell of polished silver-gold plates that shine like gems, and small crystalline points along its ridges. Its scaly head is held up with calm, bright eyes.

Sahagin Comum.aparencia: Upright fish-like humanoid with blue-green scales, a finned crest, webbed clawed hands and a wide-lipped mouth with sharp teeth. It carries a trident, and its bulging eyes sit on the sides of its head.

Sahagin Rei.aparencia: Tall upright fish-like humanoid of deep teal scales, with a large spiny dorsal fin crest and a coral-and-shell crown. It carries an ornate long trident and wears a gilded breastplate of shells.

Sahagin Ancião.aparencia: Stooped fish-like humanoid with dull pale-green scales, thin ragged fins and cloudy eyes. It wears a seaweed shawl and a necklace of pebbles, and leans on a twisted driftwood staff.

Sahagin Sombrio.aparencia: Upright fish-like humanoid with dark navy scales, spiny jagged fins and glowing yellow eyes. Its teeth are long and crooked, and it grips a rusted barbed spear with blackened claws.

Sahagin Brilhante.aparencia: Upright fish-like humanoid with iridescent silver-blue scales and a translucent shimmering fin crest. Wears a belt of pearls and holds a gleaming white-gold trident with calm round eyes.

Goblin Comum.aparencia: Small green-skinned humanoid with large pointed ears, a hooked nose, yellow eyes and a toothy grin. Wears patched leather scraps and carries a crude short knife, with a slightly hunched, wiry frame.

Goblin Rei.aparencia: Short but stout green-skinned humanoid with pointed ears, a bulbous nose and a heavy jaw. Wears a rough crown of bent metal, a fur-trimmed cloak and a belt of trinkets, wielding a notched cleaver.

Goblin Ancião.aparencia: Wizened small green humanoid with long drooping ears, a bald spotted head, a wispy white beard and heavy-lidded eyes. Dressed in a ragged patched robe, it leans on a crooked bone-topped staff.

Goblin Sombrio.aparencia: Wiry dark gray-green humanoid with long ears, glowing amber eyes and sharp fangs. Dressed in a black hooded cloak and dark leather wrappings, it holds a curved dagger low in a stalking crouch.

Goblin Brilhante.aparencia: Small bright yellow-green humanoid with pointed ears, wide shining eyes and a cheerful toothy grin. Wears a polished brass cap and a light tunic with gold buttons, holding a small gleaming blade.

Mindflayer Comum.aparencia: Tall humanoid with a smooth purple-gray skin, a bulbous hairless head and four long writhing tentacles around its mouth. Its eyes are white and blank, and it wears a high-collared dark robe.

Mindflayer Rei.aparencia: Tall humanoid with a large domed head in mauve skin, six long tentacles around its mouth and pale blank eyes. It wears a high-collared royal robe of deep violet with gold trim and a jeweled circlet.

Mindflayer Ancião.aparencia: Gaunt tall humanoid with grayish wrinkled skin, a veined domed head and thin, drooping tentacles. Its eyes are clouded and sunken, and it wears a threadbare long robe and a hunched stance.

Mindflayer Sombrio.aparencia: Tall humanoid with near-black violet skin, a smooth domed head and four slick tentacles ending in thin tips. Its eyes glow cold white and it wears a tight black robe with a raised hood.

Mindflayer Brilhante.aparencia: Tall humanoid with pale pearly lavender skin, a smooth domed head and four slender tentacles that gleam. Its eyes shine soft gold, and it wears a white robe with silver embroidery.

Garuda Comum.aparencia: Humanoid-bodied bird figure with large broad wings of green and gold feathers, a hooked beak, talon feet and a crest of tall plumes. Its arms are muscular and it hovers with chest forward.

Garuda Rei.aparencia: Tall winged bird-man with a tall golden crest, a hooked beak, huge broad wings of red-gold plumage and a breastplate of bronze. Taloned feet are sharp and it holds a proud, upright posture.

Garuda Ancião.aparencia: Aged winged bird-man with dull white and gray plumage, thinning crest, a hooked beak worn at the tip and sagging wings. Its eyes are pale and heavy-lidded, and its body is lean and slightly bent.

Garuda Sombrio.aparencia: Muscular bird-man with dark charcoal and deep violet plumage, jagged crest feathers, a sharp black beak and glowing red eyes. Its wing tips are sharp and its talons look long and curved.

Garuda Brilhante.aparencia: Graceful bird-man with white and radiant gold plumage, a flowing crest and large wings that seem to glow. It has a polished beak, golden talons and a bright, calm expression.

Ifrit Comum.aparencia: Muscular horned beast-man with orange-red skin, a mane of flame, curved horns and glowing yellow eyes. His clawed hands are large, his lower body ends in fiery digitigrade legs, and he has a snarling fanged face.

Ifrit Rei.aparencia: Huge muscular horned fire-being with deep crimson skin, a flowing mane of tall flames and large swept-back horns ringed in gold. Wears heavy gold arm bands and glares with blazing eyes.

Ifrit Ancião.aparencia: Hunched horned beast-man with ashen gray-red skin, a faded mane of low embers, and cracked, worn horns. His lined face is heavy, and his arms are thick but slow, with dim glowing eyes.

Ifrit Sombrio.aparencia: Muscular horned beast-man with charred black skin, a mane of dark purple-red flame and twisted horns. Cracks in his skin glow orange, his eyes are white-hot, and his claws are long and blackened.

Ifrit Brilhante.aparencia: Muscular horned figure with bright golden-orange skin, a mane of white-yellow flame and polished pale horns. A radiant glow surrounds him and his eyes blaze bright, with an upright regal stance.

Shiva Comum.aparencia: Slender woman-shaped figure with pale blue skin, long icy-blue hair and a form of frosted crystal. Her eyes are calm and she wears a close-fitting blue outfit, with a faint cold mist around her limbs.

Shiva Rei.aparencia: Tall slender woman-shaped figure with pale blue skin, long flowing silver-white hair and a tall crown of ice crystals. Wears a flowing gown of frost and a long train of drifting snow.

Shiva Sombrio.aparencia: Slender woman-shaped figure with dusky blue-gray skin, long dark indigo hair and sharp shards of black ice along her shoulders. Her eyes glow pale, and a cold dark mist trails her feet.

Shiva Brilhante.aparencia: Slender woman-shaped figure with luminous pale blue-white skin, long glittering silver hair and a form that shimmers like clean glass. Delicate crystals sparkle at her shoulders and her eyes are bright.

Bahamut Comum.aparencia: Huge four-limbed dragon with dark gray-blue scales, a broad horned head, a spiked ridge along its back and large bat-like wings. Its jaws are wide and its tail is long and heavy.

Bahamut Rei.aparencia: Enormous dragon with deep navy and silver scales, a crown of long swept horns, massive wings with long finger bones and a broad armored chest. Its heavy jaws and thick tail suggest great weight.

Bahamut Ancião.aparencia: Vast old dragon with cracked, dull gray scales, chipped horns, a scarred muzzle and torn wing membranes. Its eyes are milky, its spine is bowed, and moss grows in the cracks of its hide.

Bahamut Sombrio.aparencia: Huge dragon with black scales edged in purple, a sharp spiked ridge, curved dark horns and wide, tattered wings. Its eyes glow red and its jaws drip with dark smoke over long fangs.

Bahamut Brilhante.aparencia: Huge dragon with gleaming white and pale gold scales, smooth swept-back horns and wide wings with glowing membranes. Its eyes are bright blue and its armored chest looks polished and pearly.

Poring Selvagem.aparencia: Small round pink jelly blob with a smooth glossy surface, two big black dot eyes, a tiny curved smile and a little droplet-shaped tip on top. It sits low and squishy on the ground.

Poring Mutante.aparencia: Small round jelly blob with blotchy green and purple skin, uneven lumps, mismatched dark eyes and a crooked mouth with a few small teeth. A bulge droops off one side of its body.

Poring Filhote.aparencia: Tiny round pale-pink jelly blob with an oversized glossy head, huge shining dot eyes and a very small smile. Its body is soft and rounded with a small drop on top, even smaller than its kin.

Poring Chefe.aparencia: Very large round pink jelly blob with a thick glossy body, narrowed dark eyes and a wide determined grin. A pair of short spikes rise from its top and its base spreads wide and heavy.

Poring Sagrado.aparencia: A small round pink jelly blob with a glossy translucent body, two black dot eyes and a tiny smile, bathed in a soft white-gold shimmer with a faint glowing ring floating above it.

Lunatic Selvagem.aparencia: A plump round white rabbit-like creature with thick fluffy fur, long drooping ears, small black eyes and a tiny pink nose, sitting upright on stubby hind legs.

Lunatic Mutante.aparencia: A round fluffy rabbit with patchy fur in sickly green and white, one ear swollen and lumpy, a third misaligned eye on its cheek and uneven oversized teeth.

Lunatic Filhote.aparencia: A tiny soft white bunny with an oversized head, short stubby ears, big shiny eyes and a puffball body barely larger than a loaf of bread.

Lunatic Chefe.aparencia: A hulking, heavily muscled rabbit-like beast with thick shaggy white fur, a scarred muzzle, torn ear tips, broad shoulders and narrowed red eyes.

Lunatic Sagrado.aparencia: A fluffy round rabbit with pearly white fur edged in gold, long ears glowing softly, a small halo-like ring of light above its head and calm pale eyes.

Fabre Selvagem.aparencia: A chubby green caterpillar larva with a segmented rounded body, a tiny face with small dark eyes, little stub feet and a smooth glossy skin.

Fabre Mutante.aparencia: A bloated caterpillar with blotchy purple-green skin, uneven body segments, extra tiny legs sprouting along its flank and mismatched bulging eyes.

Fabre Filhote.aparencia: A very small pale-green larva with a big round head, wide dot eyes and a short stubby segmented body, tiny enough to rest on a leaf.

Fabre Chefe.aparencia: An oversized caterpillar with thick armored plating over its segments, dark ridged skin, strong blunt mandibles and a scarred, wide head.

Fabre Sagrado.aparencia: A plump pale larva with a pearly white-gold body, faintly glowing segment lines, soft round eyes and a gentle light ring floating over its head.

Pupa Selvagem.aparencia: A stiff oval chrysalis with a hard glossy yellow-brown shell, ridged along its length, with two small closed-looking eyes and no visible limbs.

Pupa Mutante.aparencia: A lumpy cocoon with cracked, discolored sickly shell, tumorous bulges along its sides, a split seam oozing dark fluid and uneven eyes.

Pupa Filhote.aparencia: A small smooth egg-shaped chrysalis, pale cream with a soft shell and two big sleepy eyes, noticeably tiny and rounded.

Pupa Chefe.aparencia: A large armored chrysalis with a thick dark ridged shell, rough scarred plating, heavy bulk and two narrow glaring eyes.

Pupa Sagrado.aparencia: A smooth chrysalis with a pearly ivory shell traced by thin golden lines, a soft glow leaking from its seams and a faint halo above.

Chonchon Selvagem.aparencia: A small fly-like insect with a rounded yellow-green body, big compound eyes, a short stinger tail and two translucent blurred wings.

Chonchon Mutante.aparencia: A fly with a swollen blotchy body, mismatched wings of different sizes, a third wing stub, bulging uneven eyes and a dripping crooked stinger.

Chonchon Filhote.aparencia: A tiny round fly with a big head, huge shiny eyes, a short stubby tail and small fluttering wings too small for its body.

Chonchon Chefe.aparencia: A large, thick-bodied fly with dark armored segments, heavy scarred wings, a long thick stinger and large glaring red eyes.

Chonchon Sagrado.aparencia: A fly-like insect with a pale gold body, glowing translucent wings edged in white light, calm round eyes and a small halo above its head.

Willow Selvagem.aparencia: A short walking tree stump with gnarled bark skin, twisted branch arms sprouting green leaves, a hollow knothole face with dim glowing eyes and root feet.

Willow Mutante.aparencia: A warped tree creature with blackened bark, branches growing in wrong directions, fungal growths, withered sickly leaves and several uneven knothole eyes.

Willow Chefe.aparencia: A large ancient tree creature with thick scarred bark, heavy gnarled limbs, deep roots as legs, a thick crown of dark leaves and a deep angry hollow face.

Willow Sagrado.aparencia: A small tree creature with pale silvery bark, branches bearing white blossoms, a gentle knothole face and a soft golden glow circling its crown.

Roda Frog Selvagem.aparencia: A round green frog with a wide mouth, bulging eyes, smooth damp skin, folded back legs and a pale yellow belly.

Roda Frog Mutante.aparencia: A bloated frog with warty purple-green skin, an extra leg growing from its flank, mismatched bulging eyes and an oversized crooked mouth.

Roda Frog Filhote.aparencia: A tiny froglet with a big head, huge round eyes, soft bright-green skin and short thin limbs, like a chubby tadpole with legs.

Roda Frog Chefe.aparencia: A large heavy frog with thick dark-green warty skin, a broad scarred head, powerful hind legs and a wide jaw with a thick throat sac.

Roda Frog Sagrado.aparencia: A smooth frog with pale pearly skin dotted by gold speckles, calm bright eyes, a faint glow on its back and a small halo above its head.

Spore Selvagem.aparencia: A chubby mushroom creature with a round red-orange cap spotted in white, a stout cream body, small stubby feet and two dark round eyes.

Spore Mutante.aparencia: A lopsided mushroom with a mottled sickly cap, drooping lumpy growths, bulging mismatched eyes and dripping dark spores around a swollen stalk.

Spore Filhote.aparencia: A tiny mushroom sprite with a small pale cap too big for its body, a tiny stalk, huge round eyes and little stubby feet.

Spore Chefe.aparencia: A big thick-stalked mushroom with a dark, scarred broad cap, bulky arms, heavy stubby legs and a stern scowling face.

Spore Sagrado.aparencia: A plump mushroom with a pearly white cap flecked with gold, a glowing cream body, gentle eyes and a soft light ring above its cap.

Peco Peco Selvagem.aparencia: A tall flightless bird with a round yellow-feathered body, long strong scaly legs, small stubby wings, a pointed orange beak and a crest of feathers.

Peco Peco Mutante.aparencia: A flightless bird with patchy molting feathers in sickly colors, a bent oversized beak, three-toed uneven legs, a lumpy neck and mismatched eyes.

Peco Peco Filhote.aparencia: A small fluffy yellow chick with a big round head, short stubby legs, tiny wings and a little orange beak, standing wobbly.

Peco Peco Chefe.aparencia: A large powerful flightless bird with thick muscular legs, dense dark-gold plumage, a heavy hooked beak, scarred face and sharp talons.

Peco Peco Sagrado.aparencia: A tall flightless bird with glossy white-gold feathers, long slender legs, a graceful feathered crest and a faint glow around its small wings.

Wolf Selvagem.aparencia: A lean wolf with grey fur, a thick blue mane around the neck, sharp pointed ears, a long muzzle and a bushy tail, standing in a low alert stance.

Wolf Mutante.aparencia: A gaunt wolf with patchy mange, bulging misshapen muscles, an extra eye on its brow, overgrown jagged fangs and a limp, uneven mane.

Wolf Filhote.aparencia: A small round wolf pup with soft grey fuzz, a short blue tuft of mane, oversized paws, big ears and a stubby tail.

Wolf Chefe.aparencia: A large broad-shouldered wolf with dark grey fur, a thick bristling blue mane, scarred snout, heavy paws and long fangs.

Wolf Sagrado.aparencia: A lean wolf with silvery-white fur, a glowing pale blue mane, calm golden eyes and fine light-colored markings along its shoulders.

Smokie Selvagem.aparencia: A chubby raccoon-like animal with brown fur, a dark eye mask, a ringed bushy tail and a green leaf resting on top of its head.

Smokie Mutante.aparencia: A raccoon with matted, patchy fur, a lumpy face, mismatched eyes, a split ringed tail with two tips and a wilted blackened leaf on its head.

Smokie Filhote.aparencia: A tiny round raccoon cub with fuzzy brown fur, a big head, large dark-masked eyes, a short striped tail and a small leaf on its head.

Smokie Chefe.aparencia: A large stocky raccoon with thick dark fur, a heavy scarred face, broad paws with long claws, a big banded tail and a large leaf crown.

Smokie Sagrado.aparencia: A plump raccoon with soft cream-white fur, golden ringed tail, gentle eyes and a glowing green leaf with a faint halo of light above it.

Yoyo Selvagem.aparencia: A small pink monkey with short fur, a pale round face, long arms, a curled tail and bright wide-set eyes, crouched ready to leap.

Yoyo Mutante.aparencia: A monkey with blotchy pink and grey fur, one arm much longer than the other, a lopsided face with extra teeth and a twisted, knobbly tail.

Yoyo Filhote.aparencia: A tiny pink monkey baby with a big round head, huge eyes, tiny hands, short limbs and a little curly tail.

Yoyo Chefe.aparencia: A big muscular pink-furred monkey with a broad chest, heavy arms, a scarred brow, bared canines and a thick tail.

Yoyo Sagrado.aparencia: A slender monkey with soft cream-pink fur, golden tips on its tail, calm bright eyes and a faint glowing ring above its head.

Orc Warrior Selvagem.aparencia: A tall green-skinned brute with a heavy jaw and lower tusks, a broad hunched frame, thick arms, a crude iron axe, leather straps and a fur-lined belt.

Orc Warrior Mutante.aparencia: A hulking green orc with uneven swollen limbs, a lumpy bald head, an extra tusk, patchy sickly skin and rusted bolted-on shoulder plates.

Orc Warrior Filhote.aparencia: A small green orc child with a big head, tiny tusks, round belly, thin arms and an oversized wooden club dragging beside it.

Orc Warrior Sagrado.aparencia: A tall green orc with white-gold painted bands on its skin, polished steel chest plate, a gleaming axe and a pale glow around its head.

Gargoyle Selvagem.aparencia: A bat-winged stone-grey creature with a hunched body, clawed hands and feet, pointed horns, a fanged beaked face and leathery spread wings.

Gargoyle Mutante.aparencia: A cracked stone-skinned bat creature with mismatched wings, extra horns growing from its shoulders, a lopsided grin and sickly green stains over its body.

Gargoyle Filhote.aparencia: A small stubby grey stone bat creature with a big round head, tiny horns, stumpy wings, chubby limbs and wide round eyes.

Gargoyle Chefe.aparencia: A massive dark stone gargoyle with thick craggy hide, heavy broad wings, long curved horns, large claws and a deeply scarred snarling face.

Gargoyle Sagrado.aparencia: A bat-winged creature carved from pale white marble, with golden veins in its stone, soft glowing eyes and a faint halo above its horns.

Baphomet Selvagem.aparencia: A tall horned goat-headed demon with dark fur, large curved horns, glowing red eyes, a muscular torso and a huge scythe held in clawed hands.

Baphomet Mutante.aparencia: A goat-headed fiend with uneven horns of different lengths, mottled sickly skin, an extra arm sprouting from its ribs and twisted clawed fingers.

Baphomet Filhote.aparencia: A small goat-headed imp with tiny curved horns, a big round head, stubby limbs, a small tail and a child-sized scythe held in both hands.

Baphomet Chefe.aparencia: A towering goat-headed demon with massive ram horns, thick dark armor-like hide, a battle-scarred face and a giant jagged scythe.

Baphomet Sagrado.aparencia: A tall goat-headed figure with white fur and pale golden horns, glowing white eyes, a shining silver scythe and a thin ring of light behind its head.

Dark Lord Selvagem.aparencia: A tall gaunt demon king in dark flowing robes with a pointed hat and cape, a pale skull-like face, glowing red eyes and a long staff.

Dark Lord Mutante.aparencia: A warped demon in tattered dark robes, an elongated skull face with extra eyes, uneven bony limbs, clawed hands and a crooked broken staff.

Dark Lord Filhote.aparencia: A small round demon child wearing an oversized dark cape and pointed hat, a pale round face, glowing red eyes and tiny hands holding a short stick.

Dark Lord Chefe.aparencia: A huge demon king in heavy black spiked armor with a long cape, a crown of horns, a scarred ghostly face and a tall jagged staff.

Dark Lord Sagrado.aparencia: A tall demon in white and violet robes trimmed in gold, a pale face with softly glowing eyes, a luminous crown ring and a long silver staff.

Doppelganger Selvagem.aparencia: A ghostly humanoid shape with a smooth grey body, hollow dark eyes, a stretched grin, thin arms ending in blade-like fingers and a trailing misty lower body.

Doppelganger Mutante.aparencia: A distorted ghostly figure with a split body, two overlapping faces, long uneven arms of different lengths and a melting, dripping grey form.

Doppelganger Filhote.aparencia: A small smoky grey ghostly figure with a big round blank head, hollow eyes, a tiny grin, stubby arms and a wispy tail instead of legs.
