Doppelganger Chefe.aparencia: A tall dark ghostly figure with a thick shadowy body, a wide jagged grin, long sharp blade-like arms and a faint crown of dark horns.

Doppelganger Sagrado.aparencia: A pale ghostly figure with a smooth white body, hollow glowing eyes, a gentle thin smile, slim hands and a misty gold-edged lower body.

Eddga Selvagem.aparencia: A huge old tiger with orange fur and black stripes, a broad scarred face, a long wispy mustache, heavy paws and a thick tail.

Eddga Mutante.aparencia: A gaunt tiger with mottled orange and sickly green fur, an extra set of fangs, lumpy swollen shoulders, uneven stripes and a split tail.

Eddga Filhote.aparencia: A tiny tiger cub with a round orange body, bold thin stripes, a big head, oversized paws, round ears and a short tail.

Eddga Chefe.aparencia: A giant muscular tiger with dark-striped fur, a mane-like ruff, deep battle scars across its face, long fangs and enormous claws.

Eddga Sagrado.aparencia: A tall tiger with white-gold fur and pale stripes, calm glowing amber eyes, a soft light along its back and a faint ring above its head.

Maya Selvagem.aparencia: A giant queen ant with a dark glossy exoskeleton, a huge swollen abdomen, long jointed legs, curved mandibles and thin antennae with a small crown-like crest.

Maya Mutante.aparencia: A large ant queen with a lumpy discolored shell, uneven mandibles, extra legs, a cracked swollen abdomen and mismatched bulging eyes.

Maya Filhote.aparencia: A small, soft-bodied ant with a big round head, short antennae, tiny mandibles, a plump pale-brown abdomen and thin little legs.

Maya Chefe.aparencia: A massive armored queen ant with thick black plates, large sawtooth mandibles, a huge abdomen, long spiked legs and a scarred head crest.

Maya Sagrado.aparencia: A giant ant with a pearly white and gold exoskeleton, a glowing swollen abdomen, graceful long legs, slim mandibles and a soft light crown over its head.

Phreeoni Selvagem.aparencia: A large lizard-like monster with a thick green body, a huge head dominated by a long pink tongue hanging from its wide mouth, strong legs and a heavy tail.

Phreeoni Mutante.aparencia: A bloated lizard-like beast with blotchy purple-green skin, a forked and overgrown tongue, mismatched eyes, an extra stubby limb and a lumpy tail.

Phreeoni Chefe.aparencia: A massive armored reptilian brute with dark thick scales, a scarred broad head, a very long heavy tongue, thick legs and a spiked tail.

Phreeoni Sagrado.aparencia: A large lizard-like creature with pale pearly scales edged in gold, a long soft pink tongue, calm bright eyes and a faint glow ring above its head.

Osiris Selvagem.aparencia: A tall mummified sphinx-like king with a lion body wrapped in aged bandages, a pharaoh headdress, a gaunt dark face and glowing eyes.

Osiris Mutante.aparencia: A decaying mummy lion with torn dripping bandages, exposed bone, an asymmetric twisted headdress, an extra jaw and uneven rotting limbs.

Osiris Filhote.aparencia: A small bandaged lion cub mummy with a tiny striped headdress too big for its head, round hollow eyes and short stubby paws.

Osiris Chefe.aparencia: A giant mummified sphinx with thick tattered wraps, a heavy golden headdress and collar, deep cracked scars, large clawed paws and burning eyes.

Osiris Sagrado.aparencia: A tall sphinx-like mummy in clean white wrappings with a gleaming gold headdress, a calm pale face, a sun disk glowing behind its head and gold-tipped claws.

Lamball Alpha.aparencia: A round fluffy white sheep-like creature with a cloud of wool, tiny hooves, short curled horns, stubby ears and a larger, more imposing body than its kin.

Lamball Brilhante.aparencia: A round fluffy sheep-like creature with a shimmering iridescent wool coat, tiny hooves, small curled horns, stubby ears and sparkling points of light on its fleece.

Lamball Gigante.aparencia: Enormous round sheep-ball taller than a house, buried in thick pink-white wool, with tiny stubby hooves, small floppy ears and a sleepy, placid face.

Lamball Sombrio.aparencia: Round sheep-ball with wool turned charcoal and violet, eyes glowing dim red, stubby legs half hidden in a drifting dark haze at its fleece edges.

Lamball Elemental.aparencia: Round, fluffy sheep-ball whose wool shimmers in swirling pastel bands, with a few glowing motes drifting off the fleece and bright curious eyes.

Cattiva Alpha.aparencia: Stocky orange cat-like creature, larger than its kin, with a thick ruff, a notched ear, broad shoulders and a hard, dominant stare.

Cattiva Brilhante.aparencia: Small round orange-furred cat-like creature recolored in glossy pale gold and cream, with tall tufted ears, big eyes and a plump belly.

Cattiva Gigante.aparencia: Hulking orange cat-like beast the size of a bear, with a massive round head, thick tufted ears, heavy paws and a placid half-lidded gaze.

Cattiva Sombrio.aparencia: Cat-like creature with dull blackish-purple fur, ears slightly tattered, narrow glowing yellow eyes and a hunched, prowling stance.

Cattiva Elemental.aparencia: Orange cat-like creature with fur streaked in iridescent colors, small crystal-like sparkles along its ear tufts and tail, eyes bright and wide.

Chikipi Alpha.aparencia: Tiny yellow chick grown sturdy, with a ruffled crest of feathers, thick scratching feet, a sharp small beak and a puffed-out chest.

Chikipi Brilhante.aparencia: Fluffy round chick with feathers glossy pale blue-white instead of yellow, tiny orange beak, thin legs and a plump downy body.

Chikipi Gigante.aparencia: Colossal downy yellow chick towering over trees, with a round feather-ball body, small wings, thick pillar legs and a tiny beady-eyed head.

Chikipi Sombrio.aparencia: Round chick with dingy gray-black down, ragged tuft on its head, glowing red eyes and a dark beak, shadowy wisps clinging to its feathers.

Chikipi Elemental.aparencia: Round downy chick with feathers shifting between teal and gold, a faint glowing ring above its head and sparkling motes drifting around it.

Lifmunk Alpha.aparencia: Muscular squirrel-like creature with a big leafy sprout on its head, thick forearms, a scarred cheek and a bushy tail bristling upright.

Lifmunk Brilhante.aparencia: Small squirrel-like creature with golden-cream fur and a bright pink-leafed sprout on its head, large eyes and a fluffy curled tail.

Lifmunk Gigante.aparencia: Giant squirrel-like beast with a whole leafy bush growing from its head, a tail like a shaggy tree trunk and broad furry limbs.

Lifmunk Sombrio.aparencia: Squirrel-like creature with dark gray fur, wilted blackened leaves on its head, hollow glowing eyes and a frayed, limp tail.

Lifmunk Elemental.aparencia: Squirrel-like creature with a glowing prismatic leaf on its head, fur dusted with shimmering sparkles and a tail ending in a soft gem-bright glow.

Foxparks Alpha.aparencia: Large red-orange fox with a blazing flame-tipped tail, thick neck mane, singed scars across the muzzle and a broad aggressive stance.

Foxparks Brilhante.aparencia: Small fox with pale lavender-white fur, a bright blue flame burning at its tail tip, tall pointed ears and an alert bushy-tailed posture.

Foxparks Gigante.aparencia: Wolf-sized monstrous fox with a huge roaring tail flame, heavy paws, thick orange fur and a towering, broad-chested frame.

Foxparks Sombrio.aparencia: Fox with sooty black fur, ember-red eyes, a tail burning with dim violet flame and long dark smoke trailing from its back.

Foxparks Elemental.aparencia: Fox with fur fading from orange to cyan, a tail flame of swirling multicolored light and small floating sparks around its paws.

Fuack Alpha.aparencia: Heavyset blue duck-like creature with a scarred bill, thick webbed feet, ruffled head crest and a stern squared-off stance.

Fuack Brilhante.aparencia: Small duck-like creature with glossy teal-silver feathers, an orange bill, webbed feet and a rounded cheerful body.

Fuack Gigante.aparencia: Colossal blue duck-like creature, tall as a house, with a wide flat bill, massive webbed feet and a barrel-shaped body.

Fuack Sombrio.aparencia: Duck-like creature with murky blue-black feathers, a dull bill, bloodshot yellow eyes and damp feathers dripping dark water.

Fuack Elemental.aparencia: Duck-like creature with translucent shimmering blue feathers, small water droplets orbiting its body and a faintly glowing bill.

Sparkit Brilhante.aparencia: Tiny rodent-like creature with silvery-white fur, pale golden spiky tufts, a zigzag tail and big bright eyes.

Sparkit Gigante.aparencia: Giant rodent-like beast with thick yellow fur, spiky crackling tufts along its back, a jagged tail like a lightning bolt and heavy paws.

Sparkit Sombrio.aparencia: Rodent-like creature with dusky purple-black fur, dim spiky tufts, a drooping zigzag tail and glowing pale eyes.

Sparkit Elemental.aparencia: Rodent-like creature with yellow fur that fades into iridescent hues, a tail of crystalline zigzags and tiny arcs of light between its spikes.

Tanzee Alpha.aparencia: Powerfully built monkey with long thick arms, a heavy brow, leafy bands wrapped around its wrists, scarred chest and a knuckle-walking stance.

Tanzee Brilhante.aparencia: Slender monkey with pale golden fur, a creamy face, long agile limbs, a curled tail and bright mischievous eyes.

Ciclope Celeste.aparencia: Tall one-eyed giant with pale, almost white skin, a single bright blue eye and long silver-white hair. He wears a clean linen tunic with a gold belt.

Ciclope Ancião.aparencia: Huge aged one-eyed giant with wrinkled grey skin, a long white beard and a milky eye. Hunched, heavily muscled and leaning on a thick rough staff.

Ciclope Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Lumpy one-eyed giant with greenish blotchy skin, a bulging bloodshot eye and a crooked jaw with broken teeth. Sores and warts cover his torso and he stoops forward.

Hidra de Fogo.aparencia: Multi-headed water serpent with deep red scales and glowing orange throats. Each of its many necks ends in a fanged head, and smoke leaks from the mouths.

Hidra das Sombras.aparencia: Many-necked serpentine monster with black scales, a few violet stripes and thin glowing eyes. The heads sway low over murky water, hungry and silent.

Hidra Celeste.aparencia: Multi-necked serpent with shimmering white and pale blue scales and a soft starry gleam. Its heads are slender and calm, with golden eyes.

Hidra Ancião.aparencia: Giant multi-headed serpent with dull grey-green scales and scarred, drooping necks. Some heads are blind and pale, and thick moss grows along its back.

Hidra Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Multi-headed serpent with sick yellow-green scales, weeping sores and swollen necks. A few of its heads hang limp with sunken eyes and dripping fangs.

Fênix de Fogo.aparencia: Large bird with blazing red, orange and gold plumage, a long trailing tail of flame-like feathers and a sharp curved beak. Its eyes glow amber.

Fênix das Sombras.aparencia: Large bird with dark charcoal feathers and ember-red underlights, long tail plumes like smoldering ash and glowing pale eyes. It perches low and watchful.

Fênix Celeste.aparencia: Elegant bird with pearly white and soft sky-blue plumage, long trailing tail feathers tipped in gold and a gentle bright eye. Wings are broad and radiant.

Fênix Ancião.aparencia: Aged bird with dull ember-grey plumage, patchy feathers and a long, thin neck. Its tail feathers are faded and faintly glowing, with a heavy-lidded gaze.

Fênix Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Bird with mangy, half-burnt feathers in sickly orange and black, exposed bone along one wing and a cracked beak. Its eyes are clouded and its neck twisted.

Unicórnio de Fogo.aparencia: White horse with a single spiraling horn, a flame-red mane and tail, and glowing orange hooves. Its coat is warm cream, and it carries its head high.

Unicórnio das Sombras.aparencia: Slender black horse with a long twisted horn, a silver-violet mane and narrow glowing eyes. Its coat has a faint dusky sheen and it stands motionless.

Unicórnio Ancião.aparencia: Elderly horse with a dull grey-white coat, a long thin horn with worn grooves and a sparse, flowing mane. Its sagging frame is gaunt but dignified.

Unicórnio Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Horse with a patchy mottled coat in grey-green, a cracked and crooked horn and sunken, bloodshot eyes. Ribs show and the mane hangs in dirty clumps.

Pégaso de Fogo.aparencia: Winged horse with a rich chestnut coat, a flaming mane and tail, and feathered wings with ember-orange tips. Hooves glimmer like hot coals.

Pégaso das Sombras.aparencia: Black winged horse with smoky wings, a dark grey mane and glowing pale eyes. Its feathers look like soot and its body is lean and muscular.

Pégaso Celeste.aparencia: Pure white winged horse with large, feathered wings tipped in pale blue and a silky silver-blond mane. It stands elegant and bright-eyed.

Pégaso Ancião.aparencia: Old winged horse with a grey, dappled coat, a sagging back and worn, ragged wing feathers. Its mane is thin and white, and it moves with a patient stoop.

Pégaso Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Winged horse with a sickly mottled coat, ragged half-bare wings and visible ribs. Its eyes are bloodshot and its mane hangs matted and dark.

Sereia de Fogo.aparencia: Upper half of a woman with copper-red hair and a tail of scales in orange and gold. Glowing eyes, ember-colored fins and warm-toned skin.

Sereia das Sombras.aparencia: Pale half-woman with long black hair and a dark teal fish tail with fine spines. Narrow eyes, sharp teeth and slim, clawed hands.

Sereia Celeste.aparencia: Half-woman with flowing silvery-blond hair and a pearly tail shimmering in white and aqua. Tall, graceful and fin-edged with delicate shell jewelry.

Sereia Ancião.aparencia: Old half-woman with long white hair, wrinkled grey-blue skin and a dull, scarred tail. Barnacles cling to her fins and she wears a rough net shawl.

Sereia Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Gaunt half-woman with tangled green hair, sallow skin with sores and a ragged, rotting tail. Sunken eyes, sharp teeth and webbed, clawed fingers.

Kraken de Fogo.aparencia: Enormous tentacled sea monster with a red-orange bulbous head and glowing crimson eyes. Its suckered arms are thick and it steams where it touches water.

Kraken das Sombras.aparencia: Enormous squid-like monster with ink-black skin, faint violet markings and a single glowing eye. Its long tentacles are lined with sharp hooks.

Kraken Celeste.aparencia: Giant squid-like creature with pale, translucent blue-white skin and glowing bioluminescent spots. Its many arms flow gracefully and its large eyes are gold.

Kraken Ancião.aparencia: Vast old squid-like monster with scarred grey skin, barnacles on its head and a few broken tentacles. Its huge eye is cloudy and its body looks heavy.

Kraken Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Squid-like sea horror with sickly green skin, rotting patches and dangling tentacles dotted with sores. Its eyes are dull and bloodshot, and kelp clings to its body.

Górgona de Fogo.aparencia: Woman with hair of coiling red-orange snakes, scaly copper skin and glowing eyes. She wears a scorched dark robe and her fingers end in sharp claws.

Górgona das Sombras.aparencia: Pale woman with a crown of black snakes, sunken cheeks and glowing violet eyes. Wears a ragged dark cloak and has thin, clawed hands.

Górgona Celeste.aparencia: Woman with hair of pale gold and white snakes, smooth stone-pale skin and bright blue eyes. She wears a long white robe and a calm, still posture.

Górgona Ancião.aparencia: Old woman with grey, thin snakes for hair, deeply wrinkled stony skin and cloudy eyes. Hunched, wrapped in a dull cloak, and leaning on a rough staff.

Górgona Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Gaunt woman with sickly green snakes for hair, patchy rotting skin and bulging bloodshot eyes. Long jagged claws, tattered clothes and a twisted spine.

Cérbero de Fogo.aparencia: Three-headed dog with a black coat and glowing orange eyes, flames licking from three jaws. Thick muscular body and a spiked, snake-like tail.

Cérbero das Sombras.aparencia: Giant three-headed hound with a coat of deep black shadow, pale glowing eyes and long fangs. Stands low and massive, with spines along its back.

Cérbero Celeste.aparencia: Three-headed dog with a cream-white coat, gentle golden eyes and a thick fluffy mane. Sturdy and calm, with a bright plume of a tail.

Cérbero Ancião.aparencia: Old three-headed hound with a grizzled grey coat, a grey muzzle on each head and cloudy eyes. Heavy, scarred and slow, with a drooping tail.

Cérbero Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Three-headed hound with mangy patchy fur, exposed ribs and sores. Each head drools with yellowed fangs and bloodshot eyes, and the tail is bony.

Basilisco de Fogo.aparencia: Small serpent-like reptile with a rooster-like crest, red-orange scales and burning yellow eyes. Smoke trails from its mouth and its scales glow at the edges.

Basilisco das Sombras.aparencia: Long black serpent with a bony crest, narrow glowing green eyes and a hooked fanged mouth. Its scales are glossy and its body coils low.

Basilisco Celeste.aparencia: Slim serpent with pearly white scales, a small golden crest and bright, calm eyes. Pale blue stripes run down its body and it holds its head upright.

Basilisco Ancião.aparencia: Huge old serpent with dull grey-brown scales, a ragged crest and cloudy eyes. Moss and cracks cover its thick, coiled body.

Basilisco Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Serpentine reptile with sickly green-yellow scales, weeping sores and a bent, broken crest. Its eyes are bulging and its mouth drips thick slime.

Manticora de Fogo.aparencia: Lion-bodied beast with a human-like face, red-orange fur, bat-like wings and a tail bristling with spines. Glowing eyes and a mouth full of sharp teeth.

Manticora das Sombras.aparencia: Lean dark lion-bodied beast with a grim face, bat wings and a scorpion-like spiked tail. Black fur, narrow glowing eyes, crouched in a hunting pose.

Manticora Celeste.aparencia: Lion-bodied beast with cream-white fur, feathered pale wings and a serene face. Its tail carries soft, spike-like golden plumes and its eyes are blue.

Manticora Ancião.aparencia: Heavy old lion-bodied beast with grizzled grey fur, a worn human-like face and torn wings. Tail spines are dull and chipped and the gait is slow.

Manticora Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Lion-bodied beast with mottled mangy fur, a distorted face with too many teeth and tattered wings. Its tail drips with swollen, oozing spines.

Esfinge de Fogo.aparencia: Lion-bodied creature with a human head, sandy fur, a long red-orange mane and large feathered wings. Smoldering eyes and sun-baked golden claws.

Esfinge das Sombras.aparencia: Dark-furred lion-bodied sphinx-like creature with a narrow human face, black feathered wings and glowing pale eyes. Lies in a sleek, motionless crouch.

Esfinge Celeste.aparencia: Lion-bodied creature with a serene human face, golden-white fur and broad feathered wings. A pale headdress-like mane frames its bright calm eyes.

Esfinge Ancião.aparencia: Ancient lion-bodied creature with a weathered, cracked stone-like face, dull sandy fur and worn, grey wings. Heavy, lying still like a weathered statue.

Esfinge Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Lion-bodied creature with a gaunt human face, sickly mottled fur and ragged ruined wings. Eyes are hollow and bloodshot, and its jaw hangs crooked.

Yeti de Fogo.aparencia: Enormous shaggy ape-like giant with fur fading from white to rust red, glowing orange eyes and big, calloused hands. Steam rises from its shoulders.

Yeti das Sombras.aparencia: Large shaggy ape-like creature with dark grey-black fur, narrow glowing eyes and long arms with sharp, curved claws. It hunches in the shadows.

Yeti Celeste.aparencia: Tall shaggy ape-like giant with thick snow-white fur, pale blue eyes and a peaceful flat face. Broad shoulders and long, strong arms.

Yeti Ancião.aparencia: Huge old ape-like giant with grey-white matted fur, a deeply lined face and cloudy eyes. Stooped, with long arms dragging near the ground.

Yeti Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Ape-like giant with patchy, dirty fur, visible sores, a sagging jaw and bloodshot eyes. Long arms dangle with ragged claws and its back is twisted.

Lobisomem de Fogo.aparencia: Wolf-like humanoid with russet-red fur, glowing orange eyes and ember-colored claws. Tall and muscular, with a long snout and a bristling mane.

Lobisomem das Sombras.aparencia: Lean wolf-headed beast with black fur, pale glowing eyes and long claws. It stands upright, crouched low and hungry-looking.

Lobisomem Celeste.aparencia: Wolf-headed humanoid with silver-white fur, calm blue eyes and a thick mane. Tall, strong and graceful, with a tail like a pale plume.

Lobisomem Ancião.aparencia: Old wolf-like beast with grey, grizzled fur, scars across its muzzle and cloudy eyes. Hunched and muscular with long worn claws.

Lobisomem Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Wolf-like beast with mangy patchy fur, exposed ribs, bloodshot eyes and a drooling jaw of broken fangs. Its limbs are twisted and the spine bent.

Vampiro de Fogo.aparencia: Tall, pale-skinned humanoid with slicked dark hair, red-orange glowing eyes and long fangs. Wears a high-collared burgundy coat with ember-colored lining.

Vampiro das Sombras.aparencia: Tall, gaunt humanoid with ashen skin, jet-black hair and narrow glowing red eyes. Wears a long black coat with a high collar and has sharp, clawed fingers.

Vampiro Celeste.aparencia: Slender pale-skinned humanoid with silver-white hair, light blue eyes and small fangs. Dressed in a long white coat with gold embroidery.

Vampiro Amaldiçoado.aparencia: Gaunt humanoid with sallow skin, matted dark hair and bloodshot eyes. Fangs are overgrown, nails long and cracked, and the clothes are tattered and soiled.

Leão Africano.aparencia: Large tawny lion with a thick dark brown mane, a muscular build and amber eyes. Short sandy fur and a tufted tail.

Leão Siberiano.aparencia: Big lion with a thick, long pale-gold coat and a heavy, shaggy mane. Dense fur covers its paws and the build is broad and powerful.

Leão Polar.aparencia: Large white-furred lion with a fluffy cream mane, pale icy blue eyes and broad furry paws. Thick-coated body, stocky and strong.

Leão Pardo.aparencia: Medium-sized lion with a smooth reddish-brown coat, a short dark mane and sharp amber eyes. Lean, muscular and low to the ground.

Leão Negro.aparencia: Sleek lion with a black coat, a thick dark mane and bright yellow eyes. Muscular and glossy, with a long tufted tail.

Leão Gigante.aparencia: Enormous lion much larger than normal, with a massive golden-brown mane, wide shoulders and a thick chest. Heavy paws and a deep, scarred muzzle.

Leão Anão.aparencia: A knee-high tawny big cat with a stubby body, oversized paws and a fluffy half-grown mane. Its short legs and round face make it look like a cub that never grew up.

Leão Imperial.aparencia: A broad-chested golden cat with a huge, richly layered mane that frames the head like a crown. It stands tall and upright, with a calm, commanding gaze and a thick tufted tail.

Leão Selvagem.aparencia: A gaunt, rangy tawny cat with a ragged, tangled mane full of burrs and dirt. Scarred ears, bared teeth and a low crouching stance give it a wild, unkempt look.

Leão Veneno.aparencia: A sickly green-tinged tawny cat with a mane streaked purple at the tips. Yellow eyes, drooling jaws and dark veins along the legs mark it as toxic.

Tigre Africano.aparencia: A lean sand-coloured striped cat with long legs, a narrow chest and large alert ears. Its stripes are thin and faded, suited to dry open grassland.

Tigre Siberiano.aparencia: A heavy, thick-furred orange cat with a pale cream ruff and wide, padded paws. Its stripes are sparse and soft-edged, and frost clings to its whiskers.

Tigre Polar.aparencia: A white-coated big cat with pale blue stripes and icy blue eyes. Its fur is dense and shaggy, with broad furred paws made for walking on snow.

Tigre Pardo.aparencia: A big cat in a muddy chestnut-brown coat with dark brown stripes that blur into the fur. Its build is stocky and earthy, with a heavy square head.

Tigre Negro.aparencia: A sleek, jet-black big cat whose stripes show only as faint glossy bands in the light. Pale amber eyes glow from its dark face as it prowls low.

Tigre Gigante.aparencia: An enormous striped big cat the size of a house, with thick pillar legs and a head broader than a doorway. Its stripes are wide as planks and its fangs as long as swords.

Tigre Anão.aparencia: A tiny striped big cat the size of a house cat, with a rounded face, big eyes and stubby legs. Its stripes are tightly packed and its tail is thick and short.

Tigre Imperial.aparencia: A majestic orange big cat with bold black stripes and a golden sheen on its coat. It carries a pale ruff like a collar and holds its head high with a regal pose.

Tigre Selvagem.aparencia: A scruffy, wiry striped big cat with matted fur, torn ears and a crooked tail. Its eyes are wide and its back is arched in a feral, ready-to-pounce crouch.

Tigre Veneno.aparencia: A striped big cat with sickly lime-green fur and purple-black stripes that drip like ink. Its fangs are stained yellow and its tongue is dark violet.

Urso Africano.aparencia: A tall, rangy sand-coloured bruin with a long snout, short sleek fur and long limbs. It has a pale muzzle and sun-bleached shoulders, built for hot dry ground.

Urso Siberiano.aparencia: A massive bruin wrapped in long, shaggy grey-brown fur with a thick neck mane. Heavy padded paws and a frosted muzzle give it a cold-country look.

Urso Polar.aparencia: A huge cream-white bruin with a long neck, a narrow head and a black nose. Its dense fur is slightly yellow-tinged and its broad paws are webbed for swimming.

Urso Pardo.aparencia: A stout bruin with thick brown fur, a prominent shoulder hump and a wide dished face. Long pale claws curve from its heavy forepaws.

Urso Negro.aparencia: A medium-sized bruin with glossy black fur, a tan snout and a pale chest patch. It has rounded ears, a straight profile and a lumbering, curious stance.

Urso Gigante.aparencia: A towering bruin the size of a barn, its brown fur coarse like thatch. Each paw is a boulder tipped with claws like scythes, and its head is lower than its huge hump.

Urso Anão.aparencia: A palm-sized round bruin cub with a button nose, tiny ears and soft honey-brown fuzz. Its limbs are stubby and its belly is plump, giving a toy-like silhouette.

Urso Imperial.aparencia: A grand bruin with a thick, glossy dark-gold coat and a lighter mane around the shoulders. It stands partly upright with a proud chest and a steady, noble gaze.

Urso Selvagem.aparencia: A shaggy, wild-eyed bruin with matted brown fur and a broken claw. Its ribs show slightly, its lip is curled and it sways forward in a restless, aggressive hunch.

Urso Veneno.aparencia: A bruin with bruised violet-brown fur, patches of green mange and swollen dark gums. Foam beads at its muzzle and its claws are tinted sickly yellow.

Lobo Africano.aparencia: A tall, thin-bodied canine with huge ears, long legs and a tan coat with black patches. Its muzzle is narrow and its tail is bushy with a dark tip.

Lobo Siberiano.aparencia: A thick-coated grey canine with a wide ruff, small rounded ears and pale ice-blue eyes. Its fur forms heavy layers over the shoulders, and the tail is plumed.

Lobo Polar.aparencia: A snow-white canine with a dense double coat, short ears and black eyes and nose. Frost dusts its shoulders and its big furred feet leave wide tracks.

Lobo Pardo.aparencia: A canine in a dusty reddish-brown coat with a darker saddle across its back and pale underparts. Its build is sturdy and its snout is broad and scarred.

Lobo Negro.aparencia: A sleek, coal-black canine with a glossy coat and bright yellow eyes. Its long legs and narrow chest suit a silent, stalking gait.

Lobo Gigante.aparencia: A canine as tall as a horse, with shaggy grey fur and a head the size of an anvil. Its teeth are long as daggers and each paw is the width of a dinner plate.

Lobo Anão.aparencia: A fox-sized canine with a round skull, oversized ears and fluffy grey fur. Its legs are short and its tail curls up high like a puppy's.

Lobo Imperial.aparencia: A proud silvery-white canine with a magnificent ruff and a pale gold sheen along its back. It holds its head high with a long elegant neck and a flowing tail.

Lobo Veneno.aparencia: A gaunt canine with grey fur turning green at the edges, dripping saliva and glazed yellow eyes. Dark veins run beneath thin skin along its flanks and snout.

Águia Africano.aparencia: A large raptor with a white head and chest, a chestnut belly and black wings. Its hooked yellow beak is strong and its broad wings are held wide over open savanna.

Águia Siberiano.aparencia: A big raptor with dense dark-brown plumage, white shoulders and thick feathered legs like trousers. Frosty down edges its neck and its wings are broad and heavy.

Águia Polar.aparencia: A large pure-white raptor with a pale grey beak, icy blue eyes and fully feathered talons. Its plumage is thick and fluffy, blending with snow.

Águia Pardo.aparencia: A raptor with earthy brown plumage, a golden nape and heavy yellow talons. Its feathers are mottled like dry leaves and its stare is intense and steady.

Águia Negro.aparencia: A large raptor in glossy black plumage with a hooked grey beak and gleaming amber eyes. Its wings are long and fingered and its tail is dark and square.

Águia Gigante.aparencia: A colossal raptor with a wingspan as wide as a ship, brown feathers as long as oars and talons like iron hooks. Its beak could crush a boulder.

Águia Anão.aparencia: A sparrow-sized fluffy raptor with a big head, tiny hooked beak and stubby wings. Its downy feathers are soft brown with a white chest, and its legs are small and yellow.

Águia Imperial.aparencia: A majestic raptor with dark chocolate plumage and a shining golden crown and nape. Its white shoulder bars stand out and it perches with a regal upright pose.

Águia Selvagem.aparencia: A ragged raptor with ruffled, uneven feathers and a wild, glaring eye. Its talons are chipped, one wing feather is broken and its beak is hooked and scratched.

Águia Veneno.aparencia: A raptor with greenish-grey plumage tipped in purple, a yellowed beak and bloodshot eyes. Its talons look stained with a sickly dark ooze and its crest is bristly.

Tubarão Africano.aparencia: A sleek grey-sandy shark with a slim torpedo body, a pointed snout and a pale belly. A warm bronze tint runs along its flanks and its dorsal fin is tall.

Tubarão Siberiano.aparencia: A thick, slow-looking shark with slate-grey skin, a rounded snout and a blue-white frosted belly. Its skin is heavy and rough, and its tail fin is broad.

Tubarão Polar.aparencia: A pale white shark with an icy blue back, glassy dark eyes and rows of triangular teeth. Its skin looks frosted and its large fins are edged in translucent white.

Tubarão Pardo.aparencia: A stout brown shark with a mottled bronze-brown back and a creamy underside. It has a broad flat head, a wide mouth and heavy pectoral fins like paddles.

Tubarão Negro.aparencia: A slim, dark shark with charcoal-black skin and a matte, shadowy sheen. Its eyes are small and dull, and black-tipped fins cut like blades.

Tubarão Gigante.aparencia: An immense shark as long as a ship, with a wide cavernous mouth and teeth like shovel blades. Its grey back is scarred and its fins are as large as sails.

Tubarão Anão.aparencia: A hand-sized shark with a chubby body, huge round eyes and tiny pointed teeth. Its light grey skin has soft speckles and its fins are small and rounded.

Tubarão Imperial.aparencia: A grand shark with a deep blue back, a gleaming silver belly and golden edges on its fins. Its long streamlined body and tall dorsal fin carry a majestic poise.

Tubarão Selvagem.aparencia: A scarred, battered shark with torn fins, ragged gill slits and crooked rows of teeth. Its dull grey skin is covered in old bite marks and its eyes are restless.

Tubarão Veneno.aparencia: A shark with sickly green-grey skin, purple blotches and pale cloudy eyes. Spines on its fins drip a bluish fluid and a faint foam trails from its gills.

Elefante Africano.aparencia: A huge grey tusked giant with enormous fan-shaped ears and a deeply wrinkled hide. Its back dips in the middle and its long trunk ends in two fingers.

Elefante Siberiano.aparencia: A massive grey-brown tusked giant covered in long, shaggy rust-coloured hair, with small ears and a high domed skull. Its tusks curve long and thick.

Elefante Polar.aparencia: A heavy tusked giant with pale blue-white skin, sparse white hair and ice-like frost on its tusks. Its ears are small to hold in heat and its feet are broad.

Elefante Pardo.aparencia: A tusked giant with reddish-brown skin like dried clay, deep wrinkles and a round forehead. Its tusks are yellowish and its trunk is thick and heavy.

Elefante Negro.aparencia: A tusked giant with dark charcoal skin, ink-black wrinkles and dull ivory tusks. Its small eyes glint faintly and its ears hang heavily against its shoulders.

Elefante Gigante.aparencia: An immense tusked giant tall as a tower, with legs like stone columns and ears like barn doors. Its curved tusks are thick as tree trunks and its hide is cracked grey rock.

Elefante Anão.aparencia: A pony-sized tusked giant with a round tummy, a short trunk and tiny nubs for tusks. Its ears are floppy and large for its size and its skin is soft grey.

Elefante Imperial.aparencia: A stately grey tusked giant with polished ivory tusks, long and gracefully curved, and creamy pale patches on its forehead. It walks tall with its trunk raised.

Elefante Selvagem.aparencia: A rough-skinned tusked giant with a snapped tusk, patchy mud-caked hide and wildly flared ears. Its eyes are wide and its trunk is lifted in a threatening curl.

Elefante Veneno.aparencia: A tusked giant with mottled grey-green skin, yellowed tusks tipped purple and a swollen trunk. Dark veins stand out on its ears and its eyes are bloodshot.

Rinoceronte Africano.aparencia: A heavy grey beast with two upright horns on its snout, a pointed lip and thick hide folded at the shoulders. Its stance is wide and its ears are rounded.

Rinoceronte Siberiano.aparencia: A stocky horned beast covered in thick, shaggy auburn hair, with a huge forward-curved horn above a smaller one. Its back hump and short legs suit cold plains.

Rinoceronte Polar.aparencia: A bulky horned beast with pale blue-white plated hide and a milky horn that looks like ice. Frost clings to the folds of its skin and its lumbering gait is slow.

Rinoceronte Negro.aparencia: A massive dark-grey horned beast with a hooked upper lip and a long front horn curved backward. Its hide is slate-black, rough and plated like armour.

Rinoceronte Gigante.aparencia: A colossal horned beast as large as a hill, with a horn the length of a lance and plated hide like boulders. Its feet are three-toed, wide and heavy.

Rinoceronte Anão.aparencia: A calf-sized horned beast with a round belly, a small blunt horn and soft grey wrinkly skin. Its ears are big and its legs are short and stubby.

Rinoceronte Imperial.aparencia: A noble horned beast with smooth, polished silver-grey plates, a long straight golden-tipped horn and a high-held head. Its stance is proud and solid.

Rinoceronte Selvagem.aparencia: A rough, muddy horned beast with a chipped horn, scarred hide and small furious eyes. It lowers its head and paws the ground with a bristling, ready-to-charge posture.

Rinoceronte Veneno.aparencia: A horned beast with dull grey-green plated hide, purple-stained horns and weeping, swollen eyes. Slimy ooze seeps between its armour folds.

Hipopótamo Africano.aparencia: A barrel-bodied grey-brown beast with short legs, a huge square muzzle and small ears. Its hairless hide has a pinkish sheen and tusk-like teeth show in its wide jaw.

Hipopótamo Siberiano.aparencia: A round beast with a coat of coarse grey-brown fur over thick hide and a wide blunt muzzle. Its small ears are tucked in and it keeps a hunched, heat-saving shape.

Hipopótamo Polar.aparencia: A round, pale blue-white beast with smooth, thick hide, a huge muzzle and tiny ears. Its skin looks frosted and its nostrils puff vapour in cold air.

Hipopótamo Pardo.aparencia: A barrel-shaped beast with muddy brown skin, a broad flat muzzle and short, thick legs. Wet clay dries in cracks across its back and its eyes sit high on its head.

Hipopótamo Negro.aparencia: A heavy beast with dark slate-black skin, a wide jaw lined with ivory tusks and small gleaming eyes. Its hide looks wet and glossy like oil.

Hipopótamo Gigante.aparencia: An enormous beast as big as a house, its mouth wide enough to swallow a cart. Its grey hide folds like cliffs and its tusks are as thick as logs.

Hipopótamo Anão.aparencia: A tiny round beast the size of a piglet, with a pinkish-grey rubbery body, a big head and little pointed ears. Its teeth are small and its legs are stumps.

Hipopótamo Imperial.aparencia: A stately beast with a smooth, rosy-grey hide, pearl-white tusks and a calm lifted head. Its massive body is clean and glossy, with a regal broad-chested posture.

Hipopótamo Selvagem.aparencia: A gnarled beast with scarred, mud-streaked hide, a gaping jaw showing crooked tusks and wild bulging eyes. Its short legs are braced and its flanks heave.

Hipopótamo Veneno.aparencia: A bloated beast with sickly green-purple skin, oozing blisters and yellow stained tusks. Its eyes are bloodshot and a toxic-looking sweat drips from its flanks.

Crocodilo Africano.aparencia: A long olive-grey reptile with a V-shaped snout, rough armoured scales and a muscular flattened tail. Its pale belly and sharp interlocking teeth show when its jaws gape.

Crocodilo Siberiano.aparencia: A thick-bodied pale grey-green reptile with a broad snout, rimed scales and a short, heavy tail. Frost clings to its back ridges and its yellow eyes squint slowly.

Gorila Selvagem.aparencia: A wild ape with tangled black fur, bared teeth and a tense hunched stance. Its brows are furrowed, one ear is torn and its hands grip the ground restlessly.

Gorila Veneno.aparencia: Broad-shouldered ape with sooty fur streaked in sickly green, long arms dragging knuckles, and dripping yellow-green gums around heavy canines; veins glow faintly toward the wrists.

Pantera Polar.aparencia: Long-furred big cat with near-white pelt, pale gray rosettes, and fluffy snow-gripping paws; a thick tail curls over its back and its eyes are ice blue.

Pantera Negro.aparencia: Muscular big cat with a glossy jet-black coat where rosettes show only in raking light; glowing amber eyes and a low, stalking crouch.

Pantera Gigante.aparencia: Enormous big cat the size of a house, with a thick mountain-like back, paws wide as boulders, and a heavy skull; its tawny coat is coarse and scarred.

Pantera Anão.aparencia: Tiny cat-sized predator with oversized paws, a round head, and a soft spotted coat; short legs and a stubby tail give it a cub-like, bouncy look.

Pantera Imperial.aparencia: Regal big cat with a deep violet-gold coat, a thick mane-like ruff around the neck, and a gold-banded tail; it sits upright with a proud, lifted chin.

Pantera Selvagem.aparencia: Ragged, leaf-tangled big cat with a patchy rough coat, wild bristling fur along the spine, and bared teeth; thorn scratches and muddy paws mark it as untamed.

Pantera Veneno.aparencia: Lithe big cat with a purple-green mottled coat, bright toxic yellow eyes, and drooling jaws; its claws are tipped in oily dark residue.

Sucuri Africano.aparencia: Thick constrictor with sandy tan scales marked by rust-colored blotches, a broad flat head, and a muscular coiled body lying across dry grass.

Sucuri Siberiano.aparencia: Heavy snake in dull gray-green with dark saddle patches and slightly ridged scales; coils tightly as if conserving heat, with a blunt, wide snout.

Sucuri Polar.aparencia: Pale, frost-white constrictor with light blue-gray ring markings and glassy scales; its coils look crystalline, with small pale eyes.

Sucuri Pardo.aparencia: Thick muddy-brown snake with darker oval spots down its back, a swollen midsection, and flat dull scales; it blends into riverbank silt.

Sucuri Anão.aparencia: Small, short-bodied snake no longer than an arm, olive with tiny spots, a rounded snout, and big curious eyes; its coils are neat and plump.

Sucuri Imperial.aparencia: Stately serpent with deep emerald scales edged in gold, a crest-like ridge above the eyes, and long, even coils; it holds its head high above the water.

Sucuri Selvagem.aparencia: Scruffy swamp constrictor with moss and algae clinging to mottled green scales, a scarred snout, and nostrils flaring high on the head.

Sucuri Veneno.aparencia: Thick snake with acid-green and violet scales, swollen venom glands behind the jaw, and fangs beading with milky fluid; its eyes are pale and glassy.

Carvalho Gigante.aparencia: Towering ancient oak with a trunk wide enough to tunnel through, a canopy that blots out the sky, and roots thick as walls clutching a hillside.

Carvalho Anão.aparencia: Knee-high oak sapling with a twisted thin trunk, a puffy round crown of bright leaves, and a few tiny acorns balanced on its branches.

Carvalho Imperial.aparencia: Majestic oak with a perfectly symmetrical crown of deep green and gold-tipped leaves, pale smooth bark, and branches fanning upward like a crown.

Carvalho Selvagem.aparencia: Unruly oak with thorny shoots, tangled vines, branches jutting at odd angles, and a rough knotted trunk covered in lichen and bristling twigs.

Carvalho Veneno.aparencia: Oak with sickly purple-green leaves, bark oozing dark sap, bulbous swollen galls on the branches, and fungus spots ringing the roots.

Baobá Polar.aparencia: Swollen white-barked trunk crusted in ice, with bare brittle branches ending in clear crystals; the base is half-buried in drifted snow.

Baobá Pardo.aparencia: Stout tree with dusty brown trunk textured like dry clay, stubby upturned limbs, and wrinkled rounded fruits hanging low.

Baobá Negro.aparencia: Bloated trunk of charcoal-black bark with deep fissures, bare crooked limbs against the sky, and a faint violet glow inside a wide hollow.

Baobá Gigante.aparencia: Colossal trunk as wide as a building, bark folded in huge ridges, and a distant crown of twisted limbs; small creatures nest in its hollows.

Baobá Anão.aparencia: Potato-shaped little tree barely waist-high, with a fat smooth trunk, a few spindly twigs sprouting tufts of leaves, and a single round fruit.

Baobá Imperial.aparencia: Grand trunk of warm bronze bark, sprouting a wide golden-green crown, with large cream flowers hanging like lanterns from its branches.

Baobá Selvagem.aparencia: Lumpy trunk wrapped in creepers, with ragged branches, peeling bark strips, and thorny shoots sprouting from knots in all directions.

Baobá Veneno.aparencia: Bloated trunk streaked in mustard and violet, with bark weeping sticky sap, blistered pods hanging from the limbs, and a ring of withered grass.

Girassol Africano.aparencia: Tall flower with a broad dark seed disc ringed by vivid orange-yellow petals, a hairy green stalk, and wide rough leaves; its head tilts toward the sun.

Girassol Siberiano.aparencia: Sturdy flower with short thick petals of pale yellow, a frost-speckled seed disc, and a stout stalk wrapped in fuzzy hairs against the cold.

Girassol Pardo.aparencia: Faded flower with copper-brown petals, a large dark seed head heavy with seeds, and a drooping dry stalk dusted in soil.

Girassol Negro.aparencia: Flower with ink-dark petals edged in dim amber, a seed disc like polished onyx, and a slender black stalk bowing away from the light.

Girassol Gigante.aparencia: Skyscraper-high flower whose disc is wide as a pond, with petals like gold sails and a trunk-thick green stalk braced by roots.

Girassol Anão.aparencia: Palm-sized flower with a chubby round face of bright yellow petals, a tiny brown disc, and a short stem with two little leaves.

Girassol Imperial.aparencia: Radiant flower with layered golden petals forming a crown-like double ring, a deep mahogany disc, and a straight proud stalk.

Girassol Selvagem.aparencia: Lopsided flower with uneven jagged petals, a scruffy seed disc, a bristly stem leaning every direction, and weeds tangled around its base.

Girassol Veneno.aparencia: Flower with sickly green-yellow petals spotted in purple, a bruise-colored disc beaded with sticky droplets, and a mottled limp stalk.

Mandrágora Real Anão.aparencia: Thumb-high root sprite with a turnip-like round body, two tiny leaves on top, little stick limbs, and wide shiny eyes.

Mandrágora Real Imperial.aparencia: Elegant root figure with smooth cream-purple skin, a crown of vivid leaves ringed with small violet flowers, and slender upright limbs.

Mandrágora Real Selvagem.aparencia: Wild root creature with a shaggy mop of thorny vines, twisted bark-like skin, snapping rootlet fingers, and a hunched, snarling pose.

Mandrágora Real Veneno.aparencia: Root figure with mottled lilac-green skin, blistered knobs on its back, drooping nightshade-like bells on its head, and dripping dark berries.

Javali Siberiano.aparencia: Heavy wild boar with thick shaggy gray-brown bristles, a deep chest, short curved tusks, and a dense woolly undercoat.

Javali Polar.aparencia: Stocky white-furred boar with ice-blue shading on the bristles, pale tusks, small dark eyes, and frost on its snout.

Javali Pardo.aparencia: Muddy brown boar with a coarse dusty coat, a blunt snout caked in soil, and short broad tusks; it stands low and solid.

Javali Negro.aparencia: Dark-bristled boar with a black coat, a ragged mane along the spine, and glinting red eyes; tusks are long and nearly sharpened to points.

Javali Gigante.aparencia: Huge boar the size of a wagon, with a boulder-like head, tusks as long as spears, and a back covered in stiff thick bristles.

Javali Anão.aparencia: Small piglet-sized boar with stripes along its flanks, a round belly, tiny nubs for tusks, and a twitchy upturned snout.

Javali Imperial.aparencia: Noble boar with a glossy reddish coat, a gold-white mane, long polished tusks ringed in bronze, and a straight proud posture.

Javali Selvagem.aparencia: Unkempt boar with matted twig-snagged bristles, scarred hide, chipped tusks, and a frothing snout; it paws the dirt, hackles raised.

Javali Veneno.aparencia: Boar with patchy greenish skin showing through thinning bristles, yellow-stained tusks, swollen boils on its flanks, and slime at its mouth.

Cobra Africano.aparencia: Slim snake with a sand-yellow body banded in brown, a flared hood behind the head, and a raised forebody swaying above rocky ground.

Cobra Siberiano.aparencia: Thickset hooded snake with steel-gray scales, a pale throat, small frost-rimmed eyes, and a compact coiled body.

Cobra Polar.aparencia: Ice-white hooded snake with a translucent bluish hood, glassy scales, and a faint trail of mist; its forked tongue is pale.

Cobra Pardo.aparencia: Matte brown hooded snake with rough scales and a dust-colored hood marked by two faint eyespots; it lies flat among dry leaves.

Cobra Negro.aparencia: Jet-black hooded snake with a mirror-bright sheen, a wide hood, and glowing amber slit eyes; it rears up in a tall S-curve.

Cobra Gigante.aparencia: Enormous hooded snake whose rearing body towers over trees, with a hood as wide as a barn door and fangs like curved scythes.

Cobra Anão.aparencia: Tiny hooded snake as long as a pencil, with a miniature hood, bright round eyes, and a bobbing little head.

Cobra Imperial.aparencia: Stately hooded snake with royal blue scales edged in gold, a broad hood patterned with a crown-like emblem, and a lofty, composed stance.

Cobra Selvagem.aparencia: Ragged hooded snake with patchy shed skin, mottled olive scales, a frayed hood, and a twitchy, striking posture; scars cross its snout.

Cobra Veneno.aparencia: Hooded snake with lurid green and violet scales, dripping glossy fangs, a hood speckled with toxic yellow, and pale, hungry eyes.

Aranha Africano.aparencia: Long-legged spider with a sandy tan body, banded orange-brown legs, and a bulbous abdomen; it crouches low on dry rock.

Aranha Siberiano.aparencia: Furry gray-brown spider with dense insulating hairs on a thick body, short sturdy legs, and a frosted abdomen.

Aranha Polar.aparencia: White spider with translucent pale-blue legs, a glassy abdomen, and tiny icy eyes; thin frosty silk threads trail from its spinnerets.

Aranha Pardo.aparencia: Plain brown spider with a violin-like mark on its back, slender legs, and a small oval body; it tucks into dark corners.

Aranha Negro.aparencia: Glossy black spider with a round shiny abdomen marked by a red hourglass, thin long legs, and eight tiny beady eyes.

Aranha Anão.aparencia: Fingernail-sized spider with a round beaded body, tiny springy legs, big front eyes, and a bright speckled abdomen.

Aranha Imperial.aparencia: Elegant spider with a deep indigo body, gold filigree-like patterns on its abdomen, long glossy legs, and a stately, poised crouch.

Aranha Selvagem.aparencia: Shaggy spider with leaf-green and brown mottling, spiny legs, and a lumpy abdomen; torn webs hang from its limbs.

Aranha Veneno.aparencia: Spider with a neon green and purple abdomen, bulging venom sacs at the jaws, and legs ringed in warning yellow; fang tips drip.

Hydralisk Primal.aparencia: Raw, primitive snake-bodied alien with rough tan hide, thick horns instead of smooth plates, a ragged hood, and heavy, coarse forearms.

Ultralisk Infectado.aparencia: Colossal horned quadruped with rotting grey-green flesh, bulging yellow growths on its back and tusks streaked with dark ooze. Its armor plates hang loose like peeling bark.

Ultralisk Purificador.aparencia: Enormous bulky quadruped with smooth ivory armor plates and tusk-blades polished to a bright sheen. Pale blue light seeps from seams in its hide and its stance is steady and noble.

Roach Elite.aparencia: Low, broad six-legged crawler with a thick glossy brown shell edged in orange ridges, a wide flat head and strong spiny legs. Its carapace is thicker and more layered than normal.

Roach Purificador.aparencia: Neat, tidy crawler with a cream-white shell edged in thin gold lines, smooth rounded plates and clear amber eyes. It holds its head high and its legs are straight and even.

Baneling Primal.aparencia: Crude ball-shaped creature with a thick earthy-brown skin sac, a fringe of coarse bristles and tiny clawed feet. A knobbly bone ring circles its middle like a roll cage.

Baneling Infectado.aparencia: Swollen sac creature with sagging grey-green skin, visible dark fluid sloshing inside and several tiny leaking holes. Its stubby legs are pale and withered.

Overlord Primal.aparencia: Bulbous floating creature with a tan leathery balloon body, rough bark-like patches and long curling tendrils like vines. Small tufts of moss grow along its underside.

Overlord Infectado.aparencia: Floating bladder with mottled putrid green skin, bulging cysts and torn dangling tendrils that drip thick fluid. Its eyes are clouded and its body sags unevenly in the air.

Overlord Purificador.aparencia: Soft, rounded floating body in pale silvery white with gentle glowing patches, fine silky tendrils and wide kind eyes. It hovers level and serene with no spikes at all.

Zealot Purificador.aparencia: Calm armored fighter in white and pale blue plate with flowing light cloth, forearm blades of soft glowing light and a hooded, lowered head. His stance is open and peaceful.

Dragoon Veterano.aparencia: Spider-like walker with a scuffed, dented hull, mismatched replacement leg plates and a stained cannon muzzle. Scorch marks darken its cockpit shell and its core flickers dimly.

Dragoon Infectado.aparencia: Four-legged machine with a corroded hull overrun by purple fungal growth, a crooked cracked shell and a bent cannon. Slimy strands hang from its joints and its core glows sickly green.

Dragoon Purificador.aparencia: Elegant four-legged walker with a smooth white and silver hull, slim curved legs and a crystal-clear core glowing soft white. Its cannon is sleek and capped with a ring of light.

Colossus Elite.aparencia: Towering two-legged machine on long spindly stilt legs, with a slim armored torso in dark blue and gold, twin lens-like cannons on its shoulders and glowing blue seams.

Colossus Veterano.aparencia: Giant stilt-legged walker with a dented, repainted torso, one scuffed lens cannon and rust streaks down its tall legs. Its joints look worn and its stance leans slightly.

Colossus Primal.aparencia: Giant on tall, tree-trunk-like stone legs with a blocky rock torso, vines draped across its shoulders and a pair of crude crystal lenses. Its feet are broad and heavy.

Colossus Infectado.aparencia: Tall stilt-legged machine with a corroded, bent torso, purple fungal blooms creeping up its legs and lens cannons clouded with grime. Its glow is a weak sickly green.

Colossus Purificador.aparencia: Tall, elegant walker with long thin white legs, a smooth silver torso and two clear crystal lenses glowing a calm white. Its proportions are slim and its posture is upright.

Marine Elite.aparencia: Stocky soldier in heavy blue-grey powered armor with a large rounded helmet, a visor glowing amber and a long rifle held across the chest. Extra shoulder plates add bulk.

Marine Veterano.aparencia: Stocky soldier in battered grey armor with chipped paint, a visor cracked across one corner and a rifle wrapped with worn tape. Faded stripes mark one shoulder and his stance is relaxed.

Marine Primal.aparencia: Burly fighter in homemade armor of scrap plates and animal hide, a rough pot-like helmet and a crude single-barrel rifle strapped to his back. Mud streaks cover his legs.

Marine Infectado.aparencia: Slouched soldier in cracked armor with fleshy purple growths bursting through the seams, a broken visor and an arm swollen into a lumpy claw. Green slime trails from his rifle.

Marine Purificador.aparencia: Soldier in clean white and pale blue armor with a smooth helmet, a softly glowing visor and a slim rifle carried low. A short white cape hangs from one shoulder.

Ghost Elite.aparencia: Slim agile soldier in a fitted black bodysuit with sleek armor panels, a visored helmet with a red lens and a long scoped rifle. A faint shimmer blurs his outline.

Ghost Veterano.aparencia: Wiry fighter in a worn charcoal bodysuit with patched knee pads, a scuffed helmet and a long scoped rifle with a scratched barrel. Grey stubble shows beneath his visor.

Ghost Primal.aparencia: Lithe hunter in a hooded cloak of dark hide, ash-smeared face and a long carved wooden bow-rifle. Feathers and cords hang from his belt and his feet are wrapped in cloth.

Ghost Infectado.aparencia: Thin, twitchy figure in a torn bodysuit with purple lumps pushing under pale skin, a cracked helmet and a rifle crusted with slime. His eyes glow a feverish green.

Ghost Purificador.aparencia: Slim figure in a smooth white-and-grey bodysuit with a clear glowing visor, a slender rifle of pale metal and a trailing short scarf of faint light. His stance is still and balanced.

Marauder Elite.aparencia: Very bulky soldier in thick dark-red heavy armor with a large domed helmet, massive shoulder guards and twin grenade launchers on the forearms. A glowing yellow visor slit cuts across the face.

Marauder Veterano.aparencia: Heavy, stout soldier in dented rust-red armor with a flaking paint number, one patched shoulder guard and a scratched launcher arm. His helmet is dull and a thick belt holds spare canisters.

Marauder Primal.aparencia: Massive brute in layered stone-and-hide armor with a horned crude helmet and heavy knuckle-guards. A big sling-like launcher is strapped across his thick back.

Marauder Infectado.aparencia: Hulking soldier with corroded armor split open by purple fleshy growths, a lopsided helmet and one arm swollen far larger than the other. Green slime oozes from his launcher.

Marauder Purificador.aparencia: Large soldier in smooth white plate with soft gold trim, a rounded helmet with a calm blue visor and neat, slimmer launchers on both forearms. His stance is broad and gentle.

Goliath Elite.aparencia: Two-legged walker with a tall boxy cockpit, a big missile pod on each arm and glossy white-and-red plating. Its legs have thick pistons and its cockpit glass glows blue.

Goliath Veterano.aparencia: Bipedal walker with faded, chipped hull paint, dented missile pods and an oil-streaked cockpit with a crack in the glass. One leg piston has been replaced by a mismatched rod.

Goliath Primal.aparencia: Crude two-legged walker of riveted stone slabs and rough bronze, with a small slit cockpit, log-like leg beams and two plain tube launchers. Vines wrap around its knees.

Goliath Infectado.aparencia: Walking machine with a rusted hull overgrown by purple spongy growths, a cracked cockpit with a dim green glow and one bent launcher arm. Dark fluid drips from its leg joints.

Goliath Purificador.aparencia: Slim two-legged walker with a smooth pearl-white hull, a clear bubble cockpit glowing soft blue and neat, narrow launcher pods. Its legs are slender and its posture is upright.

Siege Tank Elite.aparencia: Heavy tracked war machine with a thick blue-steel hull, a long main gun with a reinforced muzzle brake and a rotating turret with layered armor. Bright yellow stripes mark the front plate.

Siege Tank Veterano.aparencia: Heavy tracked machine with a scuffed, dented hull, patched armor plates and a gun barrel scorched black at the tip. Its treads are caked in dust and a faded number is painted on the turret.

Siege Tank Primal.aparencia: Crude tracked machine built from stone slabs and rough iron bands, with log-like treads, a short thick cannon and a lumpy turret. Dry grass tufts poke out of its seams.

Siege Tank Infectado.aparencia: Tracked machine with a corroded hull and sagging treads, purple fleshy growth swelling around the turret and a bent barrel leaking green sludge. Its lamp glows sickly.

Siege Tank Purificador.aparencia: Sleek tracked machine with a smooth white and pale silver hull, a slim long barrel capped by a ring of soft light and neat low treads. A small clear crystal sits atop the turret.

Battlecruiser Elite.aparencia: Gigantic flying warship with a wedge-shaped steel-blue hull, layered armor plates, rows of gun turrets along the flanks and a huge forward cannon. Twin engines glow bright orange at the rear.

Battlecruiser Veterano.aparencia: Huge flying warship with a battered hull covered in scorch marks, replaced mismatched panels and a few dark turrets. Its paint is faded and its engines glow a tired dull orange.

Battlecruiser Infectado.aparencia: Massive airborne hull eaten by rust and purple fleshy growth, with torn armor plates drooping from the sides and a crooked front cannon. Green glow leaks from its cracked engine vents.

Battlecruiser Purificador.aparencia: Massive floating ship with a clean white and silver hull, smooth sweeping lines and gold-trimmed fins. Its engines glow soft blue and its front cannon is capped with a pale crystal.

Zealot Elite II.aparencia: Imposing warrior in thick gold plate with winged shoulder guards, a tall plumed helm and two long forearm blades edged with bright white light. He wears a short crimson tabard.

Mutalisk Veterano II.aparencia: Winged beast with deeply scarred, patched wings, a dark teal carapace worn smooth at the edges and a twisted tail blade. A chunk of one wing tip is missing and its eyes are narrowed.

High Templar Primal II.aparencia: Stooped old shaman with a long beard braided with reeds, a heavy cloak of woven bark and a staff-less pose. A rough green crystal dangles at his chest and his skin is painted with white spirals.

Ghost Elite II.aparencia: Tall slim operative in a matte midnight-blue suit with segmented armor, a sharply angled helmet with twin glowing slits and a long folding rifle on his back. His posture is silent and tense.

Overlord Veterano II.aparencia: Big floating sac with a thick, ropey scarred hide, several old stitched tears and long uneven tendrils. Its small eyes are deep set and its underside is stained brown.

Orc de Mordor.aparencia: Stocky, long-armed humanoid with sooty black-grey skin, a crooked jaw with yellowed fangs and a rusty iron helm with a red eye painted on it. He carries a heavy curved cleaver.

Orc de Isengard.aparencia: Broad humanoid with greenish-brown skin, a tight leather cap and a white hand painted on his chest plate. He holds a short thick sword and his tusks are chipped.

Orc de Moria.aparencia: Pale, hunched cave-dweller with big dark eyes, grey clammy skin and tattered hide scraps. His long arms hold a crude spiked club and his ears are large and pointed.

Orc das Sombras.aparencia: Lean humanoid with ink-black skin, narrow glowing red eyes and a ragged hooded cloak that blurs into shadow. Long clawed fingers hold a thin dark dagger.

Orc Ancião.aparencia: Old, heavily built humanoid with leathery grey-green skin, a broken tusk and a thin white braid. His armor is a patchwork of old dented plates and his spine is bent but still strong.

Orc Líder.aparencia: Tall, muscular humanoid with dark green skin, a spiked iron crown-helm and a thick fur mantle across one shoulder. He holds a great axe and a row of trophy teeth hangs at his belt.

Uruk-hai de Mordor.aparencia: Tall, strong humanoid with dark skin, a heavy black plate cuirass and a squared helmet with a red-painted sign. He holds a long curved sword and a round iron shield.

Uruk-hai de Isengard.aparencia: Tall broad-shouldered humanoid with coarse black hair, a pale hand mark painted on his helm and a thick leather-and-iron breastplate. His weapon is a large serrated blade.

Uruk-hai de Moria.aparencia: Large humanoid with grey dusty skin, a horned iron cap and a dark stone-studded shield. Long arms hold a heavy spiked mattock and his boots are caked with cave mud.

Uruk-hai das Sombras.aparencia: Tall humanoid with near-black skin, a faceless smooth dark mask and a long cloak that trails like smoke. He wields a narrow black spear and his eyes show as two pale dots.

Uruk-hai Ancião.aparencia: Tall, gaunt old humanoid with scarred ashen skin, a white-streaked mane and heavy battered armor with a long frayed cape. He leans on a thick two-handed sword.

Troll de Isengard.aparencia: Huge, hulking brute with grey-brown stony skin, a low heavy brow and thick tree-trunk arms. A rough iron belt and a chain collar hang on him, and he clutches a large wooden club.

Troll de Moria.aparencia: Towering pale-grey brute with cracked stone-like hide, a small head set deep in broad shoulders and long arms that drag near the floor. Cave moss grows on his back and he holds a boulder.

Troll das Sombras.aparencia: Hulking hunched brute over three meters tall, skin the color of wet slate that seems to smoke at the edges. Long knuckle-dragging arms, heavy brow, small pale eyes glowing in a lumpy dark face.

Troll Ancião.aparencia: Enormous stooped brute with lichen-crusted, cracked gray hide like weathered boulder. Sagging jowls, a bald mottled scalp, mossy tufts on the shoulders and thick yellowed tusks worn to stumps.

Troll Líder.aparencia: Towering broad-chested brute taller than its kin, with scarred olive hide, a crude iron-studded harness and a spiked bone crown lashed to its head. Bulging forearms wrapped in chains, scowling underbite.

Goblin de Mordor.aparencia: Small wiry humanoid with ash-gray skin, a long hooked nose and oversized ears. Wears scorched black leather scraps and a dented helm, soot smeared over the face, orange glints in narrow eyes.

Goblin de Isengard.aparencia: Stocky short humanoid with sallow green-brown skin and a flat scowling face. Strapped into riveted iron plates, a white palm print painted on the chest, rusty cleaver hanging from a belt of chain.

Goblin de Moria.aparencia: Spindly pale humanoid adapted to caves, with bulging milky eyes, huge ears and long clawed fingers that grip rock. Crouches low in ragged scraps, skin damp and grayish like cave fungus.

Goblin das Sombras.aparencia: Lean child-sized humanoid with ink-black skin, thin limbs and slit yellow eyes. Hooded in tattered dark cloth, grinning with needle teeth, a curved knife held low and wisps of shadow trailing the feet.

Goblin Líder.aparencia: Bigger, broader humanoid with mottled green skin, one torn ear and a missing tooth grin. Wears a patchwork chief's mantle of pelts, a dented horned helmet and a notched scimitar at the hip.

Warg de Mordor.aparencia: Pony-sized wolf with coarse charcoal fur singed rust-red along the back, ribs showing under tight skin. Ember-orange eyes, long yellow fangs and a cinder-dusted muzzle in a low prowling stance.

Warg de Isengard.aparencia: Heavy-shouldered wolf with dense gray-brown fur and a broad skull, wearing a studded iron collar and strapped chest plate. A pale hand-shaped mark is branded on its flank, jaw thick with scars.

Warg de Moria.aparencia: Gaunt cave-dwelling wolf with thin whitish-gray fur, nearly hairless legs and oversized pale blind-looking eyes. Long narrow muzzle, splayed claws for climbing rock, hunched wary posture.

Warg das Sombras.aparencia: Sleek black wolf of stretched proportions whose outline blurs into dark vapor along the legs and tail. Glowing silver-white eyes, ears laid flat and fangs bared in a silent snarl.

Warg Ancião.aparencia: Massive old wolf with grizzled gray-white fur matted into thick ruffs, a scarred muzzle and a clouded eye. Heavy bowed frame, broken fangs and a slow, grim heavy-pawed walk.

Warg Líder.aparencia: Largest of its pack, a wolf as big as a horse with a thick dark mane, torn ears and claw scars across the face. Wears a collar of bones and an iron-spiked shoulder guard, chest puffed in a dominant stance.

Nazgûl de Mordor.aparencia: Tall gaunt figure in a long ragged black robe and pointed iron crown over an empty hood. Pale bony hands grip a sword, hem of the cloak burnt red at the edges, faint ember glow inside the cowl.

Nazgûl de Isengard.aparencia: Tall hooded wraith in layered gray-black robes with riveted steel pauldrons and a plain faceted helm. A white handprint is stitched on the breast, skeletal fingers resting on a heavy mace.

Nazgûl de Moria.aparencia: Stooped hooded specter in dust-gray, cobweb-draped robes, one sleeve rotted away to bare bone. Mineral-pale skin glimmers under the hood, stone grit clinging to the hem and a rusty axe in hand.

Nazgûl das Sombras.aparencia: Tall figure whose black cloak dissolves into smoke at the hem so no feet show. The hood holds only a void with two cold pinpoints of white light, and long pale fingers reach out from the trailing sleeves.

Nazgûl Ancião.aparencia: Ancient withered wraith in mildewed, threadbare grave robes, hunched with a long bent spine. Cracked ivory crown fused to the skull, cobwebs and gray dust draping the shoulders, brittle yellowed hands.

Nazgûl Líder.aparencia: Imposing tall wraith in a black cloak edged with silver thread, a tall jagged crown and a long gray mail shirt beneath. Holds a great two-handed blade, pale spectral glow behind the faceless hood.

Fellbeast de Mordor.aparencia: Bald, long-necked winged reptile with a leathery black hide streaked ash-red, wingspan wider than a house. Hooked beak-like snout, bony ridges along the neck and sooty claws on bat-like wings.

Fellbeast de Isengard.aparencia: Heavy-bodied winged reptile with slate-gray scaly skin, thick neck and a flat vulture-like head. Iron plates are riveted onto its chest and wing joints, sooty stains on the ribs, powerful clawed hind legs.

Fellbeast de Moria.aparencia: Pale, blind-eyed winged reptile with chalk-gray skin and a long skeletal neck, adapted to caverns. Wings folded like torn umbrellas, hooked talons on all limbs and a wrinkled bare head.

Fellbeast das Sombras.aparencia: Lean winged reptile of jet-black skin with a faint violet sheen, wings ragged like torn cloth that bleed into mist. Long snaking neck, hollow glowing white eyes and a snout of bare gleaming bone.

Fellbeast Ancião.aparencia: Massive old winged reptile with sagging, blotchy gray hide, patchy bald scalp and a drooping neck. Wing membranes are tattered and holed, claws chipped and yellowed, eyes cloudy.

Fellbeast Líder.aparencia: Largest of its kind, a winged reptile with thick dark hide, a spiked crest along the skull and notched wing edges from old fights. A heavy chain harness circles the chest and the beak snaps wide in a roar.

Oliphaunt de Mordor.aparencia: Colossal four-legged tusked beast with wrinkled ash-gray hide and huge flapping ears, taller than a tower. Painted red war markings on the flanks, curved tusks blackened by soot and a banded trunk.

Oliphaunt de Isengard.aparencia: Enormous tusked beast with thick brown-gray hide covered in riveted iron armor plates and spiked tusk sheaths. A pale hand mark is painted on the forehead, small wary eyes above a heavy trunk.

Oliphaunt de Moria.aparencia: Massive tusked beast with pale, dusty hide and sunken eyes, hair-thin fur clinging in patches. Shorter ears and stumpy thick legs suit narrow caves, tusks chipped from scraping stone walls.

Oliphaunt das Sombras.aparencia: Gigantic tusked beast with midnight-black hide that fades into smoke at the legs and ear tips. Pale glowing eyes, long tusks like dark ivory curved forward, trunk swaying slowly.

Oliphaunt Ancião.aparencia: Vast ancient tusked beast with deeply creased, moss-spotted gray skin and sagging trunk. Tusks overgrown, one cracked and split, ears ragged and a slow lumbering gait on column legs.

Oliphaunt Líder.aparencia: Biggest of the herd, a tusked beast with bronze caps on its tusks, a draped crimson cloth saddle and scarred hide. Wide chest, tall domed head and a raised trunk trumpeting.

Balrog de Mordor.aparencia: Towering horned fiend with basalt-black skin cracked by glowing red seams like cooling lava. Great bat-like wings of smoke, a mane of flame and a long glowing whip trailing from one clawed fist.

Balrog de Moria.aparencia: Huge horned fiend of shadow wrapped in flickering flame, with stone-gray hide marked by cave dust. Heavy ram-like horns, ragged smoky wings and a broad axe glowing red at the edge.

Balrog das Sombras.aparencia: Tall horned fiend whose body is mostly black smoke, with only a core of dim red embers visible in the chest. Wide wings of vapor, burning eyes and a thin whip of dark fire.

Balrog Ancião.aparencia: Gigantic gaunt horned fiend with ash-crusted, charred skin and a dim sooty glow in its cracks. Wings tattered to rib-like bone, long ragged mane of gray embers and a stooped, heavy stance.

Balrog Líder.aparencia: Colossal horned fiend with burning orange skin cracks, spiked pauldrons of blackened iron and a thick burning mane. Holds a huge flaming sword and a lashing fire whip, wings wide and flaring.

Ent de Mordor.aparencia: Giant walking tree with charred black bark split by red glowing cracks and branches burnt to bare twigs. Roots serve as legs, a gnarled face with a hollow knot-hole mouth and thin smoke rising from the crown.

Ent de Isengard.aparencia: Giant tree-shaped figure with gray splintered bark, torn limbs and axe scars across the trunk. Iron spikes and rusty nails are driven into the wood, lichen hanging from sad deep-set eyes.

Ent de Moria.aparencia: Pale, stunted walking tree with colorless bark and white fungal growths, grown under the dark with no leaves. Long root-fingers feeling the ground, drooping branches and a knobbly slit-eyed face.

Ent das Sombras.aparencia: Giant walking tree with near-black bark and twisted branches that curl like claws. Dark mist pools around the thick roots, the knothole eyes glow dim violet and dead leaves hang in clumps.

Ent Ancião.aparencia: Immense ancient tree-giant with thick furrowed bark covered in moss and small ferns, a long beard of trailing lichen. Slow, deep-set amber eyes, mushrooms on the shoulders and root-feet like boulders.

Ent Líder.aparencia: Tallest tree-giant of its grove, with smooth tight bark, wide crown of green leaves and arms like thick oak limbs. A ring of white blossoms circles the neck and wide wise eyes look down from a bearded face.

Great Eagle de Mordor.aparencia: Huge raptor with a wingspan of ten meters, plumage dark brown scorched to rust at the feather tips. Fierce golden eyes, hooked ash-gray beak and talons as long as a human hand, ember-orange chest.

Great Eagle de Isengard.aparencia: Giant raptor with slate-gray feathers stained by soot, steel-gray beak and a thin iron band around each leg. Heavy broad chest, hard stern eyes and wings spread in a stiff glide.

Great Eagle de Moria.aparencia: Giant raptor with dusty pale-gray plumage and short rounded wings built for tight spaces. Large dark eyes, a stout pale beak and strong feathered legs ending in stone-scratched talons.

Great Eagle das Sombras.aparencia: Huge raptor with jet-black feathers glossed violet, wing tips fraying into smoky wisps. Glowing white eyes, a dark curved beak and a narrow, predatory swooping posture.

Great Eagle Ancião.aparencia: Vast old raptor with silver-white head feathers and weathered brown wings fraying at the ends. Heavy-lidded wise amber eyes, a worn chipped beak and a calm, perched stance.

Great Eagle Líder.aparencia: Enormous raptor with a golden-brown crest, bright white chest and glossy bronze flight feathers. Piercing gold eyes, a long scar over one brow and a proud upright stance with wings half open.

Spider de Mordor.aparencia: Car-sized arachnid with a charcoal-black body, red-glowing joints and eight long bristly legs. Cluster of ruby eyes, oversized dripping fangs and a bulbous abdomen marked by an ember-like orange pattern.

Spider de Isengard.aparencia: Large arachnid with a gunmetal gray hard-shelled body that looks plated, ridged like riveted armor. Eight thick legs with spiked joints, a small head with black eyes and thick chitin fangs.

Spider de Moria.aparencia: Pale cave-dwelling arachnid with a bone-white, translucent body and extremely long thin legs. Many milky eyes, sticky web strands trailing from the spinnerets and a soft dusty abdomen.

Spider das Sombras.aparencia: Sleek arachnid with a glossy jet-black body, long needle legs and a faint violet shimmer along the carapace. Glowing white eye cluster, curved fangs and a shadowy haze clinging to the legs.

Spider Ancião.aparencia: Huge old arachnid with a faded gray-brown body thick with dusty web strands and a swollen, wrinkled abdomen. Chipped fangs, stiff bent legs and a dull, cloudy cluster of eyes.

Spider Líder.aparencia: Biggest arachnid of the nest, broad black body with yellow banding on the legs and a bristled crest of dark spines. Wide-set glossy eyes, long fangs and a raised front pair of legs in a threat display.

Watcher in the Water de Mordor.aparencia: Mass of thick, slimy dark green tentacles rising from murky oily water, each tip ash-gray and pitted. A single large dull amber eye is half sunk in the middle of the writhing coils.

Watcher in the Water de Isengard.aparencia: Cluster of heavy tentacles with slate-colored rubbery skin rising from a foul pool, ringed by thick bands like iron hoops. One cold pale eye stares from the center, water streaming from the coils.

Watcher in the Water de Moria.aparencia: Colorless tentacles like pale wet rope emerging from a black cave pool, some covered in white slime. The central eye is milky and blind, tentacle undersides lined with small suckers.

Watcher in the Water das Sombras.aparencia: Many ink-black tentacles breaking through still dark water, each thin at the tip and slick like an eel. A pair of faint glowing eyes sits low in the dark mass, with mist curling off the surface.

Watcher in the Water Ancião.aparencia: Thick, slow tentacles with mud-green skin crusted with algae and barnacle-like growths, rising from a lake. A large heavy-lidded eye peers from the bulk, scarred by many old injuries.

Watcher in the Water Líder.aparencia: Enormous mass of more than twenty tentacles with a dark green and yellow banded pattern, the thickest as wide as tree trunks. Two large eyes bulge from a central hump and one tentacle is tipped with a hooked barb.

Barrow-wight de Mordor.aparencia: Withered corpse-like figure with blackened parchment skin, faint ember-red glow in its hollow eye sockets. Draped in scorched burial rags, bony arms outstretched with long cracked nails.

Barrow-wight de Isengard.aparencia: Gaunt dead figure with gray leathery skin, clad in corroded iron breastplate and a dented helm with a rusty visor. Sunken pale eyes, long thin arms and a rusted notched blade held loosely.

Barrow-wight de Moria.aparencia: Dusty skeletal figure with pale tight skin and dry, thin white hair, wrapped in rotted cobweb-gray cloth. Fine stone dust sifts from the joints and its jaw hangs open in a silent moan.

Barrow-wight das Sombras.aparencia: Translucent gray spectral figure with a dark smoky lower body that fades into mist before reaching the ground. Hollow black eyes, long thin skeletal fingers and a bowed, hovering posture.

Barrow-wight Ancião.aparencia: Extremely old withered corpse with sunken, wrinkled gray skin, long yellowed beard of dust and gaunt tilted skull. Tattered funeral wrappings, a tarnished gold circlet and cold pale blue pinpoint eyes.

Barrow-wight Líder.aparencia: Tall armored corpse with a tarnished bronze crown, green-stained mail shirt and a ragged dark cloak. Pale blue lights burn in its eye sockets, a long grave-worn sword gripped in bony hands.

Dragon de Mordor.aparencia: Colossal winged reptile with obsidian-black scales veined with red glowing lines, bat-like wings and a long spiked tail. Horned head with molten orange eyes, smoke curling from nostrils, belly plates dark crimson.

Dragon de Isengard.aparencia: Massive winged reptile with dull iron-gray scales that look riveted, broad chest and thick horned brow. A soot-streaked hide, heavy hammer-like tail club and glowing orange throat visible between the jaws.

Dragon de Moria.aparencia: Huge wingless-looking cave reptile with deep copper-brown scales, wings tightly folded to the back and a long lizard-like neck. Small eyes, strong digging claws and a gold-dusted underbelly.

Dragon das Sombras.aparencia: Vast winged reptile with black scales that absorb light, ragged wings with smoky translucent membranes and a slender horned head. Eyes like pale silver coins, faint dark vapor leaking from the jaws.

Dragon Ancião.aparencia: Gigantic ancient winged reptile with thick, cracked and mossy dark green scales, a wide scarred snout and heavy hooded eyes. Broken horns, torn wing membranes and a crust of gold coins stuck to the belly.

Dragon Líder.aparencia: Enormous winged reptile with bright crimson scales, a crown of long swept-back horns and broad muscular wings. Gold-trimmed belly plates, a scarred snout and a deep chest glowing orange as it rears.

Mearas de Mordor.aparencia: Tall slender horse with a coat of glossy charcoal gray, long legs and a flowing smoky mane. Ember-colored eyes, ash-dusted hooves and a proud arched neck.

Mearas de Isengard.aparencia: Powerful tall horse with a dark iron-gray coat, thick neck and a white handprint on its muzzle. Wears a steel chanfron and chest plate, sturdy legs, a clipped mane and wary rolling eyes.

Mearas de Moria.aparencia: Lean horse with a pale dun coat, sure-footed hooves and unusually large dark eyes suited for dim places. Short tight mane, scraped knees and a long careful stride.
