Mearas das Sombras.aparencia: Graceful tall horse with a jet-black coat, mane and tail that trail off into mist and pale glowing eyes. Legs fading into dark vapor, a silent ghostly gallop pose.

Mearas Ancião.aparencia: Noble old horse with a silver-white coat and long flowing mane almost touching the ground. Deep wise brown eyes, a slightly sagging back and a dignified, slow high-stepping walk.

Mearas Líder.aparencia: Magnificent tall stallion with a gleaming white coat, a long silver mane and a lifted proud head. Powerful chest, a small scar across the shoulder and a braided tail tied with a gold band.

Half-troll de Mordor.aparencia: Tall muscular humanoid with ashen gray-brown skin, flatter nose and heavy brow, less hunched than a true giant. Wears black scale armor scorched at the seams, red glow in small eyes and a broad crooked sword.

Half-troll de Isengard.aparencia: Broad humanoid of man height plus a head, with coarse olive-gray skin and thick jaw with short tusks. Wears a heavy iron helm and riveted plates, a pale hand painted on the shield and a spiked club.

Half-troll de Moria.aparencia: Thick-limbed humanoid with pale, rocky gray skin and large flat hands, adapted to dark tunnels. Squinting small eyes, a tangle of dark hair and a ragged leather kilt, carrying a stone pick.

Half-troll das Sombras.aparencia: Tall brawny humanoid with dark bluish-black skin and a heavy brow, outline softened by faint smoke. Pale glowing eyes, a hooded dark cloak over thick shoulders and short crude fangs.

Half-troll Ancião.aparencia: Stooped old humanoid with sagging gray-green skin, bald blotched head and a long white-streaked beard. Thick arms gone stringy, a worn tusk on one side and a gnarled staff for support.

Half-troll Líder.aparencia: Towering humanoid with stone-gray skin, scarred chest and a crown of iron spikes. Wears a tough hide cloak over chain armor and holds a huge cleaver, tusks banded with bronze.

Cave-troll de Mordor.aparencia: Giant brute with a blotchy dark gray hide, scorched patches and a thick sloping back. Small red-lit eyes, wide mouth of cracked teeth and huge hands dragging a heavy soot-blackened chain.

Cave-troll de Isengard.aparencia: Massive brute with thick olive-gray skin, short bowed legs and a body bound in riveted iron straps. White-painted handprint across its belly, a flat skull and a spiked iron maul in its fist.

Cave-troll de Moria.aparencia: Giant brute with bluish-gray skin and wet-looking mottled patches, huge flat feet and a bulging belly. Tiny dull eyes, a drooping lower lip and a stone-tipped chain trailing from one wrist.

Cave-troll das Sombras.aparencia: Giant brute with skin like black stone, smoke seeping from its shoulders and spine. Dim white eyes, a heavy jutting jaw and big hands with blunt claws, shadows pooling around the feet.

Cave-troll Ancião.aparencia: Enormous elderly brute with grayish hide cracked like dry mud and clumps of moss and bat guano on its back. Droopy eyelids, chipped tusks, a hunched ponderous shuffle and stalactite-like warts.

Cave-troll Líder.aparencia: Largest of its kin, a brute with greenish-gray hide, a broad scarred torso and a spiked iron collar. Thick bone bracers on its forearms, a necklace of skulls and a huge boulder-headed club.

Rathalos Subespécie.aparencia: Large winged wyvern with azure-blue scales over a pale belly, a spiked tail and sharp head crest. Leathery wings with a hooked claw at each joint, yellow slit eyes and a poisonous stinger tip on the tail.

Rathalos Variante.aparencia: Large winged wyvern with scarlet scales and darker maroon wing membranes, a spiked tail and tall pointed head crest. Strong hind legs with curved talons, glowing yellow eyes and a fleshy neck frill.

Rathalos Tempered.aparencia: Powerful winged wyvern with thickened red scales, ridged horn plates on its brow and wings edged in darker armor-like growth. Wide chest with glowing orange cracks, long barbed tail and fierce yellow eyes.

Rathalos Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Huge winged wyvern with dark blood-red scales hardened into thick overlapping plates, massive curved horns and a black-gold crest. Orange fire glows between the armor seams, wings spiked with bony ridges.

Rathalos Apex.aparencia: Enormous winged wyvern with thick crimson scales streaked with white, a jutting beak-like jaw and long swept-back head spikes. Muscular legs, wide wings with torn edges and a deep chest ready to breathe fire.

Rathalos Deviant.aparencia: Twisted winged wyvern with sickly mottled red and bruise-purple scales, uneven horns and one wing larger than the other. Bulging yellow eyes, a swollen throat, patches of raw skin and a lopsided barbed tail.

Rathian Subespécie.aparencia: Large winged wyvern with white-pink scales over a lighter belly, a short spiked tail and a rounded head with small crest spines. Strong hind legs, folded wings with a hooked claw and a venomous tail stinger.

Rathian Variante.aparencia: Large winged wyvern with dark emerald green scales, a golden-tinted belly and a thick tail bristling with spines. Broad head with short horns, bright amber eyes and a stout, forward-leaning stance.

Rathian Tempered.aparencia: Heavy winged wyvern with thickened green scales and ridged horn-like plates over the back, wings edged in dark bony armor. Orange glow in the neck cracks, an oversized spiked tail and fierce amber eyes.

Rathian Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Large green-scaled flying wyvern with a hardened, darker-green hide and chipped horns. Spined tail ends in a thick venom stinger; the body looks battle-toughened and heavy.

Rathian Apex.aparencia: Green wyvern with a strangely glossy, gold-tinged hide and swollen muscular neck. Stands tall on powerful legs, wings half-flared, tail stinger bristling with extra barbs.

Rathian Deviant.aparencia: Mottled green wyvern with sickly purple patches along the spine and jagged, overgrown spikes. Mismatched swollen legs and a twisted stinger tail give it a lopsided, aggressive gait.

Diablos Subespécie.aparencia: Heavy horned wyvern recolored in dusty black and rust, with shorter, thicker horns and a wide skull. The back plates are rough and bone-white along the edges.

Diablos Tempered.aparencia: Bulky desert wyvern in dark brown plates, with broad scarred horns and a spiked back ridge. Its hardened hide shows layered, rocky scales, and it stands braced on thick legs.

Diablos Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Armored sand-brown wyvern with deep ridges in its curling horns and rock-like shoulder plates. Dust clings to its cracked hide; it stands massive, head lowered to charge.

Diablos Apex.aparencia: Enormous horned wyvern with horns glowing faintly orange at the base and glossy brown plates streaked with red. Heavy, wide shoulders and a thick spiked tail anchor its stance.

Diablos Deviant.aparencia: Gnarled desert wyvern with cracked, discolored hide and one horn longer than the other. Pale sores mark the flanks, and the thick tail is lined with uneven, jagged spikes.

Tigrex Subespécie.aparencia: Tiger-striped wyvern with a lean build, pale blue-grey fur-like scales and dark bands. Massive wing-forelimbs fold under a broad chest; fangs bared in a wide, snarling maw.

Tigrex Variante.aparencia: Bipedal wyvern with ember-red scales banded in black stripes and scorched, blackened forelimbs. The jaws are wide and sharp, with a stout tail held low and heavy.

Tigrex Tempered.aparencia: Stout, striped wyvern with a hardened, deep-blue hide and thick, tough forelimbs. Its jaw is armored in bony ridges, and it stands braced like a tough fighter.

Tigrex Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Striped wyvern with a dense, steel-tinted hide and broad muscle across the shoulders. Wing-arms are scarred and callused, jaw plated with bone, and its stance is low and menacing.

Tigrex Apex.aparencia: Powerful striped wyvern with an unusually dark, glossy hide and thick banded muscles. Forelimb-wings are heavily calloused and the eyes burn with a bright, restless yellow.

Tigrex Deviant.aparencia: Hulking striped wyvern with a grey-purple hide, ragged skin hanging from the neck and uneven, swollen forelimbs. Fangs jut out crookedly from a lopsided jaw.

Nargacuga Subespécie.aparencia: Lean panther-like wyvern with glossy white-grey scales and razor-edged wing spikes. Slit pale eyes and a long tail studded with blade-like quills; moves in a low crouch.

Nargacuga Variante.aparencia: Sleek black wyvern with an amber-orange underbelly and sharper, longer wing blades. Its glowing green eyes narrow over a feline face, tail bristling with quills.

Nargacuga Tempered.aparencia: Panther-shaped wyvern in matte black with hardened scale plating and glinting blade spines. Large pointed ears flick forward, and it holds a taut, ready crouch.

Nargacuga Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Jet-black wyvern whose plates have a metallic, layered look and whose wing and tail blades are noticeably longer. Eyes shine a vivid green; the body is lean but dense.

Nargacuga Apex.aparencia: Feline wyvern in deep midnight scales with silvery blade edges on wings and tail. Muscles ripple under a stretched, ready posture; eyes glow a cold, intense green.

Nargacuga Deviant.aparencia: Gaunt, panther-like wyvern with dull grey-green skin, uneven snapped spines and patchy, torn scales. The eyes are clouded and the tail blades curve in crooked directions.

Zinogre Subespécie.aparencia: Wolf-shaped wyvern with thick pale-blue fur, long black forelimbs and a curved horn on its brow. Violet streaks mark the mane, and crackling blue-white sparks cling to the tail tip.

Zinogre Variante.aparencia: Wolf-like wyvern with violet-black fur and a pale mane tinged with purple. Its curved brow horn is sharp and its pale claws look elongated and thin.

Zinogre Tempered.aparencia: Wolfish wyvern with dense blue-grey fur and thick, tough hide beneath. Brow horn is broad and notched, and stout, muscular legs support a heavy stance.

Zinogre Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Wolf-like wyvern with a luminous blue mane and heavy, armored forelimbs. Faint arcs of light trace its horn and shoulders, and fangs gleam in a deep-set jaw.

Zinogre Apex.aparencia: Imposing wolf-wyvern with a dazzling white-blue mane, thick muscle and a tall curved horn. Claws are overgrown, and bright sparks outline the entire body.

Zinogre Deviant.aparencia: Mangy wolf-like wyvern with thin, patchy fur in dull grey-violet and an asymmetrical, chipped horn. Limbs are over-long and awkward, and the ribs show through its hide.

Brachydios Subespécie.aparencia: Lumbering brute with a turquoise-green body, thick club-like forearms and a hunched slug-like back. Knobby, bony growths ring the knuckles, and its skin glistens damply.

Brachydios Variante.aparencia: Hulking brute with orange-red skin and black clublike fists crusted with cooled rock. Hunched shoulders and short legs; knobs of hardened growth sit along its back.

Brachydios Tempered.aparencia: Slug-backed brute with heavy fists in hardened, dark-green crust and a broad, scarred head. Thick short limbs and rugged, bumpy hide give a solid, planted stance.

Brachydios Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Massive hunched brute with armor-like crusts over both fists and a dense, deep-green hide. Short thick legs and a heavy brow; it looks like a walking boulder.

Brachydios Apex.aparencia: Giant slug-backed brute with shiny, wet-looking skin in vivid green and fists coated in a glowing orange crust. Its shoulders are wide and its brow is deeply ridged.

Brachydios Deviant.aparencia: Bloated, twisted brute with sagging grey-green skin and one fist swollen to twice the size of the other. Bony knobs jut out unevenly and the posture is lopsided.

Gore Magala Subespécie.aparencia: Winged black wyvern with a single curved horn, fine glittering dust trailing off the wings and a slender hunched body. Eyes glow pale, and the head tapers into a sharp beak-like point.

Gore Magala Variante.aparencia: Dark-violet winged wyvern with a frilled, insect-like head, a single curved horn and tattered, membranous wings. Fine powdery scales shed from the limbs; its body is thin and hunched.

Gore Magala Tempered.aparencia: Slim black winged wyvern with a thick, ridged shell along the back and a single horn. Wings are tattered and layered with dusty scale patches; red eyes glow dimly.

Gore Magala Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Insect-like winged wyvern with armored dark plates over the back and a long, curved horn. Powdery scale dust drifts from heavy wings, and its pose is hunched and predatory.

Gore Magala Apex.aparencia: Dark, bat-like winged wyvern with a faintly iridescent shell and a long single horn. Wings carry ghostly dust patches, and the head tapers like a blade.

Gore Magala Deviant.aparencia: Frail, fungus-colored winged wyvern with a cracked shell, lopsided horn and ragged, rotting wing membranes. Pale dust leaks from gaps in its plates, and the legs are thin and crooked.

Nergigante Subespécie.aparencia: Dragon with a black hide covered in long, thick bone-white spikes, a ridged brow and large horns. Its limbs are heavy with muscle and its wings are broad and spiny.

Nergigante Tempered.aparencia: Black-bodied dragon with a wall of thick white spikes and a hardened, nearly stone-like hide. Horns are broad and ridged, and the limbs are heavy, claws gripping the ground.

Nergigante Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Dragon in charcoal black with bone-white spikes layered heavily over shoulders, tail and wing arms. Horns are thick and flared, and the body looks hardened and overbuilt.

Nergigante Apex.aparencia: Huge spined dragon with black hide and gleaming white spikes that crowd its entire back and tail. Horns curve forward and its large wings are lined with glossy bone-white blades.

Nergigante Deviant.aparencia: Hunched spined dragon with ash-grey skin, warped broken spikes and sunken eyes. One horn is snapped off and the ribs show; the wing arms are thin and uneven.

Velkhana Subespécie.aparencia: Elegant dragon with a sleek, pale-blue body, long neck, crystal-like frost plates and wide wings. Horns sweep backward; a white mane of frost hangs around the head.

Velkhana Variante.aparencia: Slender, long-necked dragon in deep sapphire blue with dark glassy plates and a pale mane. Wings are broad with translucent membranes, and the horns are narrow and silver.

Velkhana Tempered.aparencia: Tall dragon in pale blue with thick frost-colored armor on shoulders and tail and wide, ridged wings. Its long neck carries a heavy crown of ice-white horns.

Velkhana Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Majestic blue-white dragon with layered crystal plates and thick bony armor. Its wings are wide, with long ice-colored spars, and the horns sweep back like a crown.

Velkhana Apex.aparencia: Large, graceful dragon with icy translucent wing membranes and glittering white scales. Long, graceful neck, wide wings and horns that gleam with a pearly shine.

Velkhana Deviant.aparencia: Gaunt dragon with dull grey-blue scales, cloudy ice-like growths on the shoulders and torn wing membranes. Neck bends awkwardly and one horn is cracked and dull.

Kushala Daora Subespécie.aparencia: Slender, long-necked dragon with silvery-grey metallic armor plates, sweeping curved horns and wide wings. A smooth, streamlined build with sharp, angular edges.

Kushala Daora Variante.aparencia: Silver-grey dragon with a paler, whitish tint and layered armor plates along the neck and tail. Its wings are broad with sharp edges, and the horns curve back sleekly.

Kushala Daora Tempered.aparencia: Heavy-set armored dragon with dull steel plating and thick, ridged horns. Broad wings with scarred, notched edges and a strong, upright posture.

Kushala Daora Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Gleaming steel-colored dragon with plates fused thickly across the neck, shoulders and tail. The horns are long and angular and the wings are wide and razor-edged.

Kushala Daora Apex.aparencia: Majestic dragon wrapped in bright, polished armor in white-silver. Wings are broad with sharp spars, horns sweep backward and the eyes shine a cool pale blue.

Kushala Daora Deviant.aparencia: Tarnished dragon with rusted grey-brown plates, a stretched neck and ragged, notched wings. One horn is bent and the chest sinks in; the body looks worn and brittle.

Teostra Subespécie.aparencia: Lion-like dragon with a flowing red-and-white mane, broad curved horns and thick golden-tan scales. Wings are wide and ridged, and the tail ends in a heavy, plated club.

Teostra Variante.aparencia: Dragon with a deep crimson mane and dark ember-orange scales. Its horns are long and sharply curved, wings are broad with thick spars, and the stance is regal.

Teostra Tempered.aparencia: Big, muscular lion-like dragon with a ruddy mane and heavily scarred, thick hide. Horns are broad and chipped, and scorched patches mark its shoulders and wings.

Teostra Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Majestic dragon with a vast, flame-colored mane and plated golden-red scales. Horns curve like crescents and a thick plated tail trails behind a proud, upright stance.

Teostra Apex.aparencia: Towering lion-dragon with a radiant orange-white mane, large gleaming horns and polished gold-red scales. Broad wings and a heavy club-like tail anchor a commanding build.

Teostra Deviant.aparencia: Gaunt lion-like dragon with a ragged, singed mane in dull rust and ash, uneven horns and sagging, mottled scales. Wings are torn and the posture is crooked.

Lunastra Subespécie.aparencia: Lioness-like dragon with a flowing blue-white mane, slender horns and sleek dark-blue scales. Wings are wide, and the tail carries a plated, blunt tip.

Lunastra Variante.aparencia: Dragon with a mane of ember-orange and soft violet, sleek scaled body in dark purple and graceful curved horns. Wings are broad and spidery; the build is slimmer than a bull's.

Lunastra Tempered.aparencia: Stout blue-white maned dragon with thick, scarred plates and heavily ridged horns. Its wings are strong and the tail is armored, with a firm, braced stance.

Lunastra Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Dragon with a thick, flaring mane in cold blue and silver, scales in a deep indigo and notably long, swept-back horns. The body is muscular and the wings wide and thick.

Lunastra Apex.aparencia: Elegant dragon with a shimmering blue-silver mane and glossy indigo scales. Horns curve gracefully, wings are wide, and the whole body glows with a faint pale sheen.

Lunastra Deviant.aparencia: Sickly dragon with a thinning, grey-blue mane, discolored mottled scales and warped horns. Wings hang tattered, and the body is thin with sunken, glassy eyes.

Rajang Subespécie.aparencia: Muscular ape-like beast with thick golden-yellow fur standing up in spikes, long powerful arms and a pair of horns above a snarling face. Tail is short and sharp-furred.

Rajang Variante.aparencia: Ape-like beast with shaggy white-silver fur, huge arms and a pair of twisted horns. Its eyes are narrow and glowing red, and the whole body stands in a hunched, tense posture.

Rajang Tempered.aparencia: Burly ape-like beast with dark golden fur, a thick neck and heavy arms scarred with old wounds. Horns are short and blunt, and it hunches forward with clenched fists.

Rajang Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Giant ape-like beast with spiky, deep-gold fur and thick, corded muscle. Brow ridge is heavy, horns are long, and the arms are overly long and ropy.

Rajang Apex.aparencia: Powerful ape-beast with bright gold fur that bristles upward like needles, and enormous arms. Its horns curve forward and its face is twisted in a permanent snarl.

Rajang Deviant.aparencia: Mangy, hunched ape-like beast with matted grey-gold fur, uneven horns and arms of different lengths. Eyes are bloodshot and the mouth is crooked and fanged.

Deviljho Subespécie.aparencia: Bulky, green, theropod-like brute with a huge, wide jaw, tiny forearms and a deeply scarred hide. Skin is slick with a mossy sheen; ridged spines run along the back.

Deviljho Variante.aparencia: Large theropod-like brute with a ruddy, blood-colored hide and a gaping jaw full of jagged teeth. Short arms, thick tail, and a ridged crest; belly paler and heavily scarred.

Deviljho Tempered.aparencia: Hulking dark-green theropod with a rough, armored hide and a wide jaw with thick, uneven teeth. It stands low with a thick tail and its body is crowded with old scars.

Deviljho Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Enormous heavyset theropod with a hardened green-black hide and sturdy, rocky ridges over the shoulders. Its jaw is broad and bone-armored, and the tail is thick and heavy.

Deviljho Apex.aparencia: Giant theropod with scaled, dusty olive hide and heavily ridged plates along neck and back. A huge jaw sits on a thick neck, with tiny arms hanging in front.

Deviljho Deviant.aparencia: Skeletal, hungry-looking theropod with pale green, sagging skin and a jaw too wide for its head. Ribs show through, the teeth are jagged, and one arm is stunted.

Bazelgeuse Subespécie.aparencia: Armored wyvern in dark green with ember-red scales along its back and wings, and a stocky, thick-limbed build. Its wide wings carry pale, chipped plates.

Bazelgeuse Variante.aparencia: Stout wyvern with deep-black scales and orange-lit scale plates along its back. Wings are broad, the chest is deep and thick, and the head carries blunt, hardened horns.

Bazelgeuse Tempered.aparencia: Heavy wyvern with thickened dark-green plates, brighter orange scale edges and a rugged, scarred snout. Wings are broad, claws large, and the stance is wide and strong.

Bazelgeuse Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Stocky armored wyvern with tough, overlapping green-black plates tipped in glowing orange and a broad head. It looks heavier and more densely built than its kin.

Bazelgeuse Apex.aparencia: Massive wyvern with glossy dark plates and rows of luminous orange scales on its back and wings. Its head is blunt with a heavy brow, and the tail is thick and tapered.

Bazelgeuse Deviant.aparencia: Hunched wyvern with scorched, blackened plates, cracked orange scales and a crooked jaw. One wing is shorter than the other and the body is gaunt and singed.

Anjanath Subespécie.aparencia: Tyrannosaur-like beast with dusty rust-brown feathers around a thick neck, a flat red nasal crest and a broad, muscular chest. Strong hind legs and a heavy, tapered tail.

Anjanath Variante.aparencia: Large theropod with a dense blue-grey coat of feathers and a blunt nose crest in pale orange. Its legs are thick, its jaw is strong, and a deep chest balances a thick tail.

Anjanath Tempered.aparencia: Heavy theropod with a shaggy, darker-brown mane of feathers and a reddened, scarred nose crest. Jaw is thick, claws long, and the tail is held low and heavy.

Anjanath Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Powerful theropod with scarred, armored skin under thick fur-like plumes and a broad, rust-colored nasal crest. Legs are tree-trunk thick, and its stance is wide and braced.

Anjanath Apex.aparencia: Huge feathered theropod with a bright, glowing orange nose crest, a thick ruddy mane and large, muscled hind legs. Eyes are small, and the tail ends in a blunt tip.

Anjanath Deviant.aparencia: Lean, feathered theropod with ragged, patchy plumage and a cracked, blackened crest. The ribs are visible, the jaw is crooked, and it limps on uneven legs.

Pukei-Pukei Subespécie.aparencia: Chameleon-like bird wyvern with a long, thick tongue, a curled, flower-tipped tail and mottled green-brown skin. Wings are small and its beak is wide and slightly hooked.

Pukei-Pukei Variante.aparencia: Chameleon-like wyvern in vivid orange-and-teal patches, with a coiled tail tipped in a bright, bulb-shaped bloom. A long, ropy tongue hangs from a wide beak.

Pukei-Pukei Tempered.aparencia: Stocky chameleon-like wyvern with a rough hide of dark green and olive and a thick curled tail with a spiky bloom at its tip. Beak is large and heavily ridged.

Pukei-Pukei Arch-Tempered.aparencia: Large chameleon-like wyvern with thick layered scales in forest green and a coiled tail crowned with a large bulbous flower. Long tongue; wide beak with a hardened rim.

Pukei-Pukei Deviant.aparencia: Frail chameleon-like wyvern with wilting, greyish-green skin, a drooping tail whose flower has shriveled and a long, pale tongue dragging low from a crooked beak.

Rabite Verde.aparencia: Small round rabbit-like creature with a plump, light-green body, long drooping ears and a single dark hungry-looking mouth. Tiny stubby legs and a bobbing yellow tuft on its head.

Rabite Vermelho.aparencia: Round, plump rabbit-like creature with a bright red body, long drooping ears and tiny paws. Its eyes are large and dark, and a fluffy tuft sits on its forehead.

Rabite Azul.aparencia: Plump rabbit-like creature with a soft blue body and wide, drooping ears. Stubby legs and a rounded belly, with a little tuft of fur between the ears.

Rabite Místico.aparencia: Round rabbit-like creature with a pale, shimmering lilac body and long, floating ears tipped in white. A tiny glow sits above the dark eyes, and the legs are small and stubby.

Rabite Chefe.aparencia: Oversized round yellow rabbit-like beast with a fat belly, long drooping ears, tiny fangs and a thick scarred hide. Squats heavily on stubby legs, glaring with small beady eyes.

Rabite Sombrio.aparencia: Plump round rabbit-like critter with charcoal-purple fur, long limp ears and glowing red eyes. Its mouth shows jagged little teeth, and a dark haze clings to its stubby feet.

Mushboom Verde.aparencia: Walking mushroom with a wide moss-green cap dotted with pale spots, a stubby cream stalk body, tiny feet and small round black eyes. Waddles upright with short arm nubs.

Mushboom Vermelho.aparencia: Walking mushroom with a glossy scarlet cap covered in white warts, a thick pale stalk and stubby legs. Looks poisonous, with a sulky slit mouth and narrowed eyes.

Mushboom Azul.aparencia: Walking mushroom with a cool cobalt cap, damp and shiny as if dewy, over a smooth whitish stalk. Short rounded legs and wide calm eyes give it a drowsy, squishy look.

Mushboom Chefe.aparencia: Hulking mushroom with a broad cap wider than a barrel, thick knobby stalk, bulging root-like legs and cracked bark-like skin. Tiny angry eyes peer from beneath the heavy cap rim.

Mushboom Sombrio.aparencia: Walking mushroom with a blackish-violet cap, ragged gills dripping dark spores and a withered gray stalk. Hollow glowing eyes and a crooked mouth give it a sickly menace.

Lullabud Verde.aparencia: Bulb-like flower creature with a closed green bud head, leafy arms, a squat stem body and small root feet. Sleepy half-lidded eyes sit on the swollen bud.

Lullabud Vermelho.aparencia: Flower creature with a crimson tulip-like bud for a head, ruffled red petals and a short green stalk body. Thorny leaf arms hang loose; its droopy eyes look half asleep.

Lullabud Azul.aparencia: Flower creature with a sapphire-blue bud head, soft rounded petals and a teal stem body. Dewdrops cling to its leaves, and its heavy-lidded eyes give it a dreamy look.

Lullabud Místico.aparencia: Flower creature with a violet-and-silver bud head ringed by glimmering petals, a slender pale stem and curled leaf arms. Faint sparkling pollen drifts around its serene closed eyes.

Lullabud Chefe.aparencia: Giant bud-headed plant with a swollen bulb as large as a boulder, thick vine arms, a knotted trunk-like stem and gnarled root legs. Thorns stud its hide and its eyes are stern slits.

Lullabud Sombrio.aparencia: Wilting flower creature with a blackened bud head, curled purple-gray petals and a sagging bent stem. Thorny vine arms trail, and its sunken eyes glow a dim sickly yellow.

Spidoc Verde.aparencia: Bulbous spider with a green abdomen, eight thin jointed legs and a cluster of small red eyes. Its fat body is mottled with darker stripes and it crouches low to the ground.

Spidoc Vermelho.aparencia: Round-bodied spider with a bright crimson abdomen marked by black hourglass-like patches, eight spindly legs and glossy black eyes. Fangs are visible and twitch as it crawls.

Spidoc Azul.aparencia: Spider with a deep blue abdomen speckled with pale dots, eight slender legs ending in sharp tips and many shiny eyes. Its body looks smooth and slightly damp.

Spidoc Místico.aparencia: Spider with a violet abdomen etched with faint glowing silver swirls, long delicate legs and a ring of pale luminous eyes. Fine shimmering threads trail behind it.

Spidoc Chefe.aparencia: Enormous spider with a hairy, armored abdomen, thick spiked legs as long as a person is tall and a wide mouth of dripping fangs. Many small eyes glint across its bristled head.

Spidoc Sombrio.aparencia: Black spider with a gaunt violet-tinged abdomen, long needle-thin legs and glowing red eyes. Pale smoky wisps rise from its body and its fangs are curved and long.

Chobin Hood Verde.aparencia: Small rabbit-eared archer in a green hooded tunic with a feathered cap, leather boots and a short bow with a quiver on the back. Wiry and quick, with a sly grin.

Chobin Hood Vermelho.aparencia: Small long-eared archer wearing a red hooded tunic, a plumed cap and a scarf, carrying a short bow and a quiver of crimson-fletched arrows. Light on its feet with a cocky stance.

Chobin Hood Azul.aparencia: Small long-eared archer in a blue hooded tunic with a pale-feathered cap and a short bow slung forward. Slim build, light boots and watchful half-closed eyes.

Chobin Hood Místico.aparencia: Small long-eared archer in a violet cloak trimmed with silver thread, a star-pinned cap and a short bow with a glimmering string. Slender and poised, with bright sharp eyes.

Chobin Hood Chefe.aparencia: Broad-shouldered long-eared archer in a heavy hooded jerkin with metal shoulder plates, a large longbow and a fat quiver. Scarred face, thick arms and a commanding stance.

Chobin Hood Sombrio.aparencia: Small long-eared archer wrapped in a tattered black hooded cloak with a torn cap, gripping a dark bow with a frayed string. Red eyes glow beneath the hood and the ears are ragged.

Goblin Verde.aparencia: Short green-skinned humanoid with a big pointed nose, long ears, a wide toothy grin and a patched loincloth. Wiry limbs, hunched posture and a crude wooden club in hand.

Goblin Vermelho.aparencia: Short red-skinned humanoid with sharp ears, a hooked nose and yellow eyes, wearing a scorched leather vest. Stringy muscles, a snarl full of crooked teeth and a rusty short sword.

Goblin Azul.aparencia: Short blue-skinned humanoid with wide floppy ears, a damp-looking hide and bulging pale eyes. Wears a ragged vest and carries a bent spear, standing in a crouched wary pose.

Goblin Místico.aparencia: Short violet-skinned humanoid with long pointed ears, glowing white eyes and a tall crooked hat. Draped in a stitched robe with bead trinkets, clutching a gnarled twisted staff.

Goblin Chefe.aparencia: Large muscular green-skinned humanoid with a heavy jaw, tusk-like teeth, a spiked iron collar and shoulder armor of scrap plates. Hauls a huge studded mace and stands tall and menacing.

Moldy Goo Verde.aparencia: Lumpy puddle-like blob of murky green ooze covered in patches of fuzzy mold. Two dull eyes float in its surface, and sticky strands droop from its sagging mass.

Moldy Goo Vermelho.aparencia: Glossy blob of reddish-brown ooze streaked with orange mold spots and small bubbling pustules. Squats flat with two bleary eyes and thick dripping tendrils.

Moldy Goo Azul.aparencia: Wet blue-gray blob of ooze coated in pale fuzzy mold and beaded with droplets. Two sunken eyes stare from a jiggling surface, and slimy threads stretch toward the ground.

Moldy Goo Místico.aparencia: Translucent violet blob of ooze with glittering spores suspended inside and dusty silvery mold along its crest. Two pale glowing eyes drift within its quivering body.

Moldy Goo Chefe.aparencia: Towering mound of thick olive ooze studded with shelf-like mold growths and bone-like lumps. Several uneven eyes sit across its mass and heavy folds slump over a wide gaping mouth.

Moldy Goo Sombrio.aparencia: Black tar-like blob riddled with gray rot and dark spore clusters. Hollow glowing eyes peer from its sagging surface and oily threads trail from the base.

Slime Verde.aparencia: Small dome-shaped blob of glossy translucent green jelly with two black dot eyes and a tiny curved mouth. Its surface wobbles and a little drip pools underneath.

Slime Vermelho.aparencia: Small teardrop-shaped blob of glossy translucent red jelly with warm orange highlights, bright eyes and a smirking mouth. Its surface seems to shimmer as if warm.

Slime Azul.aparencia: Small dome-shaped blob of clear blue jelly with a pointed tip on top, round black eyes and a soft smile. Its body is smooth, cool-looking and slightly see-through.

Slime Místico.aparencia: Small blob of violet jelly with tiny glittering stars suspended inside, a faintly glowing core and bright white eyes. The surface has a soft pearly sheen.

Slime Chefe.aparencia: Compact but thick blob of dense dark green jelly with a crown-like ridge of spikes on its crown, heavy-lidded angry eyes and a wide fanged mouth. Bubbles rise within its body.

Slime Sombrio.aparencia: Small blob of murky black-purple jelly with a faint oily sheen, narrow glowing red eyes and a jagged grin. Dark wisps curl from its dripping surface.

Eye Spy Verde.aparencia: Floating round creature that is one big bloodshot eyeball with a green iris, fringed by short tentacles and tiny bat-like wings. A faint veiny texture covers its pale lid.

Eye Spy Vermelho.aparencia: Hovering sphere dominated by a single large eye with a burning red iris and slit pupil, ringed by wriggling stalks. Small leathery wings flap beneath a thick veined lid.

Eye Spy Azul.aparencia: Floating orb with one large icy-blue eye, wet and glossy, trailing thin tentacles below and flapping tiny fins on each side. Its pupil is a small black dot.

Eye Spy Místico.aparencia: Floating orb with one large eye whose violet iris swirls like glass, set in a smooth pale body trimmed by wispy tendrils and delicate translucent wings. Fine specks glitter around it.

Eye Spy Chefe.aparencia: Large hovering sphere with a huge central eye, a thick leathery lid and a hide of dark ridges. A mass of heavy tentacles hangs beneath and broad batlike wings keep it aloft.

Eye Spy Sombrio.aparencia: Floating dark sphere with a single sunken eye, a glowing crimson pupil and a ragged black lid. Thin shadowy tendrils dangle below, and tattered wings flutter at its sides.

Spiny Cone Verde.aparencia: Cone-shaped shellfish with a pointed green shell ringed by sharp spines, a soft fleshy foot at the base and two small stalked eyes peeking out of the opening.

Spiny Cone Vermelho.aparencia: Tall spiral cone shell in deep red with sharp thorn-like spikes along each ridge. A pale fleshy body and two stalked eyes emerge from the opening at the base.

Spiny Cone Azul.aparencia: Pointed cone-shaped shell in glossy blue with rows of short spines and a wet shine. A smooth gray body and two stalked eyes poke out from beneath.

Spiny Cone Místico.aparencia: Tall cone shell with a pearly violet sheen, spines of translucent crystal and faint glowing patterns on its surface. Two stalked eyes shine softly from the opening.

Spiny Cone Chefe.aparencia: Very large cone shell of thick dark olive plating with long, heavy, curved spikes along its spiral. A bulky fleshy foot supports it, and two stalked eyes glare from the dark opening.

Spiny Cone Sombrio.aparencia: Black cone shell with pitted, chipped surface and jagged spikes streaked in purple. A gray slimy body leaks from the opening, with two glowing red stalked eyes.

Polter Box Verde.aparencia: Wooden chest hovering above the ground with a green glow leaking from its seams. Its lid flaps open to show a toothy mouth and a floppy tongue, and two glowing eyes sit above the latch.

Polter Box Vermelho.aparencia: Floating treasure chest with red-painted planks, iron corner bands and a reddish glow from inside. The lid gapes to reveal sharp teeth and a lolling tongue; slit eyes burn on the front.

Polter Box Azul.aparencia: Drifting wooden chest in faded blue with pale mist seeping from under the lid. A row of crooked teeth lines its mouth and two watery white eyes glimmer on its face.

Polter Box Místico.aparencia: Floating chest of dark wood inlaid with silver runes and a violet glow along the seams. Its lid opens on a ring of crystalline teeth, with starry eyes above the lock.

Polter Box Chefe.aparencia: Huge floating chest bound in thick iron bands and heavy studs, with a lid that gapes wide over rows of fangs and a long tongue. Fierce eyes glow from its front and chains dangle from the sides.

Polter Box Sombrio.aparencia: Charred, cracked black chest hovering in a cold haze, with splintered boards and a lid hanging askew. Rows of pale jagged teeth show inside and two red eyes smolder on the front.

Cursed Doll Verde.aparencia: Stitched cloth doll with a green patchwork body, button eyes of mismatched sizes and a crooked sewn-on smile. Loose threads dangle from its seams and its limbs hang unevenly.

Cursed Doll Azul.aparencia: Worn rag doll in faded blue fabric with dark stains, one cracked glass eye and one missing button. Its stitched grin is torn and stuffing pokes through at the shoulders.

Cursed Doll Místico.aparencia: Violet cloth doll sewn with silver thread in strange looping patterns, with glowing white button eyes and a thin stitched mouth. Small sparkling charms are tied to its wrists.

Cursed Doll Chefe.aparencia: Oversized patchwork doll with a heavy lumpy body, thick stitched limbs and large mismatched button eyes. Rusty pins and iron nails are driven through its coarse fabric and its seam-mouth gapes wide.

Cursed Doll Sombrio.aparencia: Tattered black rag doll with ragged seams leaking gray stuffing, hollow red button eyes and a long ripped grin. Its limbs bend at odd angles and loose threads trail like hair.

Specter Verde.aparencia: Pale translucent ghost with a green tint, a wispy tail instead of legs and long hanging arms. Its hollow eyes and gaping mouth glow dimly, and the edges of its body fade like mist.

Specter Vermelho.aparencia: Translucent ghost with a reddish glow, a tapering wispy tail and thin clawed hands. Ember-like eyes burn in a gaunt skull-like face, and its body flickers at the edges.

Specter Azul.aparencia: Cold bluish ghost with a see-through body that trails into a misty tail, long drifting arms and hollow white eyes. Its form drips faintly and looks chilled.

Specter Místico.aparencia: Violet ghost with a shimmering translucent body, fine glowing lines along its arms and a flowing tail of pale smoke. Its calm hollow eyes glow white, and tiny motes orbit its head.

Specter Chefe.aparencia: Towering ghost with a broad, dense smoky body, a crown of jagged ethereal spikes and long heavy claws. Its eyes burn in a deep skull-like face and its tail coils behind it.

Specter Sombrio.aparencia: Black shadowy ghost with a ragged cloak-like body that dissolves into dark smoke, skeletal hands and two glowing red eyes in an empty face. No legs, only a tattered trailing tail.

Skeleton Verde.aparencia: Walking set of bones stained mossy green, with a grinning skull, cracked ribs and a rusty short blade. Greenish light glows in the empty eye sockets and its joints creak as it lurches forward.

Skeleton Vermelho.aparencia: Walking bones tinted rust-red and scorched at the edges, with a grinning skull and dull red glow in its eye sockets. Carries a notched axe and a dented round shield.

Skeleton Azul.aparencia: Walking bones with a cold bluish tint, damp and slick, with a grinning skull and pale icy glow in the sockets. Holds a chipped spear and its jaw hangs slightly open.

Skeleton Místico.aparencia: Slender bones the color of old ivory etched with violet runes, a tattered hooded cloak and a skull with glowing purple sockets. Clutches a crooked wooden staff topped with a crystal.

Skeleton Chefe.aparencia: Giant bone warrior with a horned skull, thick ribs and iron plates bolted to its shoulders and shins. Wields a huge cleaver, and a dark fire burns in its sockets.

Chess Knight Verde.aparencia: Carved horse-headed game piece standing as a body of green-stained stone, with a long arched neck, flowing stone mane and blank glowing eyes. Stiff legs and a heavy rounded base.

Chess Knight Vermelho.aparencia: Red lacquered horse-headed game piece come alive, with a curved neck, carved mane and flared nostrils. Hard polished body, hoofed legs and a solid round base; eyes are bright dots.

Chess Knight Azul.aparencia: Blue marble horse-headed game piece with veined stone skin, an arched neck and a chiseled mane. Pale eyes shine from a smooth face and it stands on a wide circular plinth.

Chess Knight Místico.aparencia: Horse-headed game piece of translucent violet crystal with silver veins, an elegant curved neck and a mane of glass shards. Starry light glows inside its body, set on a round base.

Chess Knight Chefe.aparencia: Massive horse-headed game piece of dark iron with riveted plates, a crested mane of blades and heavy hooves. Its blank eyes glow orange and its thick base is ringed in studs.

Chess Knight Sombrio.aparencia: Cracked black horse-headed game piece with chipped stone, a jagged mane and a long neck wreathed in dark smoke. Red pinpoint eyes glow and the base is scorched.

Dullahan Verde.aparencia: Headless rider in dark armor tinted green with moss and verdigris, holding its own pale head under one arm. Sits on a black horse with smoking nostrils and glowing eyes.

Dullahan Vermelho.aparencia: Headless rider in blood-red scorched armor, its severed head tucked under one arm with a fiery glare. Mounted on a black steed whose hooves trail sparks and steam.

Dullahan Azul.aparencia: Headless rider in cold blue-tinged armor beaded with frost, carrying its pallid head under one arm. Its black horse breathes pale steam and has icy white eyes.

Dullahan Místico.aparencia: Headless rider in slim violet armor engraved with silver sigils, holding its own head, which glows softly, under an arm. Its dark horse has a mane of drifting smoke and starry eyes.

Dullahan Chefe.aparencia: Towering headless rider in thick black plate with jagged pauldrons, a grim severed head cradled in one arm and a long whip in the other. Its massive steed has smoking nostrils and burning eyes.

Dullahan Sombrio.aparencia: Headless rider in tattered black armor that bleeds into shadow, a gaunt grinning head held under one arm. Its ink-black horse is half-smoke with glowing red eyes and steaming breath.

Dragon Verde.aparencia: Huge winged reptile with moss-green scales, a long neck and tail, a horned head and leathery wings. Pale belly plates, sharp claws and a calm heavy-lidded gaze.

Dragon Vermelho.aparencia: Huge winged reptile with deep crimson scales, a spiked back ridge, curved horns and broad leathery wings. Glowing orange eyes, powerful clawed limbs and a barbed tail.

Dragon Azul.aparencia: Huge winged reptile with sleek blue scales, a pale underbelly, finned head crests and wide membranous wings. Long slender neck, webbed claws and a smooth glossy hide.

Dragon Místico.aparencia: Huge winged reptile with pearly violet scales shot with silver, a graceful long neck and a pair of slender swept-back horns. Translucent wings glimmer and faint stars dot its hide.

Dragon Chefe.aparencia: Colossal winged reptile with thick dark scale armor, a crown of curved horns and bony spikes along its spine. Torn wing membranes, scarred snout, huge claws and a heavy club-tipped tail.

Dragon Sombrio.aparencia: Huge winged reptile with black scales dulled to charcoal, ragged wing membranes and thorny horns. Glowing red eyes, a gaunt ribbed frame and thin dark smoke leaking from its jaws.

Land Dragon Verde.aparencia: Huge wingless reptile on four thick legs with mossy green scales, a blunt horned head and a heavy swaying tail. Broad ribcage, flat clawed feet and small dull eyes.

Land Dragon Vermelho.aparencia: Huge wingless reptile on four stout legs with rust-red scales, ridged brow horns and a long thick tail. Heavily muscled shoulders, blunt claws and a low menacing stance.

Land Dragon Azul.aparencia: Huge wingless reptile on four legs with slate-blue scales, a broad flat head with short horns and a webbed neck frill. Thick tail, wide feet and glossy damp skin.

Land Dragon Místico.aparencia: Huge wingless reptile on four legs with violet scales dusted with silver flecks, curved crystal-like horns and a long tapering tail. Faint glowing marks run along its flanks.

Land Dragon Chefe.aparencia: Enormous wingless reptile with thick armored plates, a ring of heavy horns around its skull and a spiked club of a tail. Scarred hide, pillar-like legs and a huge fanged maw.

Land Dragon Sombrio.aparencia: Huge wingless reptile with black cracked scales, jagged horns and a gaunt bony back. Four thick clawed legs, a drooping tail and smoldering red eyes in a lowered head.

Slime Lutador.aparencia: Small translucent blue gelatinous blob with two bulging fist-like lumps pushed out of its sides and a scowling brow ridge; low, wide stance with a dense, bouncy body.

Slime Mago.aparencia: Small violet jelly body shaped like a pointed cone, with a glowing star-shaped core floating inside and a few drifting sparkles trapped in the translucent surface.

Slime de Elite.aparencia: Small but dense deep-teal gelatinous blob with a thick glossy surface, a ridged crest on top and a smug, narrowed pair of eyes; looks heavier and firmer than ordinary ones.

Slime Mutante.aparencia: Small lopsided green-yellow jelly with extra eyes at odd heights, bubbling lumps and a drooping tentacle-like bulge; the surface is mottled and sickly.

Goblin Lutador.aparencia: Short green-skinned humanoid with big pointed ears, a wide jaw and wiry muscle; wears wrapped knuckle bands and a leather vest, crouched in a boxer's guard.

Goblin Mago.aparencia: Small green humanoid with long drooping ears and a hooked nose, in a patched, oversized robe and a crooked pointed hat, clutching a gnarled staff topped with a smoking glass bulb.

Goblin de Elite.aparencia: Stocky green humanoid in mismatched plate scraps and a dented helmet with a rag plume, scarred cheek and gold-capped teeth, carrying a notched short blade and a round shield.

Goblin Mutante.aparencia: Hunched green humanoid with one grossly oversized arm, warty boils on its back, mismatched eyes and a lopsided jaw; skin is blotchy yellow-green and stretched over uneven muscle.

Goblin Supremo.aparencia: Tall for its kind, dark-green humanoid in a scrap-metal crown and patchwork cloak trimmed with trinkets, with a gold-toothed grin and heavy rings on every clawed finger.

Orc Lutador.aparencia: Broad, towering grey-green brute with lower tusks and a heavy brow; bare scarred torso, taped fists and a wide-legged brawler's stance.

Orc Mago.aparencia: Lean green-skinned tusked humanoid draped in a bone-trimmed ritual robe, face painted in white stripes, holding a carved totem staff hung with feathers and small skulls.

Orc Sombrio.aparencia: Hulking charcoal-skinned tusked humanoid with faintly glowing violet eyes, hooded in a tattered black mantle and spiked dark armor; shadow seems to cling around its shoulders.

Orc de Elite.aparencia: Massive green tusked warrior in layered riveted plate with a horned helm, a scarred face and a broad two-handed axe; stands upright and squared, clearly better equipped.

Orc Mutante.aparencia: Bloated green-grey brute with a swollen, knotted arm, jutting bone spurs along the spine, extra tusks and weeping sores; posture twisted and lurching.

Orc Supremo.aparencia: Giant, deep-green tusked warlord in black spiked plate with a fur mantle and a skull-crested helm, gripping a huge jagged cleaver; scars run across a heavy, glaring face.

Eye Goo Lutador.aparencia: Medium round mass of pale pink slime with one big bloodshot eye in the center and two thick, knuckled pseudopods raised like fists; low, bouncing crouch.

Eye Goo Mago.aparencia: Medium blob of purple slime with a single large glowing eye and a ring of small eyestalks circling its crown like a halo; surface shimmers with faint rune-like streaks.

Eye Goo Sombrio.aparencia: Medium blob of black-violet ooze with one huge pale eye with a slit pupil, dripping tar-like strands; the body is smoky at the edges and dim.

Eye Goo de Elite.aparencia: Medium slime mass with a thick, rubbery crimson-tinted hide, a single big eye framed by a ridged bony brow and a few armored plates embedded along its back.

Eye Goo Mutante.aparencia: Medium misshapen slime with five uneven eyes of different sizes scattered across a lumpy, mottled green body, with stringy tendrils and bubbling blisters.

Eye Goo Supremo.aparencia: Large, glossy dark-magenta slime with one enormous golden eye ringed by smaller ones, a crown-like fringe of spikes on top and thick tendrils pooling around its base.

Mage Goo Lutador.aparencia: Medium blue-violet slime with a pointed, wizard-hat-shaped peak, but two heavy fists of jelly shoved forward; star flecks drift inside a muscular, squat body.

Mage Goo Mago.aparencia: Medium indigo slime with a tall tapered hat-like peak, a glowing crescent-shaped marking on its face and swirling glittering motes suspended in its clear jelly.

Mage Goo Sombrio.aparencia: Medium near-black slime with a drooping hat-like peak, two pale glowing slits for eyes and thin violet wisps curling off a dull, glossy surface.

Mage Goo de Elite.aparencia: Medium slime with a thick, deep-blue hide, a silver-streaked pointed peak and small angular plates on its flanks; solid and heavy, with sharp, confident eyes.

Mage Goo Mutante.aparencia: Medium slime with a split, two-pointed peak, patchy teal and rust coloring, uneven eyes and swollen blisters oozing glittering fluid from its sides.

Mage Goo Supremo.aparencia: Large, deep-purple slime with a tall curved peak like a grand hat, a golden crescent mark on the brow, radiant specks inside its jelly and a trailing, cloak-like skirt.

Ruffian Lutador.aparencia: Burly, broken-nosed human thug with a shaved head and bare tattooed forearms, wearing a stained sleeveless shirt and wrapped fists, planted in a wide brawling stance.

Ruffian Mago.aparencia: Scruffy, gaunt human in a ragged hooded coat with ink-stained fingers and a crooked grin, holding a cracked rod wrapped in cords and charms.

Ruffian Sombrio.aparencia: Lean human in a dark hooded cloak with a rag over the lower face, only narrow eyes showing, carrying a curved dagger and blending into the dim.

Ruffian de Elite.aparencia: Broad-shouldered human bruiser in a studded leather coat with a metal shoulder guard and a long scar down one cheek, gripping a heavy iron-banded club.

Ruffian Mutante.aparencia: Hunched human figure with one arm swollen to twice its size, mottled grey skin, patchy hair and mismatched eyes, in torn, strained clothes.

Ruffian Supremo.aparencia: Tall, heavy-set human boss in a fur-collared long coat laden with gold chains, a shaved head with a braided beard and an ornate, heavy cleaver-like sword.

Gargoyle Lutador.aparencia: Grey stone winged biped with a horned, snarling face, thick rounded fists and a hunched, wide-footed stance; folded wings and a chiseled, chipped surface.

Gargoyle Sombrio.aparencia: Charcoal-black stone creature with bat-like leathery wings, long curved horns, glowing pale eyes and clawed feet gripping a ledge; surface streaked with soot.

Gargoyle de Elite.aparencia: Heavily built stone-grey winged figure with ridged armor-like plating over the chest, swept-back horns and thick talons; chiseled surface is smooth and polished.

Gargoyle Supremo.aparencia: Huge pale-granite winged creature with a crown of curved horns, a deep chest and wide wings with spiked edges; sits upright like a statue with glinting gem eyes.

Harpy Lutador.aparencia: Woman-faced bird body with brown feathered wings, muscular thighs ending in large hooked talons and bound wrists; a strong, forward-leaning kick-ready posture.

Harpy Sombrio.aparencia: Slender winged humanoid with sooty black plumage, pale narrowed eyes, long dark talons and tattered feathers trailing behind; crouches low like a night hunter.

Harpy de Elite.aparencia: Large, deep-chested bird-woman with glossy bronze-and-white plumage, a crest of long feathers, steel-colored talons and broad wings fully spread.

Harpy Mutante.aparencia: Bird-bodied humanoid with patchy bald skin, uneven wings of different lengths, an extra clawed limb and a bulging, twisted neck; feathers are matted green-grey.

Harpy Supremo.aparencia: Tall, regal bird-woman with long golden-crimson plumage, a flaring head crest, wings over twice her height and razor-sharp silver-tipped talons.

Minotaur Lutador.aparencia: Towering man-bodied bull with a thick brown-furred head, broad curved horns, a ringed nose and a heavily muscled bare torso with wrapped fists.

Minotaur Mago.aparencia: Tall bull-headed figure with smoother grey-brown fur and long polished horns hung with charms, wearing a long embroidered robe and holding a tall staff tipped with a glowing orb.

Minotaur Sombrio.aparencia: Black-furred bull-headed giant with glowing white eyes, long jagged horns and dark spiked armor; steam rises from its nostrils as it stands hunched forward.

Minotaur de Elite.aparencia: Huge bull-headed warrior in thick riveted bronze plate with a horned helmet fitted over its natural horns, a scarred muzzle and a massive double-bladed axe.

Minotaur Mutante.aparencia: Grotesque bull-headed brute with a third horn growing from its forehead, patchy fur over bulging veins, one arm much longer than the other and a drooling, lopsided jaw.

Minotaur Supremo.aparencia: Colossal bull-headed lord with dark red-brown fur, gilded horn caps, a heavy chain across the chest and a stone-grey battle hammer; stands taller than any doorway.

Dragon Zombie Lutador.aparencia: Giant rotting winged reptile with greying peeling scales, torn wing membranes and exposed ribs; thick forelimbs with broken claws raised in a hulking, bear-like stance.

Dragon Zombie Mago.aparencia: Gaunt colossal winged reptile with sunken green-glowing eyes, a long skeletal neck and pale ribbons of flesh hanging from the jaw; wing membranes are tattered, with eerie lights drifting inside the ribs.

Dragon Zombie Sombrio.aparencia: Colossal winged reptile with dull black decayed scales, empty glowing eye sockets and a ragged shadowy mist trailing from its torn wings and jaws.

Dragon Zombie de Elite.aparencia: Giant rotting winged reptile with thick, corroded metal plates fused onto its flanks and skull, bone spikes along the spine and a heavily scarred, half-bare jaw.

Dragon Zombie Mutante.aparencia: Giant rotting winged reptile with an extra misgrown head budding from its shoulder, bulging green tumors, mismatched uneven wings and oozing wounds along the neck.

Dragon Zombie Supremo.aparencia: Vast decayed winged reptile with a crown of long bone horns, exposed skull-like face with cold blue eye fire, wide ragged wings and a ribcage hung with rusted chains.

Skeleton Lutador.aparencia: Bleached human-sized bone frame with cloth-wrapped fists, a cracked jaw, a lowered guard stance and small pale lights in its eye sockets.

Skeleton Mago.aparencia: Thin yellowed bone figure in a tattered dark hood and robe, with blue flames in its eye sockets and a staff topped with a small floating skull.

Skeleton de Elite.aparencia: Tall bone warrior in a dented iron breastplate and helmet with a tattered crest, an old round shield and a long chipped sword; ribs show through the armor gaps.

Skeleton Mutante.aparencia: Warped bone figure with extra ribs, a second misplaced arm, an elongated spine and a skull with two crooked jaws; bones are stained green and covered in growths.

Skeleton Supremo.aparencia: Towering dark-boned figure in black ornate armor with a horned crown, a tattered purple cape, a heavy greatsword and cold violet fire burning in its skull.

Ghost Lutador.aparencia: Pale translucent humanoid spirit with a tapering, trailing lower body, a stern face and solid-looking clenched fists glowing faintly; leans forward in a punching pose.

Ghost Mago.aparencia: Pale blue translucent robed spirit with hollow glowing eyes, a hood of drifting mist and long thin fingers holding a small floating orb of light.

Ghost Sombrio.aparencia: Smoky black-violet spirit with a ragged wispy outline, two pale hollow eyes and long thin arms trailing into dark mist; its shape seems to bleed into any dimness.

Ghost de Elite.aparencia: Bright white spirit in the ghostly shape of an armored knight, with a spectral helm, a ragged flowing cape and a faintly glowing outline; face is a hollow shadow.

Ghost Mutante.aparencia: Sickly green translucent spirit with a stretched, melting face, several arms of unequal length and a bulging, warped body that drips glowing slime.

Ghost Supremo.aparencia: Large pale spirit wearing a floating, spectral crown and a long flowing mantle of silver mist, with a calm, hollow face and a ring of glowing wisps orbiting overhead.

Wraith Lutador.aparencia: Gaunt hooded shade with long ragged robes, no legs below the hem and two clawed, bony hands clenched like fists; its face is a dark void with dim red pinpoints.

Wraith Mago.aparencia: Slender hooded shade with tattered grey-blue robes, glowing cyan eyes in an empty hood and long pale fingers spread around floating, swirling glyph-like lights.

Wraith Sombrio.aparencia: Pitch-black hooded shade with a barely visible outline, ragged smoke for a hem and two narrow white eyes; reaches forward with thin, shadowy claws.

Wraith de Elite.aparencia: Shade in a rusted, floating helm and shoulder plates over tattered black robes, holding a pitted sword; empty hood glows a steady pale green.

Wraith Mutante.aparencia: Distorted hooded shade with a swollen, uneven hood, too many long fingers on one hand and dripping green-black ichor along its torn hem; eyes are mismatched.

Wraith Supremo.aparencia: Tall hooded shade in layered black-and-purple robes with a thin tarnished crown above the hood, trailing a long ragged cloak and cold white fire in its eyes.

Chimera Lutador.aparencia: Lion-bodied beast with a goat head rising from the back and a snake-headed tail, wide shoulders and thick forelegs braced low; short scorched mane and a heavy brow.

Chimera Sombrio.aparencia: Dark charcoal lion-bodied beast with a goat head on its back, a serpent tail and bat-like wings; eyes glow dim orange and a smoky haze surrounds the mane.

Chimera de Elite.aparencia: Large tawny lion body with a thick crested mane, a horned goat head and a coiled snake tail, with steel-grey plates on its shoulders and heavy claws.

Chimera Mutante.aparencia: Lumpy lion-bodied beast with two extra goat heads growing from the flank, a split serpent tail, patchy mangy fur and misaligned legs; wounds glow ember red.

Chimera Supremo.aparencia: Huge crimson-maned lion body with large dragon-like wings, a majestic horned goat head and a long scaled serpent tail; thick golden claws and a ring of embers about its mane.

Manticore Lutador.aparencia: Lion body with a bearded, almost human face, a thick mane and a curved scorpion-like tail ending in spines; heavy forepaws with blunted, wrapped claws, set in a strong crouch.

Manticore Mago.aparencia: Slim lion body with a calm, bearded human-like face, a mane braided with beads and a long barbed tail that curls overhead; a faint ring of runes floats around it.

Manticore Sombrio.aparencia: Dark brown-black lion body with a pale human-like face, glowing yellow eyes, small bat wings and a venom-tipped tail raised high; crouching low and quiet.

Manticore de Elite.aparencia: Large lion body with a scarred, human-like face, a crest of dark mane and a heavy segmented tail with a thick barbed tip; metal bands wrap its forelegs.

Manticore Mutante.aparencia: Misshapen lion body with a stretched, melting human-like face, two tails of different lengths, uneven mane and lumpy, green-veined swellings along the back.

Manticore Supremo.aparencia: Enormous red-gold lion body with a stern bearded face, a dense dark mane, wide leathery wings and a long, glossy tail with a large dripping barb.

Cockatrice Lutador.aparencia: Two-legged, rooster-headed reptile with a red comb, bare gripping feet with long claws, a scaly muscular chest and short feathered wings held out like fists.

Cockatrice Mago.aparencia: Slim rooster-headed reptile with a purple-streaked comb, jewel-like pale eyes, a long curling serpent tail and feathers tipped with faint glowing speckles.

Cockatrice Sombrio.aparencia: Sleek rooster-headed reptile with near-black feathers and scales, a dark crimson comb, pale unblinking eyes and a thin dark mist drifting off its tail.

Cockatrice de Elite.aparencia: Large rooster-headed reptile with a tall bright crest, thick glossy scales along the chest, bronze-tipped feathers and heavy curved talons; stands tall and proud.

Cockatrice Mutante.aparencia: Rooster-headed reptile with a second small head budding at its neck, patchy bald skin, uneven wings and swollen yellow-green warts along the tail.

Cockatrice Supremo.aparencia: Tall rooster-headed reptile with a huge, jagged red crest, long iridescent green-black tail plumes, a gleaming gold beak and large wings with scaled edges.

Behemoth Lutador.aparencia: Huge four-legged horned beast with a purple-grey hide, a thick neck, long tusks and forelegs like tree trunks; rears slightly onto its haunches with clenched, club-like paws.

Behemoth Mago.aparencia: Huge four-legged horned beast with smoother blue-grey hide and a long mane of glowing hair, a luminous gem in the forehead and thin glyph-like markings along its flanks.
