Urso da Selva Agressivo.aparencia: Aggressive jungle bear with a ridged, wrinkled forehead, bared teeth and a stiff, bristled back. Forelimbs are heavy, claws hook forward.

Urso da Selva Letal.aparencia: Streamlined jungle bear with a dark, damp-looking coat, long hooked claws and a narrow face. Crouched and tense, sunk low on its limbs.

Urso da Selva Venenoso.aparencia: Jungle bear with a sickly greenish cast to its dark fur, yellow claws and a pallid mottled snout. Slick lips and purple-spotted gums.

Urso da Selva Veloz.aparencia: Lanky jungle bear with flat, glossy fur, very long limbs and a slender, tapered muzzle. Stands lightly on its toes, ready to spring.

Urso da Selva Ancião.aparencia: Elderly jungle bear with a patchy dark coat, a grey-white muzzle and drooping, wrinkled skin. Claws are long, curled and chipped.

Urso da Selva Solitário.aparencia: Solitary jungle bear with a ragged dark coat, a thin build and one drooping ear. Hunches near tree roots and keeps its head tucked.

Urso da Selva Majestoso.aparencia: Majestic jungle bear with a sleek, shining black coat, strong shoulders and a pale, bright chest mark. Tall neck and an unblinking gaze.

Urso da Selva Feroz.aparencia: Ferocious jungle bear with deep brow furrows, a wide-open snarl and a back bristling with raised fur. Forearms are thick and scarred.

Urso da Selva Territorial.aparencia: Sturdy jungle bear with a muddy belly, bark shavings stuck in its fur and wide, deeply marked claws. Planted low on thick limbs in a defensive crouch.

Urso da Selva Noturno.aparencia: Jungle bear with near-black fur, large dark eyes ringed in pale fur and a low, silent stride. Soft thick paw pads and a hunched back.

Urso da Selva Fantasma.aparencia: Translucent, smoke-colored jungle bear with a dissolving outline, glowing pale eyes and a faintly visible chest mark. Moves without disturbing leaves.

Urso da Selva Primal.aparencia: Primal jungle bear with a sloping, heavy brow, a matted coat tangled with vines and extra-thick curved claws. Frame is powerful, stooped and long-armed.

Urso da Selva Ancestral.aparencia: Ancestral jungle bear with a back overgrown with moss and fern, a deeply lined grey muzzle and pale, thick claws. Slow, heavy frame with patchy fur.

Urso da Selva Menor.aparencia: Lean jungle bear with a short, fine coat, a narrow pale snout and delicate limbs. Eyes are large and ears are small and round.

Urso da Selva Colossal.aparencia: Colossal jungle bear with a vast rounded back, a glossy dark coat and legs as wide as tree trunks. Head is big and blunt, claws long as sickles.

Urso do Pântano Selvagem.aparencia: Muddy swamp-dwelling bear with a dark brown coat plastered in silt and algae, wet-matted fur and a broad flat head. Stands with a low, damp slouch.

Urso do Pântano Gigante.aparencia: Huge swamp bear with a thick, waterlogged coat draped with weeds, a barrel chest and wide, webbed-looking paws. Skin around the muzzle is slick and dark.

Urso do Pântano Anão.aparencia: Small swamp bear with a squat, wet body, mud-caked paws and a short snout. Fur clumps in tufts and tiny reeds stick in its coat.

Urso do Pântano Imperial.aparencia: Imposing swamp bear with a dark, glossy coat laced with green moss, a broad flat skull and a tall, steady stance. Paws are broad and splayed.

Urso do Pântano Agressivo.aparencia: Aggressive swamp bear with a mud-streaked, bristling coat, a snarling, wrinkled muzzle and wide-set shoulders. Claws curved and dripping.

Urso do Pântano Letal.aparencia: Swamp bear with a thick, slimy coat stained greenish-black, long yellowed claws and a leathery mottled muzzle. Dark gums and a stringy, sticky drool.

Urso do Pântano Venenoso.aparencia: Swamp bear with a slick, olive-stained coat, dripping yellow claws and pallid, bruise-purple gums. Eyes are sunken, and its snout is crusted with green scum.

Urso do Pântano Veloz.aparencia: Lean swamp bear with a slick, flat coat, long legs and large, flexible paws that splay over mud. Body is narrow and its stride long and springy.

Urso do Pântano Ancião.aparencia: Elderly swamp bear with a heavy, peat-stained grey muzzle, drooping eyelids and a sparse, algae-draped coat. Slow, sagging frame.

Urso do Pântano Solitário.aparencia: Solitary swamp bear with a dark, mud-slicked coat, a thin build and ragged ears. Sits low in shallow water, head lowered, apart from everything.

Urso do Pântano Majestoso.aparencia: Majestic swamp bear with a glossy, dark green-brown coat, a broad, strong back and a neck held proud. A cream chest blaze stands out against wet fur.

Urso do Pântano Feroz.aparencia: Ferocious swamp bear with a thick scarred brow, flared jaw and a wild, dripping coat. Arms are heavy with muscle and claws are thick, stained dark.

Urso do Pântano Territorial.aparencia: Thick-bodied swamp bear caked in dried clay up to its shoulders, with wide mud-crusted paws. Deep, widely planted stance and a low, thick neck.

Urso do Pântano Noturno.aparencia: Swamp bear with a nearly black wet coat, big pale reflective eyes and a quiet, slouching stride. Cattails and weeds hang from its fur.

Urso do Pântano Fantasma.aparencia: Wispy, grey-green swamp bear with a half-transparent body trailing mist, a hollow face and faintly glowing eyes. Coat looks like drifting fog.

Urso do Pântano Primal.aparencia: Primal swamp bear with a heavy, sloping brow, a wild peat-matted coat and blunt, thick claws. Hunched, long-armed stance, with slime on its shoulders.

Urso do Pântano Ancestral.aparencia: Ancestral swamp bear with a back covered in moss and duckweed, a creased grey face and large pale claws. Heavy, ponderous build, with dripping fur.

Urso do Pântano Menor.aparencia: Slender swamp bear with a thin, wet coat, a narrow muzzle and long delicate legs. Large ears and a small, curious face.

Urso do Pântano Colossal.aparencia: Colossal swamp bear, vast and round-backed, with a thick weed-draped coat and enormous paws. Head is broad and blunt, and its fur streams with muddy water.

Urso das Profundezas Selvagem.aparencia: Heavy dark-coated bear with a pale, pressure-bleached muzzle, huge round eyes adapted to darkness and thick, wet fur. Broad pale claws and a hunched, slow stance.

Urso das Profundezas Gigante.aparencia: Towering cave bear with a massive hump, shaggy slate-brown fur dulled by cavern dust and pale, almost useless small eyes. Paws as wide as shields, heavy jaw, slow rolling gait.

Urso das Profundezas Anão.aparencia: Squat, barrel-bodied cave bear barely knee-high to a man, with short stubby legs, thick grey-brown fur and a blunt rounded muzzle. Looks cuddly but stands planted and stubborn.

Urso das Profundezas Imperial.aparencia: Broad cave bear with a thick mane-like ruff of fur around the neck, dark brown coat shot with silver, and a proud upright stance. Wide chest, heavy forelimbs, calm stare.

Urso das Profundezas Agressivo.aparencia: Hunched cave bear with bristling fur along the spine, lips drawn back from yellowed teeth and scarred claws. Head low, shoulders tensed, always mid-lunge.

Urso das Profundezas Letal.aparencia: Lean, muscular cave bear with a coal-black coat, long hooked claws worn to points and a narrow lowered head. Moves with quiet, calculated steps.

Urso das Profundezas Venenoso.aparencia: Cave bear with sickly green-tinged fur, patchy and slick, and swollen purple gums over stained teeth. Drips yellow froth from its muzzle and has a dull, glassy gaze.

Urso das Profundezas Veloz.aparencia: Slim-limbed cave bear built more like a hound, with a long narrow back, slick short fur and big splayed paws. Chest deep, stride stretched, ears pinned flat.

Urso das Profundezas Ancião.aparencia: Ancient cave bear with a frosted white muzzle, sagging skin, thin sparse fur and claws curled long and yellow. Heavy-lidded milky eyes, slow stooped walk.

Urso das Profundezas Solitário.aparencia: Lone cave bear with matted dark fur and a rangy frame, wary hunched shoulders and scarred ears. Stands apart, head turned half away, thin from solitary living.

Urso das Profundezas Majestoso.aparencia: Grand cave bear with glossy chestnut fur, a thick golden-brown ruff and a regal raised head. Broad, symmetrical, with gently gleaming dark eyes.

Urso das Profundezas Feroz.aparencia: Wild-eyed cave bear with ragged rust-red fur standing on end, a wide snarling maw and thick forearms. Muscles bunch under the skin, saliva strings from its jaws.

Urso das Profundezas Territorial.aparencia: Stocky cave bear with fur gone coarse around the shoulders, deep claw gouges in its forelimbs and a wide-planted stance. Flat stare, ears forward, guarding its ground.

Urso das Profundezas Noturno.aparencia: Cave bear with near-black fur and big reflective eyes that glow faintly like a cat's in the dark. Rounded ears, soft-footed, a bulky shape that fades into shadow.

Urso das Profundezas Fantasma.aparencia: Translucent, bone-pale cave bear whose fur looks like drifting mist and whose eyes are hollow pools of grey. Edges blur and its paws leave no mark on the ground.

Urso das Profundezas Primal.aparencia: Primitive-looking cave bear with a sloping skull, thick brow ridge, shaggy ochre coat and oversized forepaws. Low stooped posture, heavy tusk-like canines.

Urso das Profundezas Ancestral.aparencia: Huge cave bear with a rock-hard brow, weathered fur matted with clay and moss, and claws like curved stone blades. Old scars criss-cross its flanks.

Urso das Profundezas Menor.aparencia: Small cave bear cub-sized adult, with slim shoulders, soft chocolate fur and a short snout. Round ears and a faintly timid, tucked-in posture.

Urso das Profundezas Colossal.aparencia: Mountainous cave bear, double normal size, with a wide sagging belly, trunk-like legs and thick dark fur that hangs to the floor. Each pawfall looks ground-shaking.

Urso Abissal Selvagem.aparencia: Bulky dark bear with sleek charcoal fur, small buried eyes and pale faintly glowing speckles on shoulders and flanks. Broad flipper-like paws, thick neck, damp-looking coat.

Urso Abissal Gigante.aparencia: Colossal blue-black bear with a barrel chest and dripping layered fur, tiny eyes and a long heavy muzzle. Webbed, spade-like paws with short dark claws, massive hump.

Urso Abissal Anão.aparencia: Squat, round abyssal-dark bear with stubby legs and short wet fur, glowing dots along its back and tiny curious eyes. A compact, plump cub-like build.

Urso Abissal Agressivo.aparencia: Slate-black bear with a flattened skull and snarling mouth full of thin, needle-like teeth. Muscular forelimbs and claws like hooks, glowing dots flaring on its shoulders.

Urso Abissal Letal.aparencia: Sleek abyssal bear with a jet-black coat, long narrow jaws full of fine curved fangs and heavy hooked claws. Low silent crouch, glowing blue spots dimmed to thin lines along its back.

Urso Abissal Venenoso.aparencia: Deep-sea-dark bear with a slimy, pitted hide and glowing blue-green blotches that look like infected sores. Overlong fangs, sunken eyes, dripping drool.

Urso Abissal Veloz.aparencia: Narrow-waisted black bear with a streamlined body, flattened paws like paddles and sleek wet fur. Long muzzle held forward, glowing freckles trailing along its flanks.

Urso Abissal Ancião.aparencia: Elderly abyss bear with lank, sparse fur like waterlogged felt, a drooping lower lip and cloudy eyes. Skin hangs in folds, claws grown long and ridged.

Urso Abissal Solitário.aparencia: Isolated dark bear with a thin frame, dull mottled fur and a single faint glow-spot on its crown. Eyes small and distant, ears folded low.

Urso Abissal Majestoso.aparencia: Regal black bear with a luminous silver-blue mane around its neck and glowing marks like constellations across its back. Dignified upright head, thick gleaming fur.

Urso Abissal Feroz.aparencia: Heavy-jawed black bear with a bristling hump, bared teeth glinting in a wide maw and glowing shoulder spots flared bright. Eyes narrow, body coiled.

Urso Abissal Territorial.aparencia: Broad-chested black bear standing square, coat dense and oily, with deep scratches ringing its thick neck. Eyes dim and fixed, stance firmly rooted.

Urso Abissal Noturno.aparencia: Soot-black bear with enormous round eyes that shine like lamps, big cupped ears and soft pelt dotted with faint glowing flecks. Moves smoothly on silent pads.

Urso Abissal Primal.aparencia: Stocky, low-browed bear with a sloping skull and coarse dark mane, jaw jutting forward. Dense old-fashioned build, thick forelimbs, tiny wary eyes.

Urso Abissal Ancestral.aparencia: Vast shaggy bear with grey-streaked fur, a barnacle-like crust of pale growth over its shoulders and long claws worn smooth. Slow, heavy, deeply wrinkled snout.

Urso Abissal Menor.aparencia: Small slender bear with fine short fur, big wet eyes and webbed little paws. Pointed muzzle, narrow shoulders, tail stub tucked.

Urso Abissal Colossal.aparencia: Gigantic abyssal bear with a hide thick as a hull, great sagging jowls and a back dotted with glowing spots like lamps. Almost too wide for any passage, flippered paws.

Urso Costeiro Selvagem.aparencia: Wiry brown bear with salt-stiffened shaggy fur, a pale cream chest and broad, partially webbed paws. Moderately long muzzle, damp nose and crusted sea-salt on its back.

Urso Costeiro Gigante.aparencia: Very large coastal brown bear with a rounded hump, dense kelp-stained coat and a wide skull. Paws like paddles, deep chest, standing in a shallow-water stance.

Urso Costeiro Anão.aparencia: Short, round coastal bear with stubby legs, sandy-brown fur flecked with white and a flat blunt face. Cheeks puffy, tail hidden, soft and plump.

Urso Costeiro Imperial.aparencia: Majestic coastal bear with a thick cream-gold ruff, seaweed-green sheen across its back and a proudly held head. Broad chest, clean heavy claws, amber eyes.

Urso Costeiro Agressivo.aparencia: Coastal bear with a ridged scarred muzzle, ruffled brown fur and teeth bared in a snarl. Forelegs thick and hooked with long curved claws, forward-leaning pose.

Urso Costeiro Letal.aparencia: Coastal bear with a heavy lowered head, jaws gaping with long yellowed fangs and a coat marked by pale scars. Heavily muscled shoulders and paws like hooked mallets, ready to strike.

Urso Costeiro Venenoso.aparencia: Coastal bear with greenish-yellow patches in its matted fur, swollen lips and a stained, foam-flecked maw. Skin under the coat looks mottled, eyes dull red.

Urso Costeiro Veloz.aparencia: Sleek coastal bear with a long narrow frame, short wet-looking fur and long wide-set paws made for racing across sand. Chest deep, belly tucked, head thrust forward.

Urso Costeiro Ancião.aparencia: Old coastal bear with salt-white fur around its face and shoulders, ridged claws and sagging jowls. Eyes cloudy, stance wide and settled, coat patchy like driftwood.

Urso Costeiro Solitário.aparencia: Solitary coastal bear with mud-dark, tangled fur and a narrow rangy frame, face half hidden by hanging wet hair. Sits alone, head low, ears slack.

Urso Costeiro Majestoso.aparencia: Splendid coastal bear with a smooth, sun-bleached golden pelt and a broad upright chest, eyes bright amber. Neat dense fur, calm solid posture, large clean paws.

Urso Costeiro Feroz.aparencia: Fierce coastal bear with rust-brown fur raised in a spiked ridge from neck to rump and a deep-set glare. Wide jaws, long thick canines and scraped, hooked claws.

Carvalho do Saara Selvagem.aparencia: Gnarled desert oak with a thick, twisted trunk of sun-cracked pale bark and a sparse crown of small, leathery grey-green leaves. Roots spill above the sand like knuckles.

Carvalho do Saara Gigante.aparencia: Enormous desert oak with a trunk as wide as a hut, deeply furrowed sandy bark and a flat sprawling canopy of tough small leaves. Thick surface roots grip the dunes.

Carvalho do Saara Anão.aparencia: Dwarf desert oak no taller than a person, with a swollen knobby trunk, short crooked branches and tight clusters of waxy leaves. Bark pale and cracked like dry clay.

Carvalho do Saara Imperial.aparencia: Stately desert oak with a perfectly balanced, round crown of glossy dark leaves, smooth ochre bark and a straight stout trunk. Acorns hang gold at the branch tips.

Carvalho do Saara Agressivo.aparencia: Thorn-studded desert oak with jagged, hooked branches, rust-red bark and spiky holly-like leaves. Branches reach forward like claws, sap beads dark at its splits.

Carvalho do Saara Letal.aparencia: Desert oak with a stiff, straight trunk of dark iron-hard wood, branches sharpened like pikes and narrow blade-shaped leaves. Bark scarred with notches, roots set wide like a stance.

Carvalho do Saara Venenoso.aparencia: Desert oak with a bruise-purple trunk, wilted yellow-green leaves and weeping black sap through cracks in the bark. Its acorns are shriveled and spotted with mold.

Carvalho do Saara Veloz.aparencia: Slim desert oak with a tall, narrow trunk, flexible whip-like branches and small narrow leaves that stream in one direction. Pale smooth bark, shallow-rooted and light.

Carvalho do Saara Ancião.aparencia: Ancient desert oak with a hollowed trunk, weathered grey bark in thick ridges and sparse dry leaves on bent, drooping boughs. Roots coil like old rope over the sand.

Carvalho do Saara Solitário.aparencia: Lone desert oak with a leaning bare-wood trunk, thin dark-green foliage only at its top and long exposed roots. Stands alone with sand piled against one side.

Carvalho do Saara Majestoso.aparencia: Magnificent desert oak with a wide flat crown, dense glossy leaves and red-gold bark that glows in the sun. Trunk massive and symmetrical, boughs sweeping outward.

Carvalho do Saara Feroz.aparencia: Desert oak with scorched-looking, charcoal-black bark, twisted spiky branches and rust-orange leaves. Splits in the trunk show glowing red-brown wood.

Carvalho do Saara Territorial.aparencia: Squat desert oak with a very thick stubby trunk, armor-like plated bark and short heavy branches that grip the ground. Dense dark leaves, roots plunge into the sand.

Carvalho do Saara Noturno.aparencia: Desert oak with dark blue-grey leaves that close tight into shadowy bundles, near-black bark and pale night-blooming flowers on its twigs. Trunk slender and dusky.

Carvalho do Saara Fantasma.aparencia: Pale, ghost-white desert oak with bare, ashen branches, translucent grey leaves and a wispy mist clinging to its trunk. Its roots look almost see-through.

Carvalho do Saara Primal.aparencia: Primitive-looking desert oak with a crude stout trunk, mossy-ochre bark and oversized leaves like broad fans. Rough, almost prehistoric, with woody ridges.

Carvalho do Saara Ancestral.aparencia: Colossal desert oak with a buttressed trunk wrapped in thick bark like layered stone, wide gnarled boughs and deep green leaves. Aged and leaning, patched with lichen.

Carvalho do Saara Menor.aparencia: Small slender desert oak, shoulder-high, with a thin pale trunk, a few soft green leaves and a little rounded crown. Shallow roots and delicate twigs.

Carvalho do Saara Colossal.aparencia: Gigantic desert oak, its trunk broader than a cart and its crown shading a whole dune, with pale cracked bark and countless leathery leaves. Roots heave out like buried serpents.

Carvalho Siberiano Selvagem.aparencia: Frost-crusted Siberian oak with dark rough bark, stiff brown leaves that cling through winter and a compact rounded crown. Twigs sheathed in tiny ice crystals.

Carvalho Siberiano Gigante.aparencia: Great Siberian oak with a massive, deeply ridged trunk, spreading boughs heaped with snow and dense leathery brown-green leaves. Roots grip the frozen ground in thick knots.

Carvalho Siberiano Anão.aparencia: Dwarf Siberian oak, low and wind-bent, with a stubby trunk, close-packed twigs and small stiff leaves frosted white. Bark dark and rugged, crown flattened.

Carvalho Siberiano Imperial.aparencia: Stately Siberian oak with a tall trunk, wide symmetrical crown of deep green leaves and silver-frosted boughs. Bark dark and regular, acorns big and round.

Carvalho Siberiano Agressivo.aparencia: Siberian oak with jagged, thorny twigs, black-brown bark split in sharp ridges and spiky leaves edged with icy barbs. Branches thrust outward like spears.

Carvalho Siberiano Letal.aparencia: Siberian oak with a rigid, dark trunk, splintered spear-like branches and narrow stiff leaves rimed in ice. Bark scarred with deep notches, roots planted like feet.

Carvalho Siberiano Venenoso.aparencia: Siberian oak with blackened, rotting bark oozing a bitter dark sap and curled, grey-green leaves coated in pale mold. Acorns blotched purple and swollen.

Carvalho Siberiano Veloz.aparencia: Slender Siberian oak with a tall, narrow form, whippy branches and slim leaves that flutter in the wind. Bark pale and smooth, crown thin and swept to one side.

Carvalho Siberiano Ancião.aparencia: Ancient Siberian oak with a thick snow-capped trunk, deep furrows packed with ice and bare twisted limbs. Roots hump out of the frozen soil, bark grey and mossy.

Carvalho Siberiano Solitário.aparencia: Lone Siberian oak with a dark leaning trunk, half-bare branches and a few clinging brown leaves. Stands in an empty snowfield with a thin dusting of snow on its limbs.

Carvalho Siberiano Majestoso.aparencia: Magnificent Siberian oak with glossy deep-green leaves, a broad domed crown and frost glittering on every twig. Trunk thick, straight and richly dark.

Carvalho Siberiano Feroz.aparencia: Siberian oak with blackened bark scored by red cracks, jagged branches and rust-red leaves like embers. A fierce, thorny silhouette against the snow.

Carvalho Siberiano Territorial.aparencia: Siberian oak with a thick, armor-plated trunk, short heavy branches and tight, leathery leaves crusted with ice. Roots spread wide, locking into the frozen ground.

Carvalho Siberiano Noturno.aparencia: Siberian oak with deep indigo leaves, near-black bark and pale night-opening buds on slim twigs. Crown dense and shadowy, trunk narrow.

Carvalho Siberiano Fantasma.aparencia: Ghostly Siberian oak with bleached bare limbs, frost-white leaves and wisps of cold mist around the trunk. Bark looks translucent, roots like pale ice veins.

Carvalho Siberiano Primal.aparencia: Primitive Siberian oak with a crude thick trunk, shaggy bark ridges draped in moss and big stiff leaves. Boughs heavy and low, roughly shaped like a hulking giant.

Carvalho Siberiano Ancestral.aparencia: Giant Siberian oak with a trunk wrapped in thick plate-like bark, gnarled swollen boughs and sparse dark leaves. Lichen blooms in grey patches, roots twist like stone.

Carvalho Siberiano Menor.aparencia: Small slender Siberian oak, thin-trunked, with soft pale bark, a handful of glossy leaves and a delicate, upright crown. Twigs lightly rimed in frost.

Carvalho Siberiano Colossal.aparencia: Colossal Siberian oak towering over the snow, its trunk a wall of thick dark bark and its boughs reaching wide under heavy snow. Roots like frozen cliffs.

Carvalho Polar Selvagem.aparencia: Pale-barked polar oak with a stunted, wind-shaped trunk, small silvery-green leaves and twigs coated in a fuzz of frost. Crown low and bent to one side.

Carvalho Polar Gigante.aparencia: Huge polar oak with a wide white-grey trunk, great sweeping branches and thick leaves rimmed in ice. Bark furrowed deeply and frosted over, with snow piled in its forks.

Carvalho Polar Anão.aparencia: Dwarf polar oak, hardly waist-high, with a crooked trunk, matted twigs and tiny tough leaves. White-grey bark, mossy knots, hugging the snowy ground.

Carvalho Polar Imperial.aparencia: Regal polar oak with a tall pale trunk, a wide, evenly rounded crown and glittering icy leaves. Acorns shine like pearls beneath the branches.

Carvalho Polar Agressivo.aparencia: Polar oak with sharp, icicle-like thorns along its branches, grey-black bark in splintered ridges and jagged leaves. Looks cruel and brittle, bristling outward.

Carvalho Polar Letal.aparencia: Polar oak with a sturdy white-grey trunk, stiff sharpened branches pointing outward and narrow leaves hard as slate. Bark nicked and scarred, rooted firmly in snow.

Carvalho Polar Venenoso.aparencia: Polar oak with a sickly grey-green trunk, drooping slimy leaves and black frostbitten patches on its bark. Dark fluid weeps from cracks, acorns wizened.

Carvalho Polar Veloz.aparencia: Slim polar oak, tall and willowy, with pale smooth bark, flexible branches and narrow silver leaves that sweep sideways. Almost weightless in outline.

Carvalho Polar Ancião.aparencia: Elder polar oak with a gnarled, white-streaked trunk, deep ice-filled ridges and skeletal limbs holding a few tattered leaves. Roots coil like frozen rope.

Carvalho Polar Solitário.aparencia: Solitary polar oak, thin and dark against the white, with a bare leaning trunk and a few grey leaves at the tip. Snow drifts around its roots.

Carvalho Polar Majestoso.aparencia: Majestic polar oak with a tall trunk of silver-white bark, a dense rounded crown of glossy leaves and frost twinkling on every branch. Strong, graceful and symmetrical.

Carvalho Polar Feroz.aparencia: Polar oak with a coarse, thorny bristle of branches, dark blotchy bark and sharp-toothed leaves. Aggressive shape, lunging outward from a twisted trunk.

Carvalho Polar Territorial.aparencia: Stocky polar oak with a thick, ridged white trunk, branches pressed low and heavy and a dense crown of tough leaves. Rooted flat and wide into the permafrost.

Carvalho Polar Noturno.aparencia: Polar oak with dusky blue-grey bark, deep violet leaves and pale buds that open in the dark. Branches slender and drooping, trunk narrow and shadow-toned.

Carvalho Polar Fantasma.aparencia: Ghost-white polar oak with bare translucent limbs, a mist of cold vapor around its trunk and hollow, glassy knots for eyes. Stands unnaturally still.

Carvalho Polar Primal.aparencia: A hulking oak with frost-white bark split into thick prehistoric ridges, roots like mammoth tusks gripping permafrost, and a sparse crown of stiff pale-brown leaves.

Carvalho Polar Ancestral.aparencia: A very old, hollow-trunked oak, silver-grey with lichen and rime, its branches bent low and twisted into spirals; a few rusty leaves cling to icy twigs.

Carvalho Polar Menor.aparencia: A small, stunted oak barely taller than a person, bark dusted white with frost, thin crooked branches and tiny round leaves huddled close to the trunk.

Carvalho Polar Colossal.aparencia: A towering oak wide as a hut, bark glazed with ice, great horizontal limbs sagging under packed snow; enormous roots heave up the frozen ground around it.

Carvalho Pardo Selvagem.aparencia: A broad brown oak with untrimmed, sprawling limbs, shaggy moss on its trunk, tangled low branches and acorns scattered thickly beneath its uneven crown.

Carvalho Pardo Gigante.aparencia: An oversized brown oak with a trunk several arm-spans thick, deeply furrowed bark and a vast dome of heavy green foliage casting a wide shadow.

Carvalho Pardo Anão.aparencia: A squat, knobby brown oak no higher than a hip, with a thick twisted trunk, short stubby branches and a dense round cap of small leaves.

Carvalho Pardo Imperial.aparencia: A perfectly symmetrical brown oak with a straight, ridged trunk and a wide, crisply layered crown; golden-tinted leaves and a ring of raised roots like a throne base.

Carvalho Pardo Agressivo.aparencia: A brown oak with jagged bark plates, branches thrust forward like spears and thorn-like broken twigs; its crown leans sharply as if lunging.

Carvalho Pardo Letal.aparencia: A lean brown oak with sharpened, splintered branch tips, dark resin seeping from cracks in the bark, and long root-claws lying exposed across the soil.

Carvalho Pardo Venenoso.aparencia: A brown oak with sickly green-yellow streaks along its bark, oozing amber sap, and leaves speckled with purple blotches; fungus-like pustules ring the base.

Carvalho Pardo Veloz.aparencia: A slim brown oak with a smooth, tapering trunk, thin swept-back branches and narrow leaves streaming in one direction, its roots shallow and stretched like running legs.

Carvalho Pardo Ancião.aparencia: An ancient brown oak with a hollowed, bearded trunk, grey-brown bark folded into deep wrinkles, drooping boughs propped on knotty roots and sparse leaves.

Carvalho Pardo Solitário.aparencia: A lone brown oak with a single leaning trunk and an asymmetrical crown, bare on one side, standing on a bald mound with roots exposed like crossed arms.

Carvalho Pardo Majestoso.aparencia: A stately brown oak with a thick straight trunk, radiant fan of branches and glossy deep-green leaves; pale gold lichen decorates the bark like regal stripes.

Carvalho Pardo Feroz.aparencia: A hunched brown oak with a knotted face-like burl, bark in rough angular ridges, and gnarled limbs hooked like claws, its crown dark and bristling.

Carvalho Pardo Territorial.aparencia: A wide-set brown oak ringed by raised, rugged roots like a barricade, branches spread flat and low to claim the ground, leaves thick and tightly overlapping.

Carvalho Pardo Noturno.aparencia: A brown oak whose bark has darkened to charcoal-brown, leaves deep blue-green with a pale underside, and hollows in its trunk that gape like owl-roost nooks.

Darakhul.aparencia: A lean, humanoid ghoul with dry grey skin stretched over bone, hollow eyes and elongated, dark fangs. It wears worn, tattered clothes and has hooked, dirty claws.

Eagle.aparencia: Large bird of prey with dark brown plumage, a golden nape, a hooked yellow beak and strong feathered legs. Broad wings with spread fingered tips, fierce amber eyes.

Eagle, Giant.aparencia: Enormous raptor the size of a horse, with huge dark brown wings, white head feathers and an immense yellow hooked beak. Thick taloned feet like gripping hooks.

Eala.aparencia: Swan-like bird with a long curved neck, with every feather a thin plate of shining silver metal that clinks softly. Orange beak, dark eyes and wide metallic wings.

Earth Dragon Wyrmling.aparencia: Young four-legged reptile with rough brown-grey scales that look like packed earth, small crystal studs along the brow and blunt claws. Short wings, thick neck, heavy head.

Earth Elemental.aparencia: Towering humanoid heap of rock, soil and gravel, with boulder fists and pebble-bright eyes. Slab-like shoulders, patches of moss and roots, and a heavy, grinding gait.

Eater Of Dust (Yakat-Shi).aparencia: Withered, sand-caked humanoid husk with leathery skin stretched over a long frame, sunken eyes and a jaw that hangs wide. Long dry fingers and a hunched, shuffling stance.

Eater of Dust.aparencia: Gaunt desiccated creature with ashen skin cracked like dry earth, a stretched neck and a wide toothless mouth. Spindly limbs, long dull claws and a trailing powdery cloak.

Echo.aparencia: Shimmering, pale human-shaped silhouette made of overlapping translucent outlines, each slightly offset like a ripple. Its face is smooth and undefined, edges flickering.

Ecstatic Bloom.aparencia: Huge flower with layered pink and gold petals, as tall as a hut, with a swollen, pollen-dusted center. Thick vine stems curl around, and a heady golden cloud hangs over it.

Edimmu.aparencia: Twisting column of sandy, desiccated wind with a vague skeletal face half-visible inside. Ragged strips of cloth whip around it and thin dry arms reach out from the swirl.

Edjet.aparencia: Scaly dragon-featured warrior with a long snout, golden-bronze scales and a short crest. Wears a pleated linen kilt, broad collar and bronze armbands, with a curved sword.

Edjet Initiate.aparencia: Younger scaled warrior with a dusty brown hide, a shorter snout and bright defiant eyes. Plain linen wrap, a thin headband and a simple copper blade held ready.

Eel Hound.aparencia: Dog-sized beast with a bulbous slimy head, rubbery greenish-black skin and a long muscular eel tail. Webbed paws, wide sharp-toothed mouth and a hunched, dripping gait.

Efreeti.aparencia: Giant muscular genie with crimson-bronze skin, black flaming hair and glowing ember eyes. Upper body bare with gold bracers; legs trail into a swirl of smoke and cinders.

Efreeti Noble.aparencia: Tall genie with deep red skin, a jewelled turban and a curled, sleek black beard. Wears a silk vest, heavy gold rings and a curved scimitar; lower body a column of ruddy smoke.

Egret Harpy.aparencia: Woman-like torso with white feathered arms that become wide wings, and long gangly bird legs ending in black talons. Snowy plumage, a slender neck and a sharp yellow-eyed stare.

Einherjar.aparencia: Stout bearded warrior in chain mail with a faint golden glow around him, carrying a two-handed axe and an oaken shield. Beard braided in an unusual pattern, ruddy face.

Elder Black Pudding.aparencia: Huge, glossy black mass of jelly, wide as a room, glistening and slowly pulsing. Bubbles of pale yellow rise through its body; thick pseudopods creep along the floor.

Elder Ghost Boar.aparencia: Massive translucent boar, pale grey-blue and semi-solid, with ragged bristles and enormous curved tusks. Hollow glowing eyes, ribs faintly visible under a wispy hide.

Elder Shadow Drake.aparencia: Large, dragon-like beast with jet-black scales and wings that fray into dark smoke. Long horns, narrow violet eyes and a lean body that blends into surrounding gloom.

Elder Vampire.aparencia: Gaunt, ageless humanoid with bone-white skin, long silver-white hair and elongated fangs. Wears a high-collared black coat with faded crimson lining; deep red eyes, thin claw-like hands.

Eldritch Ooze.aparencia: Dark gelatinous mass whose shape constantly swirls and reforms, with specks of pale starlight drifting inside. Edges ripple oddly and several faint eyes open and close.

Eleinomae.aparencia: Beautiful slender nymph with pale green skin, dark reed-like hair and webbed fingers. Draped in strands of wetland plants and lilies; large reflective eyes like still water.

Elemental Locus.aparencia: Colossal churning landmass of fractured rock, spouting jets of flame and wrapped in howling wind. Cracked slabs float around it and glowing seams run across its ground-like body.

Elemental, Permafrost.aparencia: Bulky humanoid of frozen soil and pale ice, with a rough torso crusted in frost and blue-white crystals. Thick arms like frozen logs, glowing icy eyes and trailing cold mist.

Elemental, Rockslide.aparencia: Tumbling mass of boulders and gravel loosely forming a hulking shape, with chunks constantly breaking off and rejoining. Dusty grey, no clear face, just two dark hollows.

Elementalist.aparencia: Human mage in a layered robe of red, blue, brown and white panels, with four small orbs orbiting around one raised hand. Bare-headed, wind-tousled hair and an ornate quarterstaff.

Elephant.aparencia: Huge grey mammal with thick pillar legs, wrinkled hide, enormous floppy ears, a long trunk and curved ivory tusks. Small calm eyes and a tufted tail.

Elf, Shadow Fey Executioner.aparencia: Tall elf with ash-grey skin, black hair and cold silver eyes, wearing a faceless hood and dark leather. Carries a broad two-handed headsman's axe; stands silently still.

Elite Kobold.aparencia: Small dog-faced lizard-humanoid with rust-red scales, a bony head crest and a thin whip tail. Wears patched metal plates and a crude helm, gripping a jagged spear.

Elk.aparencia: Tall deer with a tan body, dark brown neck and mane, and large branching antlers. Long slender legs, a pale rump patch and alert dark eyes.

Elk, Giant.aparencia: Towering stag with a thick shaggy brown coat and vast, many-pronged antlers wider than a wagon. Heavy shoulders, powerful legs and a steaming muzzle.

Elophar.aparencia: Large long-snouted beast with mottled green-brown skin, a heavy body and short thick limbs. Dangling fleshy barbels around its mouth and small, glossy black eyes.

Elvish Veteran Archer.aparencia: Lean, weathered elf with long grey-streaked hair and sharp features, wearing a forest-green leather coat. Long bow drawn, quiver full of fletched arrows and a scarred forearm guard.

Ember Glider.aparencia: Small flying-squirrel-like creature with soft charcoal fur, a membrane stretched between its limbs that glows orange at the edges. Big dark eyes and a long bushy ember-tipped tail.

Emerald Dragon Wyrmling.aparencia: Young reptile with bright emerald scales that shine like cut gems, a pale green belly and crystalline spines. Small wings, short snout, sharp white teeth and curious eyes.

Emerald Eye.aparencia: Fist-sized green crystal shaped like a faceted eyeball, with a glowing slit in the middle. Hovers slightly above the ground, edges sparkling.

Emerald Order Cult Leader.aparencia: Human in a flowing deep-green robe with a golden sash and a hood adorned with gems. Wears a large emerald pendant, a thin ritual dagger and a stern, charismatic look.

Emperor’s Hyena.aparencia: Heavily built spotted hyena with a thick mane, sloping back and powerful jaws. Wears a studded collar and a faint sheen of gold on its coarse fur; head lowered, mouth open mid-laugh.

Empty Cloak.aparencia: Floating black and purple hooded cloak with silver and gold stitching, carrying nobody inside. Sleeves hang loose, the hood is a pit of darkness and the hem drifts as if in a breeze.

Empusa.aparencia: Tall, pale woman-shaped monster with one leg of shining bronze and one hoof of a donkey, clawed copper hands, and wild flame-red hair. Sharp teeth, hungry gaze and fast prowling stride.

Empyrean.aparencia: Colossal, godlike figure with radiant golden skin, flowing white hair and a muscular, idealized build. Glowing eyes, a laurel circlet and a vast aura like a sunrise.

Enchanter.aparencia: Human spellcaster in a long indigo robe with swirling silver embroidery, a slim wand in one hand. Calm face, bright eyes and a faint shimmer around the fingertips.

Enchantress.aparencia: Woman in a flowing rose and gold gown with long dark hair and delicate jewellery, a pendant that glints. Poised graceful stance, a small crystal wand and sparkling eyes.

Eonic Drifter.aparencia: Lean figure in a grey travelling coat that flickers and double-images as if seen at two moments. Pale skin, thin silver goggles and small cracks of light hanging in the air around him.

Eonic Savant.aparencia: Scholar in a blue robe with many pockets and hourglass-shaped clasps, a thin white beard and bright eyes. Faint blue sparks trail from his sleeves, holding a scroll-laden satchel.

Equitox.aparencia: Large horse-bodied creature with a sickly grey-green hide, glistening patches of oozing sores and dark, drooping mane. Yellow eyes, drooling jaws and sharp curved hooves.

Erina Defender.aparencia: Small hedgehog-like humanoid with a pointed snout, black nose and bright brown eyes, its back covered in thick spines. Wears a little patched shield strapped to one arm.

Erina Scrounger.aparencia: Small spiny humanoid with a pointed face, black snout and big brown eyes, a messy brown spined back. Carries a lumpy sack of odd trinkets and wears a ragged scarf.

Erina.aparencia: Small hedgehog-like humanoid with fur-tipped quills on its back, a pointed snout, black nose and bright brown eyes. Upright stance, short clawed hands and a tiny belt pouch.

Erina Tussler.aparencia: Stocky hedgehog-like humanoid with a thick brush of long dark quills and scarred ears. Bandaged knuckles, a flat pointed snout and a wide, ready-to-brawl crouch.

Erinyes.aparencia: Beautiful but cruel winged fiend with feathered black wings, pale skin and fierce eyes. Wears bronze-plated armour and wields a flaming sword and a coiled rope of barbs.

Ettercap.aparencia: Hunched, long-armed humanoid with a bulging spider-like abdomen, mottled purple-grey skin and a bristly face with spinneret mouthparts. Clawed fingers, sparse hair and a sticky web trailing from its hands.

Ettin.aparencia: Towering two-headed brute with thick grey-brown hide, knotted arms hanging to its knees and a heavy slouch. Each head has a flat nose and tusk-like teeth; a ragged hide kilt hangs from the waist.

Ettin, Kobold.aparencia: Stocky lizard-skinned brute with two scaly, snouted heads on a broad rust-red body. Small curved horns crown each head, and a thick tail drags behind; sharp yellow eyes squint in both directions.

Execrable Shrub.aparencia: Waist-high thorny bush with blackened, twisted branches and sickly yellow-green leaves. Oozing sap-stained knots resemble sneering faces, and roots claw above the soil like stubby legs.

Exploding Toad.aparencia: Small round toad with warty orange-red skin and a visibly swollen, glowing belly. Cracks of ember light run across its back, and it squats low with bulging, nervous eyes.

Eye Golem.aparencia: Broad-shouldered humanoid of smooth marble-white stone, standing tall and rigid. Its chest, arms and brow are covered in carved eye-shaped sigils that glow faintly, with a blank, heavy face.

Eye of the Gods.aparencia: Small floating orb like a single large eyeball with a glowing golden iris. Wispy radiant filaments trail behind it, and a faint halo ring hovers around its pale, veined surface.

Fabricator.aparencia: Wide rectangular slab of thick green ooze that creeps slowly along the ground. Its glossy surface bubbles and ripples, with stringy tendrils reaching from the edges like drips from a vat.

Faceless Wanderer.aparencia: Tall robed figure woven from tattered shadow and drifting darkness. Where the face should be sits a smooth, bone-white oval disk, and its ragged sleeves trail into smoke.

Faerie Dragon.aparencia: Slender cat-sized dragon with shimmering iridescent scales, butterfly-like translucent wings and a long, curling tail. Large bright eyes and small horns give it a playful, mischievous look.

Faerie Dragon Familiar.aparencia: Tiny palm-sized dragon with soft pastel scales and delicate dragonfly wings. It perches upright with a curled tail and wide curious eyes, a little glimmer of dust trailing behind.

Faerie Eater Troll.aparencia: Hulking hunched troll with mossy green-grey skin, a gaping wide jaw and long crooked claws. Tiny shimmering wing scraps and glittering dust cling to its stained teeth and matted hair.

Faerie Noble.aparencia: Slim, elegant, pointed-eared figure in layered silk robes of leaf green and gold. A delicate circlet of twigs and flowers crowns the head, with gossamer wings folded behind the shoulders.

Fallen Deva.aparencia: Tall winged humanoid with a graceful build, but its feathers are singed and blackened and its skin dulled to ash grey. A cracked, dimmed halo hovers above a weary, downcast face.

Fallen Planetar.aparencia: Large muscular winged being with broad, ragged charcoal wings and faintly glowing cracks across its bronze skin. It stands in tarnished plate armor, eyes burning dim red under a shattered halo.

Fallen Solar.aparencia: Towering radiant humanoid whose golden skin is scorched dark in patches. Huge ruined wings of burnt feathers spread behind a tarnished breastplate, and a broken halo flickers over a stern face.

Falsifier Fog.aparencia: Huge billowing bank of sickly grey-green mist that curls through streets like a living cloud. Pale lights shimmer inside and now and then faint faces swirl in the vapor.

Fane Spirit.aparencia: Translucent robed priest with a serene face on one side that melts into a grinning skull on the other. Pale blue vapor trails from its hem, and tattered vestments hang over bony, hovering hands.

Fang of the Great Wolf.aparencia: Large lean wolf with thick silver-grey fur, a scarred muzzle and an oversized, curved ivory fang visible even with its mouth closed. It stands with lowered head and a bristling ridge of hackles.

Far Darrig.aparencia: Small elfin herdsman with a long pointed nose and sly grin, dressed in tan hide armor, boots and a cowl trimmed with fox fur. A red sash is knotted at his waist; he is wiry and short.

Far Dorocha.aparencia: Slender, pale, long-limbed fey attendant in a dark hooded cloak with silver trim. Narrow violet eyes glint from within the hood, and it stands very still, half merged with the gloom behind it.

Far Wanderer.aparencia: Lean traveler in a dust-stained long coat and wide hood, carrying a staff and a worn satchel. Its skin has a faint starry shimmer, and its boots are scuffed from countless distances.

Fate Eater.aparencia: Human-length, ghostly centipede with a pale, semi-transparent segmented body and many thin legs. Erratic violet light flickers around it, and long antennae twitch above a pincered mouth.

Faux-Garou.aparencia: Gaunt wolf-headed figure with patchy mangy fur and an ill-fitting, stitched pelt draped over a human frame. Its snout is too long, its hands are clawed, and it hunches with a tilted stance.

Fear Liath.aparencia: Huge grey-furred, bear-like brute standing upright on thick legs, with a long, shaggy mane and bulging, glowing white eyes. Heavy hands end in long dark claws, and its mouth hangs open.

Fear Smith.aparencia: Slender elf-like figure with pale skin and a smooth, featureless face, ending in long taloned hands. It wears a dark leather apron stained with soot and carries a heavy hammer and tongs.

Felid Dragon.aparencia: Massive tiger-bodied creature with orange fur, black stripes and broad scaly dragon wings folded along its back. A long striped tail sways behind, and the head is feline with small horns.

Fell Nightmare.aparencia: Powerful black horse with a mane and tail of smoky flame, burning orange eyes and glowing hooves. Its coat is slick as oil, and its lips peel back from jagged, too-sharp teeth.

Fellforged.aparencia: Man-sized clockwork body of rusted iron plates, exposed gears and cracked brass joints. A pale ghostly glow leaks from the chest and eye slits, and its limbs jerk with a bent, twisted gait.

Fennec Fox.aparencia: Tiny sandy-cream fox with enormous upright ears, large dark eyes and a bushy black-tipped tail. It has slender legs, a pointed little muzzle and fine fur that blends with desert sand.

Feral Hunter.aparencia: Wild, sinewy hunter with matted hair, painted face and bare, scarred arms. It crouches low in patched hide wrappings, gripping a bone-tipped spear and a short curved knife.

Fetal Savant.aparencia: Tiny curled infant-like creature floating inside a translucent glowing bubble of fluid. It has an oversized bald head, closed eyes and a faint third-eye mark glowing on its forehead.

Fext.aparencia: Gaunt woman-shaped corpse with taut, grey, dead skin on her face and hands, tattooed entirely with overlapping fish-scale patterns. Her hair hangs lank and wet, and her eyes are clouded white.

Fey Drake.aparencia: Small lithe drake with emerald and lilac scales, leaf-shaped frills along its neck and slim, translucent wings. Its slender snout and bright amber eyes give it a watchful, graceful look.

Fey Knight.aparencia: Slim armored warrior in polished leaf-shaped plates of silver-green, with an antlered helm and a flowing cloak of woven vines. It carries a slender rapier and a round shield etched with thorns.

Fey Revenant.aparencia: Large spider-bodied fey with a pale, gaunt elfin torso rising from a thorn-covered black abdomen. Eight spindly legs end in barbs, and icy, frost-white tendrils trail from its shadowy form.

Feyward Tree.aparencia: Massive tree forged of cold dark metal, its trunk covered in rust-red bark-like crust. Dull metallic leaves hang from stiff iron branches, and roots of dark steel grip the ground.

Fidele Angel.aparencia: Graceful winged humanoid in flowing white robes with a soft golden glow, wide feathered wings and gentle, steady eyes. A slim halo floats above, and its hands are open and calm.

Fierstjerren.aparencia: Wiry, hard-eyed figure with sharp angular features, gray skin and star-shaped scars across the cheeks. It wears dark studded leather and carries a curved dagger on each hip.

Fire Dancer Swarm.aparencia: Cloud of tiny blue flames drifting and whirling together, each flicker holding a small white skull shape in its center. Sparks trail off the swirling mass, which has no solid body.

Fire Elemental.aparencia: Tall roiling figure made of orange and yellow flame with a vaguely humanoid outline. Its core glows white-hot, long tongues of fire whip around the arms, and ember sparks rise from the body.

Fire Giant.aparencia: Enormous soot-black-skinned humanoid with glowing orange eyes and a wild mane of ember-red hair. It wears blackened plate and a studded belt, with thick, powerful arms and a thick beard.

Fire Giant War Priest.aparencia: Huge dark-skinned humanoid in scorched ceremonial plate, painted with glowing ash-white sigils. A tall horned headdress crowns its head, and it grips a heavy iron-topped mace wreathed in embers.

Fire Imp.aparencia: Tiny red-skinned devil with pointed ears, small curved horns and a barbed tail tipped with a flicker of flame. Bat-like wings flutter on its back, and it wears a wide, wicked grin.

Fire-Infused Water Elemental.aparencia: Pillar of churning blue water shaped like a humanoid, glowing orange from within. Steam trails from its shoulders and head, and bubbles rise across its rippling, boiling surface.

Firebird.aparencia: Peacock-sized bird that struts proudly, with a wide fan of flaming tail feathers shifting from red through gold to violet. Its body is crimson and gold, and its beak is slim and curved.

Firegeist.aparencia: Small vaguely humanoid shape of black curling smoke, with bright patches of flame glowing at the eyes, chest and hands. Its lower body fades into drifting wisps rather than legs.

Firetamer.aparencia: Lean elementalist in layered crimson and charcoal robes with scorched hems, wearing a copper-banded gauntlet on one arm. Small flames curl obediently around the open hands, and the eyes glow amber.

Flab Giant.aparencia: Obese, bell-shaped giant with sagging pale-yellow skin crawling with ulcers, swollen veins and fungal rashes. Its tiny head sits low between huge shoulders, with short bowed legs and drooping arms.

Flame Dragon Wyrmling.aparencia: Young dragon, dog-sized, with charred black scales that seem burnt rather than naturally colored. Glowing orange cracks mark the throat and wing membranes, and the snout is short with small horns.

Flame Eater Swarm.aparencia: Dense cloud of tiny winged insects with glowing red abdomens and ash-grey bodies. They move as one humming mass, bits of ember and smoke trailing from their wings.

Flame-Scourged Scion.aparencia: Towering humanoid whose skin is blistered, charred and split with glowing lava-like cracks. Remnants of a scorched noble cloak cling to its shoulders, and its eyes burn like coals in a hairless head.

Flayed Wraith.aparencia: Flying sheet of raw, red, skinless-looking hide shaped like a human, with hollow eye holes and a gaping mouth. It drifts and flaps on thin, wet wings, with ragged edges trailing behind.

Flesh Golem.aparencia: Hulking humanoid stitched from mismatched patches of grey and pink skin, with thick black thread along its limbs and neck. Its brow is heavy, its shoulders huge, and its movement stiff.

Flesh Guardian.aparencia: Bulky sentry of fused muscle and exposed sinew with a bald, eyeless head and wide, plated shoulders of hardened scar tissue. It stands square and braced, forearms oversized and fists knotted.

Flesh Reaver.aparencia: Lean, wiry predator with blood-red skin, long blade-like forearms and a mouth of needle teeth. It crouches forward on digitigrade legs, with ribs showing and a whip-thin tail.

Fleshdreg.aparencia: Enormous fleshy, pink-grey tree with a swollen, vein-streaked trunk and drooping limp branches. A heap of half-digested plant matter lies at its base, and a wide slit near the bottom gapes like a mouth.

Fleshpod Hornet.aparencia: Hornet as big as a dog, with a striped black and sallow-yellow body and glassy wings. Its abdomen ends in a pulsing, wet fleshy pod and a long curved stinger.

Fleshspurned.aparencia: Floating apparition made of a tattered funerary shroud pulled into a hollow hood, over a set of absurdly large, loose white teeth. No body shows under the cloth, only dark empty folds.

Flinderbeast.aparencia: Stout, boar-sized quadruped with splintered, wood-chip-like bristles covering its back. It has a blunt tusked snout, stumpy legs and small eyes, and its brown hide looks bark-rough.

Flithidir.aparencia: Small gnome-like figure with a round face, pointed hooked beak and brilliantly colored feathered arms like short wings. A crest of bright plumes tops its head, and it flutters with tiny clawed feet.

Flumph.aparencia: Flat, pale, jellyfish-like disk hovering above the ground, ringed by a short frill of tentacles with two eyes on short stalks. Its translucent, pinkish body has a slight glow and a stubby tail spike.

Flutterflesh.aparencia: Butterfly-shaped mass of fused corpses, with broad wings of stretched skin and limbs of exposed bone. Its head is a cluster of several different skulls, and its body is gaunt and pale.

Flying Lion.aparencia: Powerful tawny lion with a full dark mane and broad feathered wings spreading from its shoulders. It hangs in a leaping pose with claws extended, its tail tufted and long.

Flying Polyp.aparencia: Huge, semi-transparent cone-shaped mass of pale tubes and whipping tentacles, with no clear face. Dark cloud-like smears trail from it, and several lipless, funnel-like mouths gape on the surface.

Flying Snake.aparencia: Slender, brightly banded serpent in red, yellow and green, with a pair of narrow feathery wings along its sides. The head is small and wedge-shaped, and the thin body curls gently as it glides.

Flying Sword.aparencia: Single long steel blade with a simple crossguard and wrapped grip, hovering point-down in midair. Its edge gleams, with faint etched runes along the flat and no wielder.

Folk Of Leng.aparencia: Lean humanoid with goat-like legs, small horns hidden beneath a wrapped turban and a wide mouth lined with rows of serrated teeth like a shark's. Its skin is sallow and its robes are loose.

Folk of Leng.aparencia: Gaunt, long-faced goat-legged figure in layered dusty silks, a tall turban concealing little horns. Its lips curl back from many jagged teeth, and the narrow shoulders and stooped back look sinister.

Fomorian.aparencia: Huge, deformed giant with lumpy grey-green skin, one overlarge arm and a twisted, misshapen face with a single sagging eye. It wears a heavy rough-stitched hide, and its legs are uneven.

Forest Drake.aparencia: Small wingless dragon with mossy green and brown scales, bark-textured ridges along its back and a long muscular tail. Its broad snout and amber eyes blend into the leaf litter as it crouches.

Forest Emperor.aparencia: Huge centaur-shaped creature of wood and raw flesh, with bony, bark-like limbs and a long, antlered head. Its torso is a tangle of roots and muscle, and thick yellow sulfurous mist drifts from its hooves.

Forest Falcon.aparencia: Large raptor with short, broad wings and a long tail, suited for tight flight among trees. Its plumage is slate-brown above and barred cream below, with a hooked beak and fierce yellow eyes.

Forest Gnome Illusionist.aparencia: Small gnome with a long nose, rosy cheeks and a green pointed cap decorated with feathers. It wears a patchwork robe sewn with tiny mirrors, and carries a thin crooked wand with a shimmer around it.

Forest Gnome Scout.aparencia: Small gnome with a ruddy face, bright eyes and a brown hood, dressed in mottled green leathers. It carries a little short bow and a quiver of fletched twigs, with moss tucked into its belt.

Forest Marauder.aparencia: Smaller, shaggy giant with mottled green-brown skin and a bristling beard threaded with leaves. It wears a bark-and-hide vest, carries a thick uprooted club, and walks with a rolling, heavy stride.

Forest Hunter.aparencia: Sturdy woodsman in a mossy green hooded cloak and leather vest, face half-shadowed. It carries a long bow across its back and a hatchet at its belt, and stands poised and quiet.

Forgotten God.aparencia: Tall, faded humanoid figure of pale, crumbling light, its face worn smooth and blank like an ancient statue. Cracked halo fragments orbit its head, and its translucent robes dissolve into dust.

Forgotten Regent.aparencia: Gaunt crowned figure in tattered, dusty royal robes, with desiccated grey skin and a tarnished iron crown. It sits slumped, hands holding a cracked scepter, eyes dim and faraway.

Foxfire Ooze.aparencia: Large glistening puddle of translucent ooze that glows with pale blue-green light, like rotting wood. Tiny spore-like specks float inside the jelly, and the surface ripples slowly as it spreads.

Foxin.aparencia: Small fox-like creature with russet fur, a white chest, large pointed ears and a plume of a tail. Its long snout and quick amber eyes suggest cleverness, and it stands lightly on slim legs.

Fractal Golem.aparencia: Heavy humanoid made of angular crystalline plates that repeat in smaller and smaller copies of the same shapes. Its surface glints with prismatic edges, and it stands in a stiff, symmetrical pose.

Fragrant One.aparencia: Pale yellow and green slug-like body sits atop a large speckled mushroom, with a calm round human-like face and soft, sleepy eyes. Faint curls of perfumed mist drift above its glossy back.

Fragrite.aparencia: Squat creature of fractured rock and gem-like crystal shards, with chunky stone limbs and jagged glassy spikes along its back. Its dull brown body has bright, faceted patches that catch the light.

Fraughashar.aparencia: Slight goblin-like creature with blue skin, big pointed ears and a long nose dripping with icicles. It has thin limbs, small sharp teeth and a ragged scrap of cloth for clothing.

Frog.aparencia: Small green amphibian with smooth, moist skin, long folded hind legs and big bulging eyes on top of its head. Its pale throat swells gently, and it sits low on webbed toes.

Frog, Giant.aparencia: Man-sized amphibian with warty olive skin, a huge wide mouth and powerful hind legs coiled for a leap. A long pink tongue lies ready, and heavy-lidded golden eyes sit atop a broad flat head.

Frog, Giant Poisonous.aparencia: Big, plump amphibian with glossy skin in vivid warning bands of yellow, electric blue and black. Slick toxic droplets bead along its back, and it sits wide and heavy with bulging red eyes.

Frost Giant.aparencia: Enormous pale blue-skinned humanoid with a braided white beard and icy eyes. It wears thick furs and rough iron armor crusted with rime, and carries a huge notched axe.

Frost Giant Jarl.aparencia: Towering blue-white lord in layered fur and polished steel, with a heavy gold-ringed braid and a horned helm. A great greatsword with ember-red runes hangs at its hip, and its stance is commanding.

Frost Mole.aparencia: Small round mole with thick white-blue fur, a pink pointed snout and broad digging paws with long pale claws. Tiny, nearly blind eyes sit in the frost-dusted face, and its tail is short and stubby.

Frostjack.aparencia: Spindly figure of jagged ice and dark twisted twigs with a pumpkin-like hollow head, glowing a cold pale blue. Long thin arms end in sharp icicle claws, and frost steams around its feet.

Frostveil.aparencia: Shimmering sheet of frozen mist shaped like a shrouded figure, with an empty hood and long trailing sleeves rimmed in crystals. Cold white vapor spills from the cloth, and tiny ice flakes drift around.

Fulad-Zereh.aparencia: Towering warrior in a full suit of dark steel mail woven under overlapping plates, with a conical helmet and a hanging mail veil. A long curved blade and a round shield are held ready.

Fulminar.aparencia: Large, muscular figure of crackling blue-white energy, its shape flickering like a bolt of lightning. Arcs jump between its arms, and its eyes are bright points of white inside a rough dark head.

Fungi, Duskwilt.aparencia: Small cluster of drooping mushrooms with wrinkled, purple-grey caps and thin, pale stalks. Dim golden light pulses from the gills beneath, and the caps sag like wilted flowers at dusk.

Fungi, Mulcher.aparencia: Vast, hill-sized mass of thick brown fungal growth, with broad shelf-like caps stacked along a heavy trunk-like body. Dark wet gills, trailing threads and a rotting-leaf crust cover its surface.

Fungi, Mush Marcher.aparencia: Tall, upright mushroom creature walking on two thick stalk legs, with a broad red-brown cap and short arms. The pale gills show under the cap, and it stands in a stiff, soldier-like posture.

Fungi, Void Fungus.aparencia: Man-sized fungus with a glossy black, cup-shaped cap that seems to swallow light, on a thin pale stem. Faint violet specks drift out of the dark center, and thread-like roots curl in the dirt.

Gaki.aparencia: Emaciated humanoid with grey skin stretched over visible ribs, a hugely bloated belly and a thin neck. Its mouth is tiny and its throat narrow, with sunken glowing eyes and brittle clawed hands.

Galidroo.aparencia: Heavy, ox-sized beast with hairless, wrinkled skin covered in warts and weeping pustules. It has stubby legs, a broad blunt head with small eyes, and a drooping jaw with yellow teeth.

Gargoctopus.aparencia: Stone-gray octopus body with a craggy, chiseled head, bat-like leathery wings folded on its back and eight thick tentacles ending in clawed tips. Fanged beak and glowing yellow eyes under heavy brow ridges.

Gargoyle.aparencia: Hunched winged humanoid carved from gray stone, with a horned grimacing face, taloned hands and feet, and a short spiked tail. Crouches on bent legs, bat wings half open, surface pitted and weathered.

Garlicle.aparencia: Small bulb-bodied plant creature with pale papery skin, a tuft of green leafy fronds on top, and thin root-like limbs. Round dark eyes and a wide chanting mouth, faint pungent haze around it.

Garmvvolf.aparencia: Immense black wolf with a blood-streaked chest, shaggy matted fur and a heavy ruff, glowing red eyes and long dripping fangs. Broad paws, ribs showing under a chain-like collar scar, hunched hunting stance.

Garroter Crab.aparencia: Small blue-black freshwater crab with a muddy, ridged shell, stalked beady eyes and one oversized serrated pincer. Four pairs of thin walking legs, low scuttling posture at the stream edge.

Gaunt One.aparencia: Emaciated gray corpse-like humanoid, skin drawn tight over visible ribs and skull, sunken hollow eyes and cracked lips. Long thin fingers hang to the knees, shoulders stooped, ragged cloth at the waist.

Gbahali (Postosuchus).aparencia: Large bipedal-leaning crocodilian reptile with a long deep skull, dagger teeth and hide of mottled shifting colors. Powerful hind legs, shorter forelimbs, heavy tail held out for balance.

Gbahali.aparencia: Huge scaly predator with a narrow crocodile-like head full of long curved teeth, hide patterned in blotches that blend with surroundings. Thick muscular legs, low crouch, tail dragging behind it.

Gear Spider.aparencia: Tiny clockwork spider with a brass cog for a body and eight jointed legs made of thin rods and hinges. Pinprick lens eyes, tiny exposed gears ticking along its back, delicate metal fangs.

Gearforged Templar.aparencia: Tall humanoid built of bronze plates and pale mithral panels, visible gears turning in the joints of shoulders and knees. Heavy helm with a narrow glowing visor, tabard of riveted metal, slow heavy gait.

Gearmass.aparencia: Bulky heap of interlocking brass and iron gears, springs and shafts fused into a rough lumbering ball-shaped body. A few piston arms jut out, steam leaks from seams, no clear face.

Gelatinous Cube.aparencia: Perfectly square block of clear green-tinged jelly filling a corridor, with half-digested bones and coins floating suspended inside. Surface wobbles slightly and glistens, no face or limbs.

Gelatinous Wall.aparencia: Huge upright slab of translucent slime, thick as a barricade, rippling slowly with murky bubbles and dark debris suspended in it. Bulges outward at the base, glossy and dripping.

Gerridae.aparencia: Large water-strider insect with a slender brown body, very long splayed legs ending in water-repellent tips and a camel-like humped back. Long neck, small head with bulging eyes, no wings.

Ghast.aparencia: Gaunt gray ghoul with stretched pallid skin, a long jaw of yellow fangs and long clawed hands. Hunched, wiry body, patchy hair, faint rotting stench haze around the shoulders.

Ghast of Leng.aparencia: Tall, gaunt gray-skinned horror with a long face, bulging pale eyes and a wide fanged mouth. Stooped frame with long arms and hoof-like feet, ragged hide hanging loosely from the ribs.

Ghillie Dubh.aparencia: Bipedal mound of dark leaves, moss and trailing twigs shaped like a man, with a hollow shadowed face and two dim green eyes. Shaggy fronds hang from its arms, bark-like hands, silent still posture.

Ghost.aparencia: Translucent pale human figure with a tattered shroud trailing into mist instead of legs, hollow dark eyes and mouth. Arms drift outward, outline flickers, faint cold blue glow.

Ghost Boar.aparencia: Spectral boar made of pale translucent mist, with curved glowing tusks, bristled ridge of spectral hair and empty eye sockets. Hind half fades into wisps, heavy lowered head ready to charge.

Ghost Dragon.aparencia: Translucent bluish-white dragon whose body dissolves into fog at the tail and wing edges. Skeletal ribs show through, hollow glowing eyes, long jagged jaw and tattered wings spread wide.

Ghost Dwarf.aparencia: Stocky see-through bearded dwarf with a braided beard of drifting mist, a faintly outlined helm and heavy shoulders. Lower body fades to smoke, hollow eyes, hands gripping a ghostly hammer.

Ghost Knight Templar.aparencia: Transparent armored warrior in a long tabard marked with a faded cross, helm with narrow slit glowing white, mist replacing the legs. Holds a spectral broad shield and heavy blade, cold pallor all over.

Ghostwalk Spider.aparencia: Large pale spider with a semi-translucent bluish body, long thin legs that fade at the tips into mist and a cluster of dark eyes. Leaves faint trailing wisps, fangs glistening, hunched stance.

Ghoul.aparencia: Hunched gray humanoid with sunken yellow eyes, a long snout-like jaw of sharp teeth and long black claws. Skin hangs over thin ribs, ragged burial rags, crouched feral posture.

Ghoul Bat.aparencia: Small bat with a stretched emaciated torso and a head that looks like skin pulled over bone, pale eye sockets and thin fangs. Leathery wings are ragged and gray, hanging upside down.

Ghoul, Darakhul.aparencia: Tall gray-skinned ghoul with a lean wiry frame, long fangs and dark eyes, wearing dull scaled armor over a dark cloak. Claws curved and stained, ears pointed, upright disciplined stance.

Ghoul, Imperial.aparencia: Stately gray-skinned ghoul in ornate crimson-trimmed plate with a high collar, pale tight skin and elongated fangs. Narrow clawed fingers, cold white eyes, proud rigid posture.

Ghoulsteed.aparencia: Gaunt undead horse with gray stretched hide over every rib, patchy black mane and glowing red eyes. Long skull with bared yellow teeth, hooves cracked, a ragged saddle blanket hanging.

Ghul.aparencia: Lean desert figure in a black turban and loose dark robes, face half covered, with pale thin skin and glowing narrow eyes. Long fingers, curved dagger at the belt, mist curling at its feet.

Giant Owl.aparencia: Huge owl with soft buff and brown barred plumage, a round pale facial disc, large amber eyes and tufted ear feathers. Broad silent wings, powerful feathered legs with curved talons.

Giant Rat (Diseased).aparencia: Oversized rat with patchy matted gray fur, weeping red-rimmed eyes and bare sores on the flanks. Long scaly tail, yellowed protruding incisors, thin hunched body and trembling whiskers.

Giant Scorpion.aparencia: Sand-colored scorpion with a segmented armored body, two heavy pincers and a long curved tail ending in a barbed stinger. Eight legs spread wide, small eyes on the carapace.

Giant Sea Horse.aparencia: Tall seahorse with a bony ridged body in coral-pink and yellow, a long tubular snout, a curled prehensile tail and a fluttering dorsal fin. Shy upright posture, delicate skin-frill fringes.

Giant Seahorse.aparencia: Large steed-sized seahorse with a segmented teal and silver body, a horse-like arched neck, a curled tail and translucent fins. Small eye on the head, spiny crest down the back.

Giant Shark.aparencia: Gray streamlined shark thirty feet long with a pale belly, tall triangular dorsal fin, rows of serrated teeth and cold black eyes. Powerful crescent tail, scarred snout.

Giant Sloth.aparencia: Elephant-sized ground sloth with shaggy brown fur, a small round head, very long curved claws and a thick hind body that props on a heavy tail. Rears upright to browse, slow ponderous limbs.

Giant Snow Beetle.aparencia: Broad pale beetle with a frosted white-blue shell, ridged wing covers and thick short legs ending in hooked claws. Short stubby antennae, rounded body low in the snow, sturdy draft build.

Giant Spider.aparencia: Big dark brown spider with a bulbous striped abdomen, eight bristled legs and a cluster of glittering eyes. Fangs hang below the head, spinnerets at the rear, web strands trailing.

Giant, Thursir Armorer.aparencia: Broad blue-gray frost giant with a braided beard, a thick leather apron over bare arms scarred by sparks and tongs in hand. Heavy shoulders, soot-streaked skin, sturdy bronze-studded belt.

Giant, Thursir Hearth Priestess.aparencia: Tall robed giantess with ruddy skin and long braided hair threaded with ash-gray beads, carrying a bowl of glowing coals. Wears a wool shawl embroidered with flame patterns, warm calm face.

Giant Toad.aparencia: Bulky brown toad with dry warty skin, large parotoid glands behind the eyes, wide mouth and heavy squat hind legs. Gold-ringed eyes, mottled belly, sits flat and heavy on the ground.

Giant Walking Stick.aparencia: Extremely long twig-shaped insect with a thin brown-green body, spindly jointed legs held straight and a small head with thread-like antennae. Bark-like texture, motionless branch-mimic pose.

Giant Wasp.aparencia: Large wasp with a narrow waist, black and yellow banded abdomen, smoky translucent wings and big dark compound eyes. Slender dangling legs, a long stinger at the tip, thin sharp mandibles.

Giant Weasel.aparencia: Very long slender weasel with a russet back, cream belly, short legs and a bushy black-tipped tail. Triangular face, small round ears, bright dark eyes, arched body mid-leap.

Glabrezu.aparencia: Towering four-armed fiend with a dog-like head, tusked jaw and curved horns, rough gray-brown hide. Two upper arms end in huge crab-like pincers, two lower ones in human hands, hunched stance.

Gnarljak.aparencia: Small crouching creature shaped like a spring-loaded steel trap, with two toothed jaws of rusty iron, coiled spring body and tiny legs of bent wire.

Gnyan.aparencia: Large heavy-set beast with stubby legs, thick grey-brown hide in plates and a broad horned head; slow lumbering posture.

Goat.aparencia: Ordinary medium goat with a shaggy off-white coat, curved ridged horns, rectangular-pupiled eyes, small beard and sturdy cloven hooves.

Goblin Captain.aparencia: Small green humanoid in a patched breastplate and plumed dented helm, with a rusty saber, red sash and a sharp-toothed scowl.

Gorgon.aparencia: Large bull-like beast with iron-grey metallic scales, a broad snout with smoking nostrils, curved horns and heavy cloven hooves.
